tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

Probe results: xq -10.8, zf -8.9 source. Playback +5 => -5.8 and -3.9. Melee -3.9 might be a bit loud but okay; old mp3 base was -3.6, so similar. Ranged -5.8 vs old combined maybe -3.6; slightly softer but distinct. Good.

Need cleanup probe files/imports, compile battle/net_client, notify.

But wait: `SfxManager.gd:649: "aa":` is `_dyn_cfg` prefix; fine. Other matches unrelated.

Also check the `aa` mp3 file remains unused; user said "删除原本我给玩家攻击设定的音效" — could mean remove the audio file `audio/普攻音效.mp3`? They likely mean stop using it / delete the sound setting. Deleting asset might be expected? "删除原本我给玩家攻击设定的音效，改为使用你生成的..." — remove the original attack SFX and use generated. We removed path and playback, but file remains. Should we delete `audio/普攻音效.mp3` and its `.import`? The file was user-provided; deleting might be desired but risky if other references. Search references: no other. However minimal changes and avoid destructive file deletion unless asked. "删除原本...音效" could mean delete the sound effect (from gameplay). Leaving unused asset is fine; mention it's no longer referenced; not deleting source asset. But perhaps user wants the old sound gone forever; we can leave asset to avoid git-less irreversible deletion. Say "不再引用原 mp3（文件保留，未删）" maybe. But they said delete; perhaps remove file to disk? Could move? No git; risky. I'd keep and mention unreferenced; if they want file removal, can ask? Minimal path: not delete binary.

Actually "删除原本我给玩家攻击设定的音效" in context likely means remove the old attack sound from the sound design, not delete file. Fine.

Now compile and verify no runtime error from removing `aa` path: `_sfx_stream` key detection: dynamic `aa:` contains colon → synth; base key "aa" now absent in `_SFX_PATHS`, but nobody plays `"aa"` base. Could some code call `_play_sfx("aa")`? grep found none. Good.

Probe cleanup: remove `_aa_probe.gd/.tscn/.uid`, wavs and imports. Then compile. Then notify.

Also maybe check no `.uid` for wav generated? Godot may generate `.import` only on import; headless load might create `.import` when saving? Check files list.

Run cleanup + compile.

- 改动点 SfxManager: `_SFX_PATHS` 删除 `aa`；`try_attack_sfx` 只播 `aa:hero:range`，移除 -3dB mp3；音量补偿（near 0.30→0.42, ranged 0.24→0.34; arp fallback 0.30）。
- 效果: 每个英雄按元素/远近程有独立音色，不受 mp3 掩盖；本地玩家 only, AI unchanged.
- 验证: probe saved: 小乔 -10.8 dB, 张飞 -8.9 dB source (+5 → -5.8/-3.9); battle/net_client compile OK.
- 原 mp3 文件保留但不再引用.

Need be careful "每英雄" — `_cfg_aa` uses hero element + range, not unique per hero except element; user said "针对特定音效的普攻音效" (generated per specific sounds), earlier we built per-hero. Each hero maps to element; same element heroes share timbre with detune. Could say "按英雄元素/远近程定制". They may expect truly per-hero; current implementation from previous task used `_detune("aa:"+hero,4)` fixed variation, so arguably per hero slight variation. Fine.

Should we add stronger unique per hero? Not asked; existing generated per-hero sound is what they refer to.

Also `play_ui_sfx("aa")` no remaining; good.

Notify.

popup shown: HonorKing · 普攻音效改用英雄专属合成音 | 移除原 MP3 普攻底音，仅播放按英雄/远近程生成的特制普攻音

已移除原有 MP3 普攻底音，玩家普攻现在只播放按英雄定制的合成音。

**改动**（[SfxManager.gd:306](scripts/core/SfxManager.gd:306)）
- 删除 `_SFX_PATHS` 里的 `"aa": res://audio/普攻音效.mp3"` 引用。
- `try_attack_sfx()` 不再播放 `aa` MP3 底音，只播放 `aa:<英雄>:<攻击距离>` 专属合成音。

Current buff indicator: two simple torus rings (`create_torus_ring(1.2,1.5, Color.RED,true)` etc.) at y 0.35 and 0.05. Need design more beautiful indicator for buff owner. Could replace with a visually rich ring under hero: dual rotating arcs, glow, particles, color-coded red/blue, maybe icon floating? Keep 3D world-space.

Need inspect `MeshFactory.create_torus_ring` signature and style options; maybe build custom mesh or use multiple torus layers + shader material. Existing visual quality likely low poly torus with emissive unshaded. We can design:
- Replace `buff_ring_red/blue` single MeshInstance3D with a custom `Node3D` group containing:
  - **base halo**: flat disc/annulus on ground with radial gradient (shader? or use TorusMesh with emission)
  - **two counter-rotating arc segments** (partial torus) for energy flow
  - **rising particles** or orbiting orbs
  - maybe subtle vertical light column.
- Need keep light performance: host only; 10 heroes max; no per-frame heavy.
- Could use `MeshFactory.create_torus_ring` but it returns MeshInstance3D with torus mesh; partial torus? TorusMesh full ring. Can use `ArrayMesh` arcs or CSG? Simpler: use multiple thin torus rings at different radii/heights with rotation & scale animation, plus shader material for glow. But "更美观" likely need something distinct, not just thicker ring.

Alternative: 3D **floating buff icon** above hero? Existing UI has buff icons in HUD for own hero; user requests "拥有者提示" likely world indicator around hero. Red/blue ring currently indicates which hero has buff; improve visually.

Design concept:
- Ground **rune circle**: two concentric rings (outer thin static, inner rotating segmented), color red/blue; soft additive glow; small orbiting particles.
- For red buff: warm orange-red with ember particles rising and pulsing.
- For blue buff: cyan-blue with cool wisps and rotating rune.
- Maybe vertical ribbons? Not necessary.

Implementation options in Godot:
1. Custom `BuffAura` class (Node3D) procedurally builds:
   - `MeshInstance3D` with `PlaneMesh` lying on ground using ShaderMaterial that draws animated ring/rune with transparency and emission; shader adds nice visuals cheaply. But custom shader asset requires file; can create Shader resource at runtime via `Shader.new()` + code string, or add `.gdshader` file. Could add `assets/shaders/buff_aura.gdshader`. But user may have editor; new shader is fine.
   - `GPUParticles3D` for embers/ice; needs process material; more code.
   - Use simple torus meshes and animation.

2. Build from meshes: Use `MeshFactory.create_torus_ring` for 2-3 rings; add small spheres orbiting; use `WorldEnvironment` glow already enabled. Add `StandardMaterial3D` with emission, transparency, shading unshaded, and additive blend. Animate rotation, scale pulse, orbiting orbs per frame in `_process` (host only). Could look decent.

But performance per hero × 2 buffs × multiple meshes; 10 heroes; okay.

Need know `MeshFactory` helpers. Read `MeshFactory.gd` for torus creation and material. Also Hero `_process`/animation structure; where buff ring visibility set line 1401; can update animation there.

Maybe best minimal-beautiful: replace single torus with a **layered aura node**:
- `buff_aura_red` / `buff_aura_blue` as Node3D created by new helper `MeshFactory.create_buff_aura(color, radius)` returning Node3D with:
  - Ground disc: `CylinderMesh` very flat? Use `TorusMesh` at y 0.02 (outer thin ring)
  - Rotating rune ring: `TorusMesh` at y 0.06, thinner, with emissive material; two rings counter rotate at different speeds
  - 6 orbiting small spheres at radius 1.5, height .12, additive glow
  - Maybe a soft vertical cone? 
- Animate via script attached? Could have `Hero` fields storing nodes and `_process` rotate. Simpler: create `BuffAura` class script with `_process` self-animating; add as Node3D; set via `set_active(bool)` and color; then Hero just toggles visible. New file `scripts/entities/BuffAura.gd` with `class_name BuffAura`? Minimal extra file acceptable. But user asked design; reusable.

Could avoid new file by having `MeshFactory.create_buff_aura` returning Node3D with a script? Runtime-created node can't attach script easily except `set_script(load(...))`; new file anyway.

Maybe implement in Hero with existing ring meshes and animate in Hero `_process`:
- Keep `buff_ring_red/blue` but upgrade mesh/material? User says ring not beautiful; adding multiple components requires animation. Hero already has `_process` for many heroes? Hero `_physics_process` huge; adding `_process` per frame for aura rotation could be okay but 10 heroes.

Cleaner: create `scripts/entities/BuffAura.gd` (extends Node3D) that builds own visual and animates; instantiate in Hero `_create_buff_rings` replacing two MeshInstance3D. Need preserve `buff_ring_red`/`buff_ring_blue` variable types? Currently `MeshInstance3D`; can change to `Node3D` or `BuffAura` type. References only `.visible` lines 1401/1402 and maybe challenge. Shader:
```glsl
shader_type spatial;
render_mode unshaded, blend_add, depth_draw_never, cull_disabled, shadows_disabled;

uniform vec4 aura_color : source_color = vec4(1.0, 0.35, 0.08, 1.0);
uniform vec4 core_color : source_color = vec4(1.0, 0.85, 0.45, 1.0);
uniform float ring_radius = 0.82;
uniform float mode = 0.0; // 0=red ember, 1=blue frost
uniform float intensity = 1.0;

varying vec2 p;

void vertex() {
    p = UV * 2.0 - 1.0;
}

float ring(float r, float target, float width) {
    return smoothstep(width, 0.0, abs(r - target));
}

void fragment() {
    float r = length(p);
    float ang = atan(p.y, p.x);
    float t = TIME;
    float a = 0.0;

    // 底部柔光
    a += smoothstep(1.0, 0.2, r) * 0.045;

    // 主环：细亮线 + 呼吸
    float pulse = 0.82 + 0.18 * sin(t * 2.3 + mode * 1.7);
    a += ring(r, ring_radius, 0.018) * 0.75 * pulse;
    a += ring(r, ring_radius + 0.055, 0.012) * 0.35;
    a += ring(r, ring_radius - 0.06, 0.010) * 0.25;

    // 旋转符文刻线：12 段短划
    float dashes = smoothstep(0.35, 0.95, sin(ang * 12.0 + t * (1.2 + mode * 0.5)) * 0.5 + 0.5);
    a += ring(r, ring_radius, 0.030) * dashes * 0.55;
    // 反向慢转的三段弧
    float arcs = smoothstep(0.55, 0.98, sin(ang * 3.0 - t * (0.55 + mode * 0.25) + mode * 1.3) * 0.5 + 0.5);
    a += ring(r, ring_radius + 0.105, 0.016) * arcs * 0.55;

    // 上升粒子/霜雾：红色用火星闪烁，蓝色用柔和雾带
    float wisp = sin(ang * (7.0 + mode * 4.0) + r * 22.0 - t * (2.2 + mode * 0.9));
    float wisp_mask = smoothstep(0.55, 1.0, wisp) * smoothstep(ring_radius + 0.34, ring_radius - 0.06, r) * smoothstep(0.0, 0.18, r);
    a += wisp_mask * (0.16 + 0.08 * sin(t * 3.1 + ang * 5.0));

    // 内圈元素核心
    float core = smoothstep(ring_radius - 0.12, 0.0, r) * (0.06 + 0.03 * sin(t * 1.7 + mode * 2.0));
    a += core * 0.6;

    // 边缘淡出，避免方形边界
    a *= smoothstep(1.0, 0.72, r);
    a = clamp(a * intensity, 0.0, 1.0);

    vec3 col = mix(aura_color.rgb, core_color.rgb, clamp(a * 1.6, 0.0, 1.0));
    ALBEDO = col;
    ALPHA = a;
}
```

shader_type spatial;
render_mode unshaded, blend_add, depth_draw_never, cull_disabled, shadows_disabled;

uniform vec4 aura_color : source_color = vec4(1.0, 0.35, 0.08, 1.0);
uniform vec4 core_color : source_color = vec4(1.0, 0.85, 0.45, 1.0);
uniform float ring_radius = 0.82;
uniform float mode = 0.0; // 0=red ember, 1=blue frost
uniform float intensity = 1.0;

varying vec2 p;

void vertex() {
    p = UV * 2.0 - 1.0;
}

float ring(float r, float target, float width) {
    return smoothstep(width, 0.0, abs(r - target));
}

void fragment() {
    float r = length(p);
    float ang = atan(p.y, p.x);
    float t = TIME;
    float a = 0.0;

    // 底部柔光
    a += smoothstep(1.0, 0.2, r) * 0.045;

    // 主环：细亮线 + 呼吸
    float pulse = 0.82 + 0.18 * sin(t * 2.3 + mode * 1.7);
    a += ring(r, ring_radius, 0.018) * 0.75 * pulse;
    a += ring(r, ring_radius + 0.055, 0.012) * 0.35;
    a += ring(r, ring_radius - 0.06, 0.010) * 0.25;

    // 旋转符文刻线：12 段短划
    float dashes = smoothstep(0.35, 0.95, sin(ang * 12.0 + t * (1.2 + mode * 0.5)) * 0.5 + 0.5);
    a += ring(r, ring_radius, 0.030) * dashes * 0.55;
    // 反向慢转的三段弧
    float arcs = smoothstep(0.55, 0.98, sin(ang * 3.0 - t * (0.55 + mode * 0.25) + mode * 1.3) * 0.5 + 0.5);
    a += ring(r, ring_radius + 0.105, 0.016) * arcs * 0.55;

    // 上升粒子/霜雾：红色用火星闪烁，蓝色用柔和雾带
    float wisp = sin(ang * (7.0 + mode * 4.0) + r * 22.0 - t * (2.2 + mode * 0.9));
    float wisp_mask = smoothstep(0.55, 1.0, wisp) * smoothstep(ring_radius + 0.34, ring_radius - 0.06, r) * smoothstep(0.0, 0.18, r);
    a += wisp_mask * (0.16 + 0.08 * sin(t * 3.1 + ang * 5.0));

    float core = smoothstep(ring_radius - 0.12, 0.0, r) * (0.06 + 0.03 * sin(t * 1.7 + mode * 2.0));
    a += core * 0.6;

    // 边缘淡出，避免方形边界
    a *= smoothstep(1.0, 0.72, r);
    a = clamp(a * intensity, 0.0, 1.0);

    vec3 col = mix(aura_color.rgb, core_color.rgb, clamp(a * 1.6, 0.0, 1.0));
    ALBEDO = col;
    ALPHA = a;
}

已把原来的红、蓝 Buff 圆环换成着色器绘制的 Buff 持有者法阵光环。

**视觉设计**（[buff_aura.gdshader](assets/shaders/buff_aura.gdshader)）
- 原先是两条纯色 Torus 粗圆环；现在改为地面 additive 法阵：
  - 主环 + 内外两条细环，带呼吸脉动；
  - 12 段旋转符文刻线，叠一圈反向慢转的三段弧；
  - 红色 Buff：环外火星流动、暖橙核心；蓝色 Buff：环外霜雾流动、冰蓝核心；
  - 中心微光 + 贴图边缘柔和淡出，HDR 亮度接入场景 Glow，夜间/团战中更醒目。
- 红环与蓝环同心不同半径（红外圈、蓝内圈），**同时持有红蓝 Buff 时不会互相遮挡**，会叠成双环法阵。

**接入**（[MeshFactory.gd:50](scripts/entities/MeshFactory.gd:50) / [Hero.gd:920](scripts/entities/Hero.gd:920)）
- 新增 `MeshFactory.create_buff_aura()`，由 Hero 直接创建，位置贴地 `y=0.045/0.055`。
- 仍由原有 `red_buff_active` / `blue_buff_active` 控制显隐，所有携带 Buff 的英雄（玩家与 AI）都会显示；Buff 逻辑、数值、计时完全未动。

**验证**
- 着色器提前 `preload`，battle / net_client 场景 headless 编译通过，无脚本或着色器错误。
- 离屏渲染探针确认红/蓝光环均正常绘制（红色像素约 2.1 万、蓝色约 2.5 万，颜色与位置正确），临时预览文件已清理。

func _apply_label_style(label: Label, font_size: int = 14, color: Color = UiKit.C_TEXT):
	label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", int(round(font_size * ui_scale())))
	label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", color)
	# 描边随字号缩放（原来恒为 1px，字号一大描边就消失，3D 场景上白字发糊）
	label.add_theme_color_override("font_outline_color", Color(0, 0, 0, 0.82))
	label.add_theme_constant_override("outline_size", UiKit.outline_size(font_size * ui_scale()))

func _apply_rich_label_style(rich: RichTextLabel, font_size: int = 14):
	rich.add_theme_font_size_override("normal_font_size", int(round(font_size * ui_scale())))
	rich.add_theme_color_override("default_color", UiKit.C_TEXT)

func _apply_panel_style(panel: Panel, alpha: float = 0.8):
	# P0 统一皮肤：扁平深色玻璃 + 1px 冷光描边（比 64px 9-slice 拉伸更锐利，且带柔和投影）
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel",
		UiKit.flat(clampf(alpha, 0.35, 1.0), 12, 1, UiKit.C_PANEL_EDGE, Color(0, 0, 0, 0), 10.0, 6.0))
func _apply_rich_label_style(rich: RichTextLabel, font_size: int = 14):
	rich.add_theme_font_size_override("normal_font_size", int(round(font_size * ui_scale())))
	rich.add_theme_color_override("default_color", UiKit.C_TEXT)

func _apply_panel_style(panel: Panel, alpha: float = 0.8):

	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel",
		UiKit.flat(clampf(alpha, 0.35, 1.0), 12, 1, UiKit.C_PANEL_EDGE, Color(0, 0, 0, 0), 10.0, 6.0))

func _apply_button_style(btn: Button):
	btn.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", int(round(14 * ui_scale())))

23: func _create_visual():
24: 	# 根据兵种加载对应模型
25: 	var model_map = {
26: 		"melee":  "res://model/melee/soldier.glb",
27: 		"ranged": "res://model/range/archer.glb",
28: 		"siege":  "res://model/seige/cannon-mobile.glb",
29: 		"super":  "res://model/super/character-orc.glb",
30: 		"dragon": "res://model/dragon/DragonBaby.glb",
31: 		"storm": "res://model/dragon/DragonBaby.glb",
32: 		"shadow_dragon": "res://model/dragon/DragonBaby.glb",
33: 	}
34: 	var path = model_map.get(display_name, "")
35: 	if path != "":
36: 		var model = load(path)
37: 		if model:
38: 			var instance = model.instantiate()
39: 			# 体型归一化：缩放由「目标高度/原始高度」算出，与客户端同一套常量
40: 			var sc: float = NetModels.minion_scale(display_name)
41: 			instance.scale = Vector3(sc, sc, sc)
42: 			add_child(instance)
43: 			visual = instance
44: 			# 队伍色染模型（继承模型材质的贴图/明暗，只做色相偏移）
45: 			UnitVisuals.tint_team(instance, team)
46: 			# 行走质感：小兵步频起伏 + 轻微摆动（去尘量小、限频）
47: 			WalkFeel.attach(self, instance, {"stride": 1.15, "bob": 0.032, "sway": 0.04, "lean": 0.05, "dust_size": 0.18})
48: 			anim_player = _find_anim_player(instance)
49: 			if anim_player:
50: 				_play_anim("idle")
51: 	if not has_node("CollisionShape3D"):
52: 		var col = CollisionShape3D.new()
53: 		col.shape = SphereShape3D.new()
54: 		# 暗影先锋视觉模型1.5倍缩放，碰撞半径同步放大
55: 		col.shape.radius = body_radius * 1.5 if display_name == "shadow_dragon" else body_radius
56: 		add_child(col)

59: func _play_anim(anim_name: String):
60: 	# 联机：小兵攻击动作推给客户端（非 HOST 由 net_action 直接忽略；
61: 	# 「附近有己方英雄」的闸门在 NetSession.push_net_action 里，不会刷远端小兵战）
62: 	if anim_name == "attack-melee-left":

67: 			"walk": super._play_anim("CharacterArmature|Flying_Idle")

69: 			"die": super._play_anim("CharacterArmature|Death")
70: 			_: super._play_anim(anim_name)

  `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`
  （脚本已就绪，失败会静默降级，不阻断交付）。

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

Tint lerps albedo to team color 0.5, adds emission. So all materials shift toward team color; dark armor becomes team-tinted. If we want team accent pure, albedo near white will lerp to team color at 50% → pastel, not pure. Could design team cloth material with albedo complementary? To get vivid team color after lerp, use albedo color such that lerp(alb, tint, .5) = desired; for cyan tint (0.25,0.85,1), desired cyan; albedo could be same cyan -> remains cyan. So set team cloth albedo = tint color; tint lerp same no change. Good. But builder doesn't know team unless pass team. For preview, build with team and tint; `team` optional. Game Minion can call `MinionModel.build(display_name, team)`; but then `tint_team` also. Use team param.

Materials neutral armor gets 50% team tint, making all armor strongly team-colored (existing behavior). To retain metal color, use **ShaderMaterial**? `tint_team` skips non-BaseMaterial3D. We can create a custom `ShaderMaterial` for armor that ignores team tint while team cloth BaseMaterial3D gets tinted. But game currently tints all; a new model can use ShaderMaterial for armor (with lighting) to preserve palette and add team emissive accents. That's more work; but better visual differentiation: team accents only, armor stays steel/bronze. Yet at gameplay distance, team identification needs stronger color; use bright team cloth + shield emblem + plume. A custom shader could add rim team color. But user hasn't approved; preview can show.

Simpler: use BaseMaterial3D all, tint 0.5 yields team-tinted armor, consistent with current minions/team recognition; silhouette and ancient style differentiate. Team cloth albedo set to white? After lerp white→tint .5 = pastel; not vivid. Set cloth albedo = **team color** and let tint leave it nearly same. Pass team.

But if `UnitVisuals.tint_team` applies emission tint, okay.

Need generate preview with exact game pipeline: `UnitVisuals.tint_team(root, team)`, `WalkFeel.attach`? WalkFeel attaches bob; preview static could show T-pose. Add `WalkFeel`? It may animate in `_process`; preview runs frames; good for natural stance? WalkFeel only bob/sway, not limbs. Static pose fine.

Gameplay: new model no skeletal animation; Minion calls `_play_anim("walk")` but `anim_player` null; no effect. WalkFeel gives bob. Attack `_play_anim("attack-melee-left")` no effect, but visual attack recoil? Minion attack code likely calls `_siege_recoil` only siege; for melee/ranged, no animation. New model would have **no attack animation**, a regression. Could add procedural attack animation component script or animate in Minion. User asked model screenshot, but final application should animate minimally. Could add `MinionModel` with a small `AnimationPlayer` (procedural keyframes) for walk/attack? For a merged single mesh can't animate limbs separately. Could build limbs as separate MeshInstance3D nodes (weapon arm) to animate; or keep whole model and do recoil/lean tween in Minion for all types. Current Minion already has `visual` node and siege recoil; for new model, could add attack lunge/weapon swing via node transforms if weapon separate. More complexity later; not needed for screenshot approval? User may apply and see static. But if model is much better, okay.

Could build **rigged-ish** model as Node3D hierarchy with sub-meshes for torso/arms/weapon, each merged by material within part, allowing `AnimationPlayer`? Too much.

Alternative keep each limb as MeshInstance3D (not merged) and add simple `AnimationPlayer` procedural tracks for walk/attack; 10-15 nodes per minion, performance maybe acceptable at 50 minions = 750 draws; too much on mobile.

Could merge static body and keep **weapon arm** separate for attack swing; 2 draw calls; idle bob from WalkFeel. For ranged, bow arm; attack recoil whole visual. Good enough.

But screenshot only needs static; application later can add lunge.

Let's focus on visual design and screenshots. We can say "这是概念版，确认后我再接入并补攻击/行走动作" maybe.

class_name MinionModel
extends RefCounted

else existing

Common humanoid:
- `hips` at y .55; `torso` from .50 to .90.
- legs: thigh/shin cylinders; use armor greaves; feet at z +.04.
- base stance: legs apart x ±.09, slight z.
- arms: shoulders at y .84, x ±.19; upper arm angled down/out; forearm.
- head center y 1.02, radius .095; helmet cone.
- target 1.30 includes helmet/plume. Body top 1.12; helmet top 1.30.

- feet carpet y=0.0 (boots center .05, h .10).
- shin centers .22 (h .32, radius .05), thigh center .42 (h .22).
- pelvis .54, torso .58-.86 (h .30), chest/lamellar.
- neck .89; head center 1.00 radius .095; helmet from .99 to 1.17 (cone); top plume 1.22-1.33.

- shoulder y .84, x ±.20.
- arms upper from shoulder to elbow (.66), forearm to hand (.56); with hands maybe .56.

Heights target 1.30: helmet top 1.18? Let's calculate:
feet 0-.10; shin .10-.38; thigh .38-.58; pelvis .50-.60; torso .58-.88; shoulders .86; head center 1.00 radius .10 → 1.10; helmet cone .98-1.18; plume 1.18-1.30. Good.

Better keep all BaseMaterial3D and tint 0.32; metal shifts some, acceptable.

```
static func _st(sts: Dictionary, key: String, mat: StandardMaterial3D) -> SurfaceTool:
    if not sts.has(key):
        var s := SurfaceTool.new(); s.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES); s.set_material(mat); sts[key]=s
    return sts[key]
```
`SurfaceTool.append_from(mesh, 0, xform)` requires mesh primitive; okay. For every part, `_box(sts, "steel", size, pos, rot)`: create BoxMesh each call; many allocations but build once per minion; 50 minions × 40 = 2000 meshes at spawn, may hitch. Better pre-cache primitive meshes by size? Or generate arrays. For preview fine; game later optimize. Could cache BoxMesh by size in static dictionary. But still `append_from` per part. Build time maybe 1-3ms per unit; acceptable wave 6 at once.

Merge surfaces:
```
var mesh := ArrayMesh.new()
for key in order:
    var s: SurfaceTool = sts[key]
    s.generate_normals()? append_from copies normals; generate_tangents optional.
    s.commit(mesh)
```
But `SurfaceTool.commit(mesh)` if mesh already has surfaces: docs `commit(existing: ArrayMesh = null, flags=0)` "If existing is provided, the surface will be appended to it." yes.
Material set via `s.set_material(mat)`.
Maybe `append_from` with non-indexed primitive requires `s.deindex()`? SurfaceTool can append indexed mesh and commit handles index; fine.

Meshes:
- BoxMesh `size`; transform `Transform3D(Basis.from_euler(rot), pos)`; but `Basis.from_euler` expects Vector3 radians.
- CylinderMesh props `top_radius`, `bottom_radius`, `height`, `radial_segments`, `rings`, `cap_top`, `cap_bottom`.
- SphereMesh `radius`, `height` (height = 2*radius), `radial_segments`, `rings`.
- TorusMesh? use for shield rim; `inner_radius`, `outer_radius`, `rings`, `ring_segments`; orientation default around Y; shield disk facing Z? Torus lies in XZ plane; rotate x 90 to face +Z. Fine.
- PrismMesh for spear tip? use CylinderMesh top radius 0 with 4 sides.

Low-poly faceting: set `radial_segments` 6-8, `rings` 1-2; Box; smooth vs flat normals: `SurfaceTool` from primitives may have smooth normals; can set `st.set_smooth_group(-1)`? To get faceted low-poly, `st.set_smooth_group(-1)` before append? `append_from` copies normals; cylinder normals smooth. Could call `st.generate_normals()` after; default smooth groups? `generate_normals` uses smooth groups; set `st.set_smooth_group(-1)`? For each surface tool all parts; if we want flat, `generate_normals` with smooth group -1 computes flat. But setting -1 and generate normals may overwrite; good. However metals with flat facets look stylized; nice. Yet smooth cylinders more realistic. Map heroes likely smooth; use smooth normals from primitives for organic, flat boxes.

`SurfaceTool.append_from` copies normals from source; for cylinders with radial_segments 8, smooth normals; okay. Low-poly facets still visible via lighting. Use 10 segments for limbs, 12 for helmet; moderate.

Need add **contact shadow blob**? Game likely has shadows via directional light; preview ground receives shadows if light shadows enabled. `MapVisuals.setup_environment` only env; `MapVisuals` maybe adds light separately? Search setup lighting.

content.arguments:
{"file_path":"C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king\scripts\entities\MinionModel.gd","content":"class_name MinionModel
extends RefCounted
## 程序化小兵模型（候选版，暂未接入）
## 风格：低多边形东方古风甲士，钢/青铜/皮革+队伍色布甲，贴合地图的写实偏冷色调。

const SUPPORTED := ["melee", "ranged", "siege", "super"]
const TEAM_CLOTH := [Color(0.16, 0.62, 0.74), Color(0.76, 0.20, 0.16)]
const TARGET_H := {"melee": 1.30, "ranged": 1.30, "siege": 1.30, "super": 1.95}


static func is_supported(kind: String) -> bool:
	return kind in SUPPORTED


static func target_height(kind: String) -> float:
	return float(TARGET_H.get(kind, 1.30))


static func build(kind: String, team: int) -> Node3D:
	var root := Node3D.new()
	var mats := _materials(team)
	var sts: Dictionary = {}
	match kind:
		"melee":
			_body(sts, mats, false)
			_arms_melee(sts, mats)
		"ranged":
			_body(sts, mats, false)
			_arms_bow(sts, mats)
		"siege":
			_siege(sts, mats)
		"super":
			_body(sts, mats, true)
			_arms_halberd(sts, mats)
			_heavy_crest(sts, mats)
		_:
			_body(sts, mats, false)
			_arms_melee(sts, mats)
	var mesh := _commit(sts, mats)
	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
	mi.mesh = mesh
	root.add_child(mi)
	var h := mesh.get_aabb().size.y
	if h > 0.01:
		var s := target_height(kind) / h
		root.scale = Vector3(s, s, s)
	root.set_meta("minion_model_kind", kind)
	root.set_meta("tint_strength", 0.35)
	return root


# ==================== 材质 ====================

static func _materials(team: int) -> Dictionary:
	var cloth: Color = TEAM_CLOTH[1] if team == 1 else TEAM_CLOTH[0]
	return {
		"steel": _mat(Color(0.42, 0.45, 0.49), 0.62, 0.42),
		"dark": _mat(Color(0.15, 0.16, 0.18), 0.45, 0.55),
		"bronze": _mat(Color(0.60, 0.43, 0.22), 0.64, 0.38),
		"gold": _mat(Color(0.86, 0.66, 0.28), 0.72, 0.30),
		"leather": _mat(Color(0.25, 0.17, 0.11), 0.05, 0.86),
		"wood": _mat(Color(0.29, 0.20, 0.11), 0.02, 0.90),
		"skin": _mat(Color(0.56, 0.41, 0.30), 0.0, 0.82),
		"cloth": _mat(cloth, 0.0, 0.88),
		"black": _mat(Color(0.045, 0.045, 0.05), 0.10, 0.72),
	}


static func _mat(c: Color, metallic: float, roughness: float) -> StandardMaterial3D:
	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	m.albedo_color = c
	m.metallic = metallic
	m.roughness = roughness
	return m


# ==================== 基础甲士 ====================

static func _body(sts: Dictionary, mats: Dictionary, heavy: bool) -> void:
	var w := 1.12 if heavy else 1.0
	var lx := 0.105 * w
	# 腿 / 靴
	for s in [-1.0, 1.0]:
		_box(sts, mats, "leather", Vector3(0.15 * w, 0.09, 0.25), Vector3(s * lx, 0.045, 0.035))
		_box(sts, mats, "bronze", Vector3(0.15 * w, 0.035, 0.07), Vector3(s * lx, 0.105, 0.135))
		_cyl(sts, mats, "steel", 0.052, 0.062, 0.29, Vector3(s * lx, 0.245, 0.005), 8)
		_sph(sts, mats, "steel", 0.068, Vector3(s * lx, 0.39, 0.005), 8, 4)
		_cyl(sts, mats, "dark", 0.066, 0.074, 0.18, Vector3(s * lx, 0.47, -0.005), 8)
	# 胯 / 腰甲
	_box(sts, mats, "dark", Vector3(0.27 * w, 0.14, 0.19), Vector3(0, 0.56, 0))
	_box(sts, mats, "bronze", Vector3(0.31 * w, 0.055, 0.205), Vector3(0, 0.615, 0))
	_box(sts, mats, "gold", Vector3(0.07, 0.045, 0.025), Vector3(0, 0.615, 0.108))
	# 队伍色内裙
	_box(sts, mats, "cloth", Vector3(0.23 * w, 0.24, 0.02), Vector3(0, 0.47, 0.075))
	# 甲裙板
	for s in [-1.0, 1.0]:
		_box(sts, mats, "steel", Vector3(0.10, 0.215, 0.03), Vector3(s * 0.055, 0.49, 0.105), Vector3(0, 0, s * 0.10))
		_box(sts, mats, "bronze", Vector3(0.085, 0.19, 0.03), Vector3(s * 0.145, 0.48, 0.075), Vector3(0, 0, s * 0.18))
		_box(sts, mats, "dark", Vector3(0.10, 0.20, 0.03), Vector3(s * 0.165, 0.48, -0.015), Vector3(0, s * 1.25, 0))
	# 躯干
	_box(sts, mats, "dark", Vector3(0.26 * w, 0.29, 0.16 * w), Vector3(0, 0.73, 0))
	# 胸前札甲：3 排 5 片
	for row in range(3):
		var y := 0.675 + float(row) * 0.072
		for i in range(5):
			var x := -0.12 + float(i) * 0.06
			var key := "steel" if (row + i) % 2 == 0 else "bronze"
			_box(sts, mats, key, Vector3(0.055, 0.062, 0.024), Vector3(x * w, y, 0.102))
	# 侧肋甲
	for s in [-1.0, 1.0]:
		_box(sts, mats, "steel", Vector3(0.035, 0.20, 0.15), Vector3(s * 0.148 * w, 0.73, 0.02), Vector3(0, s * 0.38, 0))
	# 胸甲上缘 / 护颈
	_box(sts, mats, "steel", Vector3(0.30 * w, 0.08, 0.20), Vector3(0, 0.855, 0))
	_box(sts, mats, "bronze", Vector3(0.20, 0.035, 0.17), Vector3(0, 0.90, 0))
	# 披风
	_box(sts, mats, "cloth", Vector3(0.25 * w, 0.36, 0.02), Vector3(0, 0.72, -0.12), Vector3(0.08, 0, 0))

static func _ensure(sts: Dictionary, mats: Dictionary, key: String) -> SurfaceTool:
	if not sts.has(key):
		var st := SurfaceTool.new()
		st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
		st.set_material(mats[key])
		sts[key] = st
	return sts[key]


static func _append(sts: Dictionary, mats: Dictionary, key: String, mesh: Mesh, xf: Transform3D) -> void:
	var st: SurfaceTool = _ensure(sts, mats, key)
	st.append_from(mesh, 0, xf)


static func _box(sts: Dictionary, mats: Dictionary, key: String, size: Vector3, pos: Vector3,
		rot := Vector3.ZERO) -> void:
	var m := BoxMesh.new()
	m.size = size
	_append(sts, mats, key, m, Transform3D(Basis.from_euler(rot), pos))


static func _cyl(sts: Dictionary, mats: Dictionary, key: String, r_top: float, r_bottom: float,
		h: float, pos: Vector3, seg := 10, rot := Vector3.ZERO) -> void:
	var m := CylinderMesh.new()
	m.top_radius = r_top
	m.bottom_radius = r_bottom
	m.height = h
	m.radial_segments = seg
	m.rings = 1
	_append(sts, mats, key, m, Transform3D(Basis.from_euler(rot), pos))


static func _sph(sts: Dictionary, mats: Dictionary, key: String, r: float, pos: Vector3,
		seg := 8, rings := 5) -> void:
	var m := SphereMesh.new()
	m.radius = r
	m.height = r * 2.0
	m.radial_segments = seg
	m.rings = rings
	_append(sts, mats, key, m, Transform3D(Basis.IDENTITY, pos))


static func _limb(sts: Dictionary, mats: Dictionary, key: String, r0: float, r1: float,
		a: Vector3, b: Vector3, seg := 8) -> void:
	var d := b - a
	var h := d.length()
	if h < 0.0001:
		return
	var dir := d / h
	var axis := Vector3.UP.cross(dir)
	var basis: Basis
	if axis.length() < 0.0001:
		basis = Basis.IDENTITY if dir.y > 0.0 else Basis(Vector3.RIGHT, PI)
	else:
		basis = Basis(axis.normalized(), Vector3.UP.angle_to(dir))
	var m := CylinderMesh.new()
	m.top_radius = r1
	m.bottom_radius = r0
	m.height = h
	m.radial_segments = seg
	m.rings = 1
	_append(sts, mats, key, m, Transform3D(basis, (a + b) * 0.5))


static func _commit(sts: Dictionary, mats: Dictionary) -> ArrayMesh:
	var mesh := ArrayMesh.new()
	for key in mats.keys():
		if sts.has(key):
			var st: SurfaceTool = sts[key]
			st.commit(mesh)
	return mesh

{"file_path":"C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king\scripts\entities\MinionModel.gd","content":"class_name MinionModel
extends RefCounted
## 程序化小兵模型（候选版，暂未接入）
## 风格：低多边形东方古风甲士，钢/青铜/皮革+队伍色布甲，贴合地图的写实偏冷色调。

const SUPPORTED := ["melee", "ranged", "siege", "super"]
const TEAM_CLOTH := [Color(0.16, 0.62, 0.74), Color(0.76, 0.20, 0.16)]
const TARGET_H := {"melee": 1.30, "ranged": 1.30, "siege": 1.30, "super": 1.95}


static func is_supported(kind: String) -> bool:
	return kind in SUPPORTED


static func target_height(kind: String) -> float:
	return float(TARGET_H.get(kind, 1.30))


static func build(kind: String, team: int) -> Node3D:
	var root := Node3D.new()
	var mats := _materials(team)
	var sts: Dictionary = {}
	match kind:
		"melee":
			_body(sts, mats, false)
			_arms_melee(sts, mats)
		"ranged":
			_body(sts, mats, false)
			_arms_bow(sts, mats)
		"siege":
			_siege(sts, mats)
		"super":
			_body(sts, mats, true)
			_arms_halberd(sts, mats)
			_heavy_crest(sts, mats)
		_:
			_body(sts, mats, false)
			_arms_melee(sts, mats)
	var mesh := _commit(sts, mats)
	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
	mi.mesh = mesh
	root.add_child(mi)
	var h := mesh.get_aabb().size.y
	if h > 0.01:
		var s := target_height(kind) / h
		root.scale = Vector3(s, s, s)
	root.set_meta("minion_model_kind", kind)
	root.set_meta("tint_strength", 0.35)
	return root


# ==================== 材质 ====================

static func _materials(team: int) -> Dictionary:
	var cloth: Color = TEAM_CLOTH[1] if team == 1 else TEAM_CLOTH[0]
	return {
		"steel": _mat(Color(0.42, 0.45, 0.49), 0.62, 0.42),
		"dark": _mat(Color(0.15, 0.16, 0.18), 0.45, 0.55),
		"bronze": _mat(Color(0.60, 0.43, 0.22), 0.64, 0.38),
		"gold": _mat(Color(0.86, 0.66, 0.28), 0.72, 0.30),
		"leather": _mat(Color(0.25, 0.17, 0.11), 0.05, 0.86),
		"wood": _mat(Color(0.29, 0.20, 0.11), 0.02, 0.90),
		"skin": _mat(Color(0.56, 0.41, 0.30), 0.0, 0.82),
		"cloth": _mat(cloth, 0.0, 0.88),
		"black": _mat(Color(0.045, 0.045, 0.05), 0.10, 0.72),
	}


static func _mat(c: Color, metallic: float, roughness: float) -> StandardMaterial3D:
	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	m.albedo_color = c
	m.metallic = metallic
	m.roughness = roughness
	return m


# ==================== 基础甲士 ====================

static func _body(sts: Dictionary, mats: Dictionary, heavy: bool) -> void:
	var w := 1.12 if heavy else 1.0
	var lx := 0.105 * w
	# 腿 / 靴
	for s in [-1.0, 1.0]:
		_box(sts, mats, "leather", Vector3(0.15 * w, 0.09, 0.25), Vector3(s * lx, 0.045, 0.035))
		_box(sts, mats, "bronze", Vector3(0.15 * w, 0.035, 0.07), Vector3(s * lx, 0.105, 0.135))
		_cyl(sts, mats, "steel", 0.052, 0.062, 0.29, Vector3(s * lx, 0.245, 0.005), 8)
		_sph(sts, mats, "steel", 0.068, Vector3(s * lx, 0.39, 0.005), 8, 4)
		_cyl(sts, mats, "dark", 0.066, 0.074, 0.18, Vector3(s * lx, 0.47, -0.005), 8)
	# 胯 / 腰甲
	_box(sts, mats, "dark", Vector3(0.27 * w, 0.14, 0.19), Vector3(0, 0.56, 0))
	_box(sts, mats, "bronze", Vector3(0.31 * w, 0.055, 0.205), Vector3(0, 0.615, 0))
	_box(sts, mats, "gold", Vector3(0.07, 0.045, 0.025), Vector3(0, 0.615, 0.108))
	# 队伍色内裙
	_box(sts, mats, "cloth", Vector3(0.23 * w, 0.24, 0.02), Vector3(0, 0.47, 0.075))
	# 甲裙板
	for s in [-1.0, 1.0]:
		_box(sts, mats, "steel", Vector3(0.10, 0.215, 0.03), Vector3(s * 0.055, 0.49, 0.105), Vector3(0, 0, s * 0.10))
		_box(sts, mats, "bronze", Vector3(0.085, 0.19, 0.03), Vector3(s * 0.145, 0.48, 0.075), Vector3(0, 0, s * 0.18))
		_box(sts, mats, "dark", Vector3(0.10, 0.20, 0.03), Vector3(s * 0.165, 0.48, -0.015), Vector3(0, s * 1.25, 0))
	# 躯干
	_box(sts, mats, "dark", Vector3(0.26 * w, 0.29, 0.16 * w), Vector3(0, 0.73, 0))
	# 胸前札甲：3 排 5 片
	for row in range(3):
		var y := 0.675 + float(row) * 0.072
		for i in range(5):
			var x := -0.12 + float(i) * 0.06
			var key := "steel" if (row + i) % 2 == 0 else "bronze"
			_box(sts, mats, key, Vector3(0.055, 0.062, 0.024), Vector3(x * w, y, 0.102))
	# 侧肋甲
	for s in [-1.0, 1.0]:
		_box(sts, mats, "steel", Vector3(0.035, 0.20, 0.15), Vector3(s * 0.148 * w, 0.73, 0.02), Vector3(0, s * 0.38, 0))
	# 胸甲上缘 / 护颈
	_box(sts, mats, "steel", Vector3(0.30 * w, 0.08, 0.20), Vector3(0, 0.855, 0))
	_box(sts, mats, "bronze", Vector3(0.20, 0.035, 0.17), Vector3(0, 0.90, 0))
	# 披风
	_box(sts, mats, "cloth", Vector3(0.25 * w, 0.36, 0.02), Vector3(0, 0.72, -0.12), Vector3(0.08, 0, 0))
	_box(sts, mats, "bronze", Vector3(0.25 * w, 0.025, 0.03), Vector3(0, 0.545, -0.12))
	# 肩甲：三层札片
	for s in [-1.0, 1.0]:
		for i in range(3):
			var key := "steel" if i % 2 == 0 else "bronze"
			_box(sts, mats, key, Vector3(0.17 - 0.02 * i, 0.045, 0.20 - 0.02 * i),
				Vector3(s * (0.20 + 0.012 * i) * w, 0.855 - 0.055 * i, 0),
				Vector3(0, 0, -s * (0.20 + 0.05 * i)))
	# 手臂（近战/远程共用肩到肘；小臂由各兵种补）
	for s in [-1.0, 1.0]:
		_limb(sts, mats, "leather", 0.057, 0.052,
			Vector3(s * 0.205 * w, 0.83, 0), Vector3(s * 0.245 * w, 0.68, 0.03), 8)
	# 颈 / 头
	_cyl(sts, mats, "skin", 0.052, 0.060, 0.09, Vector3(0, 0.915, 0), 8)
	_sph(sts, mats, "skin", 0.10, Vector3(0, 1.005, 0.005), 10, 6)
	_box(sts, mats, "skin", Vector3(0.13, 0.10, 0.025), Vector3(0, 1.00, 0.095))
	for s in [-1.0, 1.0]:
		_box(sts, mats, "black", Vector3(0.026, 0.016, 0.012), Vector3(s * 0.032, 1.015, 0.109))
	_box(sts, mats, "skin", Vector3(0.026, 0.032, 0.02), Vector3(0, 0.99, 0.114))
	# 头盔

# ==================== 几何工具 ====================

static func _ensure(sts: Dictionary, mats: Dictionary, key: String) -> SurfaceTool:
	if not sts.has(key):
		var st := SurfaceTool.new()
		st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
		st.set_material(mats[key])
		sts[key] = st
	return sts[key]


static func _append(sts: Dictionary, mats: Dictionary, key: String, mesh: Mesh, xf: Transform3D) -> void:
	var st: SurfaceTool = _ensure(sts, mats, key)
	st.append_from(mesh, 0, xf)


static func _box(sts: Dictionary, mats: Dictionary, key: String, size: Vector3, pos: Vector3,
		rot := Vector3.ZERO) -> void:
	var m := BoxMesh.new()
	m.size = size
	_append(sts, mats, key, m, Transform3D(Basis.from_euler(rot), pos))


static func _cyl(sts: Dictionary, mats: Dictionary, key: String, r_top: float, r_bottom: float,
		h: float, pos: Vector3, seg := 10, rot := Vector3.ZERO) -> void:
	var m := CylinderMesh.new()
	m.top_radius = r_top
	m.bottom_radius = r_bottom
	m.height = h
	m.radial_segments = seg
	m.rings = 1
	_append(sts, mats, key, m, Transform3D(Basis.from_euler(rot), pos))


static func _sph(sts: Dictionary, mats: Dictionary, key: String, r: float, pos: Vector3,
		seg := 8, rings := 5) -> void:
	var m := SphereMesh.new()
	m.radius = r
	m.height = r * 2.0
	m.radial_segments = seg
	m.rings = rings
	_append(sts, mats, key, m, Transform3D(Basis.IDENTITY, pos))


static func _limb(sts: Dictionary, mats: Dictionary, key: String, r0: float, r1: float,
		a: Vector3, b: Vector3, seg := 8) -> void:
	var d := b - a
	var h := d.length()
	if h < 0.0001:
		return
	var dir := d / h
	var axis := Vector3.UP.cross(dir)
	var basis: Basis
	if axis.length() < 0.0001:
		basis = Basis.IDENTITY if dir.y > 0.0 else Basis(Vector3.RIGHT, PI)
	else:
		basis = Basis(axis.normalized(), Vector3.UP.angle_to(dir))
	var m := CylinderMesh.new()
	m.top_radius = r1
	m.bottom_radius = r0
	m.height = h
	m.radial_segments = seg
	m.rings = 1
	_append(sts, mats, key, m, Transform3D(basis, (a + b) * 0.5))


static func _commit(sts: Dictionary, mats: Dictionary) -> ArrayMesh:
	var mesh := ArrayMesh.new()
	for key in mats.keys():
		if sts.has(key):
			var st: SurfaceTool = sts[key]
			st.commit(mesh)
	return mesh

static func _ensure(sts: Dictionary, mats: Dictionary, key: String) -> SurfaceTool:
	if not sts.has(key):
		var st := SurfaceTool.new()
		st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
		st.set_material(mats[key])
		sts[key] = st
	return sts[key]


static func _append(sts: Dictionary, mats: Dictionary, key: String, mesh: Mesh, xf: Transform3D) -> void:
	var st: SurfaceTool = _ensure(sts, mats, key)
	st.append_from(mesh, 0, xf)


static func _box(sts: Dictionary, mats: Dictionary, key: String, size: Vector3, pos: Vector3,
		rot := Vector3.ZERO) -> void:
	var m := BoxMesh.new()
	m.size = size
	_append(sts, mats, key, m, Transform3D(Basis.from_euler(rot), pos))


static func _cyl(sts: Dictionary, mats: Dictionary, key: String, r_top: float, r_bottom: float,
		h: float, pos: Vector3, seg := 10, rot := Vector3.ZERO) -> void:
	var m := CylinderMesh.new()
	m.top_radius = r_top
	m.bottom_radius = r_bottom
	m.height = h
	m.radial_segments = seg
	m.rings = 1
	_append(sts, mats, key, m, Transform3D(Basis.from_euler(rot), pos))


static func _sph(sts: Dictionary, mats: Dictionary, key: String, r: float, pos: Vector3,
		seg := 8, rings := 5) -> void:
	var m := SphereMesh.new()
	m.radius = r
	m.height = r * 2.0
	m.radial_segments = seg
	m.rings = rings
	_append(sts, mats, key, m, Transform3D(Basis.IDENTITY, pos))


static func _limb(sts: Dictionary, mats: Dictionary, key: String, r0: float, r1: float,
		a: Vector3, b: Vector3, seg := 8) -> void:
	var d := b - a
	var h := d.length()
	if h < 0.0001:
		return
	var dir := d / h
	var axis := Vector3.UP.cross(dir)
	var basis: Basis
	if axis.length() < 0.0001:
		basis = Basis.IDENTITY if dir.y > 0.0 else Basis(Vector3.RIGHT, PI)
	else:
		basis = Basis(axis.normalized(), Vector3.UP.angle_to(dir))
	var m := CylinderMesh.new()
	m.top_radius = r1
	m.bottom_radius = r0
	m.height = h
	m.radial_segments = seg
	m.rings = 1
	_append(sts, mats, key, m, Transform3D(basis, (a + b) * 0.5))


static func _commit(sts: Dictionary, mats: Dictionary) -> ArrayMesh:
	var mesh := ArrayMesh.new()
	for key in mats.keys():
		if sts.has(key):
			var st: SurfaceTool = sts[key]
			st.commit(mesh)
	return mesh

block.text:
Need check potential issues:
- `_cyl` rotation default Vector3.ZERO; fine.
- `_cyl` with `rot=Vector3(90,0,0)`: rotating cylinder axis Y by 90 around X -> axis Z; disk faces Z. Good.
- `_limb` segment with `basis`; cylinder top at b; okay.
- `_sph` no scaling.
- `_body` super heavy then scaled by target height; horns add height maybe 1.3; target 1.95 scaled. Fine.
- `_arms_halberd` halberd extends above head to 1.68, so AABB height 1.68; scaling target 1.95 => body smaller; super body ~1.3*1.16=1.5? Halberd top 1.68; scale 1.95/1.68=1.16; body 1.16? That makes super too short! For super, target height should be body, not weapon. We should not normalize by weapon AABB or build halberd shorter. Similarly melee sword tip 1.095 < plume 1.35; okay. Super halberd top 1.73 > plume; scaling to 1.95 yields body ~1.5 (super should 1.95). Need handle: for super use `target_height` 1.95 but scale from **body height** ~1.35, not AABB. Set `var h := 1.35` for super (or compute excluding weapon hard). Easier in build:
```
var h := mesh.get_aabb().size.y
if kind == "super": h = 1.36  # 体型按甲士本体
```
Then scale 1.95/1.36=1.43; halberd top 1.68*1.43=2.4m, taller than super but plausible weapon. Hmm target super body 1.95; weapon 2.4 tall okay. But AABB height 2.4; user may see huge weapon. Fine. For melee, plume 1.35; target 1.3 => scale .96; body ~1.3.
- For ranged, bow top .98, plume 1.35; fine.
- Siege banner top 1.25; target 1.3 => scale 1.04. Good.

Currently super scale = 1.95/1.68=1.16 → body 1.5; too short relative to other 1.3 (only 15% bigger; should 1.5x). Fix.

Also heavy body `w=1.12` small; okay.

- In `_arms_bow`, bow arrow shaft from x -.10 to .29 at y.71,z.295; passes through right hand and body? It's in front z .295; okay.
- Bow string `_limb p0,p4`: vertical line at z .16 (behind bow tips? tips z .16, curve forward .295). Good.
- `_cyl` for arrowhead rotated z -90: cylinder axis Y rotated Z -90 → axis X; position x .315; cone points? top/bottom; fine.
- Siege wheels: cylinder with rot Vector3(0,0,90) rotates Y axis to -X; disk plane YZ; good. Wheel center x ±.47; width .075 along X; body width .72; wheels outside.
- spokes: box long Y at wheel center rotated X by k*30; boxes length .50 along Y, rotate around X in YZ wheel plane. good.
- Torus absent.
- Siege front shield at z .51; arrow extends to z .94; okay.
- `_siege` root height banner 1.25; target 1.3.
- Team tint on all; siege cloth flag vivid.

- `SurfaceTool.commit(mesh)` multiple surfaces: material set. Need `st.index()`? no.
- `append_from` with Transform3D basis possibly `Basis.from_euler(rot)` uses radians? Godot `Basis.from_euler(euler: Vector3, order=...)` expects **radians**! Wait Godot 4 `Basis.from_euler(euler, order=EULER_ORDER_YXZ)` docs: euler angles in radians. `Vector3(90,0,0)` would be 90 radians, not degrees! Need convert to radians. In our `_box`/`_cyl`, rot passed as degrees (90, 30, etc.). Must multiply by `PI/180`. `Basis.from_euler(rot * DEG2RAD)` or `Vector3(deg_to_rad(...))`. Fix.

In `_body`, rotations like Vector3(-0.18,0,0) are radians? I wrote small values intended radians/angles; for plume I passed `Vector3(-0.18,0,0)` maybe intended degrees -10°, but using convert would -0.18° negligible; no big. For rotations like `Vector3(0, s*1.25, 0)` intended ~72°, currently 1.25 radians = 71.6° if we remove conversion? Hmm mixed.

Need define rotation parameters consistently in **degrees**, and convert. Replace all small rad values:
- `_body` skirt side plate `Vector3(0, s*1.25, 0)` intended 90°? I wrote 1.25 rad ~72°, maybe use degrees 72.
- shoulder `Vector3(0,0,-s*(0.20+0.05*i))` intended radians slope? In degrees that's ~13°; use degrees maybe 12+3i.
- chest side `Vector3(0,s*0.38,0)` ~22°; use degrees 22.
- cape `Vector3(0.08,0,0)` ~5°; use degrees 5.
- helmet plume `Vector3(-0.18,0,0)` ~-10°; use degrees -10.
- shield `Vector3(90,0,0)` degrees.
- flag etc no rotation.
- `_arms_bow` quiver `Vector3(-0.18,0,-0.25)` ~ -10°,-14°; use degrees.
- `_limb` no rotation.
- `_heavy_crest` horn `Vector3(0,0,s*60)` degrees; good.
- `_siege` wheel `Vector3(0,0,90)` degrees; spokes `Vector3(k*30,0,0)` degrees.
- `_body` tasset `Vector3(0,0,s*0.10)` ~6°; degrees.
- `_arms_melee` none.
So convert in `_box` and `_cyl`:
```
Basis.from_euler(rot * (PI/180.0))
```
and update small rad values to intended degrees:
`0.10`→6; `0.18`→10; `1.25`→72; `0.38`→22; `0.20+0.05i`→(12+3i) maybe; `0.08`→5; `-0.18`→-10; quiver `(-10,0,-14)`; heavy cape 0.10→6.
Need edit those values.

But `Basis.from_euler` accepts Vector3 in radians; yes.

Alternatively helper `_basis_deg(rot)` convert.

Let's fix `_box` and `_cyl`, then adjust values.

class_name MapVisuals
extends RefCounted

## 王者峡谷地面视觉层（不改任何 gameplay 逻辑，只换材质/光照/装饰）
## 1. 程序化「布局贴图」：草地/土路/高地砖石/河道一次画好，所有地面平面共用同一张图、
##    按世界坐标采样 → 平面之间没有硬接缝（原先是纯色 PlaneMesh 拼硬边）
## 2. 噪声细节贴图 + 法线贴图：近看有材质层次，不再像塑料板
## 3. 环境：天空盒 + 天空环境光 + ACES 色调映射 + 深度雾 + 暖阳光/冷补光
## 4. 装饰：现成 glb（草/墙/罐）用 MultiMesh 批量铺，移动端友好
## 5. 河道水面 shader：波高场解析法线 + 菲涅尔天空反射 + 顺流闪点 + 贴岸泡沫；
##    两岸另有湿沙滩、半浸礁石、芦苇、睡莲（MultiMesh）
## 注意：project.godot 用 rendering_method="mobile"，SSAO/SSIL/体积雾不可用。

- Proposed unit2 (siege) weird: at top thin line, then a **horizontal bar** around rows 11-14, plus right blob; looks like cart with banner; might be okay but silhouette messy due adjacent super? Bbox 1253-1713 overlaps unit3 at 1740 (close but bboxes not overlap); ASCII unit2 includes right blob maybe flag. 
- Proposed unit3 super bbox starts y400 (top) and extends 489; super is 1.95m, expected top y~? camera; top y400 vs other 572, yes taller. Silhouette shows top detached blocks? Rows 0-11 show multiple disconnected shapes (horns? flag? halberd). Could be weapon/crest.

- Proposed models seem **legs absent** in ASCII: unit0 rows 24-29 solid blob to bottom; no separation between legs. Could be because legs are close/armor skirt covers; fine.
- Proposed melee body width 200px vs current 269; maybe too narrow but shield adds.

More concerning: unit0 proposed has **thin spike** at top center for 9 rows; could be plume made of 3 stacked boxes leaning back; from front it's a narrow column; looks like antenna, not a plume. The plume boxes: size (.035,.16,.05) at y1.27 etc, three stacked almost vertically with rotation -10°; from front narrow 3.5cm; should be a **crest** along Z (depth .05) not visible wide from front. That's fine, but 0.16 height each ×3 overlapping from y1.258 to1.42? They're stacked 0.012 apart, total top ~1.35; width .035, makes a thin pole. Better make plume a **team-colored crest fan** along Z with width .03 and depth .18, or a horsehair plume broader in X. Currently almost invisible. Could improve: add a **team-colored back banner/cape** visible; already cape behind (not visible front). Add a **tassel** on helmet side or a wider crest:
```
_box cloth size (.10,.03,.18) tilted? 
```
At gameplay distance team color may not read except shield emblem/skirt. Need stronger team identification.

- Team color accents: skirt cloth at front behind tassets, cape behind, helmet plume thin, shield emblem small, quiver fletching. From front, only small shield center and skirt sides. Could add **team-colored shoulder sash** diagonally across chest (visible) and **helmet plume** fan. Also **belt sash** team. This improves color and silhouette.

- Current minions are team tinted 0.5 heavily, very readable. New tint 0.30 and mostly steel; team colors may be too weak. But design goal fit map; need balance. Add more cloth.

Could increase tint to 0.4; team color reaches armor, but preserves some. Preview shows old proposed mean teal; maybe okay.

- Proposed models are **shorter/width** than current; current has big heads/accessories. Fine.

- Unit2 siege silhouette: weird floating horizontal bar; likely ballista bow arms/string; from front, cart should have wheels; ASCII rows 12-27 body, no distinct round wheels? Could be due front view: wheels plane vertical facing camera? Wheels at x ±.47, axes X, disk plane YZ; camera at +Z sees the **side of wheel** (thin .075 width) on left/right, not round; so wheels look like vertical slats. Current cannon-mobile has side profile; from front also thin. In game minions face movement direction (toward +Z); camera is isometric from +Z, so sees **back** of cart, not side; wheels edge-on. That's okay but silhouette less readable. Could rotate siege model 90° relative to movement (cannon faces forward; wheels sides); from behind you'd see flag and cart. Fine.

- Super silhouette top disconnected horns/halberd; okay.

Maybe the model looks acceptable; user judges.

But I worry it's **too crude** compared to current asset; user may reject. Could improve drastically with more deliberate design:
1. Add team-colored **sash across chest** and **helmet crest**.
2. Add **shield emblem** larger.

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os
FONT=r"C:\Windows\Fonts\msyh.ttc"; FONTB=r"C:\Windows\Fonts\msyhbd.ttc"
def f(sz,b=False):
    for p in ([FONTB] if b else [])+[FONT,r"C:\Windows\Fonts\simhei.ttf"]:
        if os.path.exists(p):
            try: return ImageFont.truetype(p,sz)
            except: pass
    return ImageFont.load_default()
# 1) close-up comparison
cur=Image.open('screenshots/minion_current_blue.png').convert('RGB').crop((120,390,2290,1020))
new=Image.open('screenshots/minion_proposed_blue.png').convert('RGB').crop((120,390,2290,1020))
W=1200; H=int(cur.height*W/cur.width)
cur=cur.resize((W,H),Image.LANCZOS); new=new.resize((W,H),Image.LANCZOS)
pad=28; top=108; bot=160; gap=30
cv=Image.new('RGB',(pad*2+W*2+gap,top+H+bot),(15,17,21)); d=ImageDraw.Draw(cv)
cv.paste(cur,(pad,top)); cv.paste(new,(pad+W+gap,top))
d.text((pad,20),"现役小兵模型",font=f(50,True),fill=(232,232,236))
d.text((pad+W+gap,20),"候选方案 · 古风甲士",font=f(50,True),fill=(110,220,250))
d.text((pad,74),"当前线上：Kenney 低多边形人物",font=f(26),fill=(170,175,185))
d.text((pad+W+gap,74),"程序化低多边形：札甲 / 钢盔 / 青铜饰边 / 队伍色绶带与盔缨",font=f(26),fill=(170,205,220))
# 类型标签：close camera 投影 x 约 410,936,1464,1990，裁切起点 120，缩放
labels=["近战","远程","攻城车","超级兵"]; xs=[410,936,1464,1990]
for i,lab in enumerate(labels):
    sx=(xs[i]-120)*W/(2290-120)
    for x0 in [pad,pad+W+gap]:
        tw=d.textlength(lab,font=f(30,True))
        d.text((x0+sx-tw/2,top+H+20),lab,font=f(30,True),fill=(232,232,236))
d.text((pad,top+H+82),"同机位 / 同灯光 / 同地图地面；新模型降低全身队伍染色强度，保留金属与皮革材质层次。",font=f(25),fill=(165,170,180))
d.text((pad,top+H+120),"截图仅为候选方案，尚未替换游戏内 Minion 模型。",font=f(25),fill=(165,170,180))
cv.save('screenshots/minion_compare.png')
# 2) wide lineup
wide=Image.open('screenshots/minion_proposed.png').convert('RGB')
cw=2400; ch=wide.height+130
cv2=Image.new('RGB',(cw,ch),(15,17,21)); d2=ImageDraw.Draw(cv2)
cv2.paste(wide,(0,54))
d2.text((36,12),"候选方案 · 双阵营实战视角（前排蓝方 / 后排红方）",font=f(34,True),fill=(232,232,236))
labels=["近战","远程","攻城车","超级兵"]; xs=[409,930,1470,1991]
for i,lab in enumerate(labels):
    tw=d2.textlength(lab,font=f(28,True))
    d2.text((xs[i]-tw/2,wide.height+70),lab,font=f(28,True),fill=(230,230,235))
cv2.save('screenshots/minion_lineup.png')
print('ok',cv.size,cv2.size)
'@ | & 'C:\Users\18749\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\python\python.exe' -","description":"Compose final comparison and lineup images"}

tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.
