tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

<path>C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king\scripts\entities\TurretMesh.gd</path>
<type>file</type>
<content>
1: extends RefCounted
2: ## 程序化防御塔模型（替换 model/turret/Turret.glb）：八角石塔 + 队伍色发光刻纹；
3: ## 水晶为十二角基座 + 立柱 + 悬浮晶核。主机与联机客户端共用同一套构建函数。
4: ## 尺寸对齐旧模型：普通塔 ≈2.2 宽 × 3.5 高，水晶 ≈3.0 宽 × 4.2 高（塔口 y≈2.0 / 3.0）。
5: 
6: const DecorMesh = preload("res://scripts/entities/DecorMesh.gd")
7: 
8: static var _accent_mats: Dictionary = {}
9: static var _crystal_mats: Dictionary = {}
10: 
11: static func team_color(team: int) -> Color:
12: 	return Color(1.0, 0.32, 0.24) if team == 1 else Color(0.26, 0.58, 1.0)
13: 
14: static func accent_material(team: int) -> StandardMaterial3D:
15: 	if _accent_mats.has(team):
16: 		return _accent_mats[team]
17: 	var c: Color = team_color(team)
18: 	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
19: 	m.albedo_color = Color(c.r * 0.45, c.g * 0.45, c.b * 0.45, 1.0)
20: 	m.emission_enabled = true
21: 	m.emission = c
22: 	m.emission_energy_multiplier = 1.5
23: 	m.roughness = 0.35
24: 	m.metallic = 0.25
25: 	_accent_mats[team] = m
26: 	return m
27: 
28: static func crystal_material(team: int) -> StandardMaterial3D:
29: 	if _crystal_mats.has(team):
30: 		return _crystal_mats[team]
31: 	var c: Color = team_color(team)
32: 	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
33: 	m.albedo_color = Color(c.r * 0.55, c.g * 0.55, c.b * 0.55, 1.0)
34: 	m.emission_enabled = true
35: 	m.emission = c
36: 	m.emission_energy_multiplier = 2.4
37: 	m.roughness = 0.12
38: 	m.metallic = 0.15
39: 	_crystal_mats[team] = m
40: 	return m
41: 
42: ## 构建一座塔的视觉节点（root 自带 "_fx_team_tint" 标记，阻止 UnitVisuals 二次染色）
43: static func visual(tier: String, team: int) -> Node3D:
44: 	var root := Node3D.new()
45: 	root.name = "TurretVisual"
46: 	root.set_meta("_fx_team_tint", true)
47: 	var stone := MeshInstance3D.new()
48: 	stone.name = "Stone"
49: 	stone.mesh = _build_crystal_stone() if tier == "crystal" else _build_tower_stone()
50: 	stone.material_override = DecorMesh.rock_material()
51: 	stone.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_ON
52: 	root.add_child(stone)
53: 	if tier == "crystal":
54: 		var pivot := Node3D.new()
55: 		pivot.name = "CrystalPivot"
56: 		pivot.position = Vector3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
57: 		root.add_child(pivot)
58: 		var body := MeshInstance3D.new()
59: 		body.name = "Crystal"
60: 		body.mesh = _octa(0.72, 2.70)
61: 		body.position = Vector3(0.0, 3.25, 0.0)
62: 		body.material_override = crystal_material(team)
63: 		body.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_ON
64: 		pivot.add_child(body)
65: 		var core := MeshInstance3D.new()
66: 		core.name = "Core"
67: 		core.mesh = _octa(0.34, 1.30)
68: 		core.position = Vector3(0.0, 3.25, 0.0)
69: 		core.material_override = accent_material(team)
70: 		pivot.add_child(core)
71: 		var ring := MeshInstance3D.new()
72: 		ring.name = "Ring"
73: 		ring.mesh = _torus(1.10, 0.055, 24, 6)
74: 		ring.position = Vector3(0.0, 2.05, 0.0)
75: 		ring.material_override = accent_material(team)
76: 		pivot.add_child(ring)
77: 		var halo := MeshInstance3D.new()
78: 		halo.name = "Halo"
79: 		halo.mesh = _torus(1.02, 0.07, 24, 6)
80: 		halo.position = Vector3(0.0, 1.32, 0.0)
81: 		halo.material_override = accent_material(team)
82: 		root.add_child(halo)
83: 	else:
84: 		var accent := MeshInstance3D.new()
85: 		accent.name = "Accent"
86: 		accent.mesh = _build_tower_accent()
87: 		accent.material_override = accent_material(team)
88: 		root.add_child(accent)
89: 	return root
90: 
91: # ==================== 普通塔 ====================
92: 
93: static func _build_tower_stone() -> ArrayMesh:
94: 	var st := SurfaceTool.new()
95: 	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
96: 	# 八角基座（两级台阶）
97: 	_put(st, _cyl(1.02, 1.12, 0.30, 8), Vector3(0.0, 0.15, 0.0))
98: 	_put(st, _cyl(0.96, 1.06, 0.22, 8), Vector3(0.0, 0.40, 0.0))
99: 	# 塔身（下粗上细）
100: 	_put(st, _cyl(0.68, 0.84, 1.00, 8), Vector3(0.0, 0.98, 0.0))
101: 	_put(st, _cyl(0.52, 0.66, 0.95, 8), Vector3(0.0, 2.02, 0.0))
102: 	# 四根竖向石肋（凿刻感）
103: 	var rib := BoxMesh.new()
104: 	rib.size = Vector3(0.13, 2.30, 0.15)
105: 	for i: int in range(4):
106: 		var a: float = TAU * float(i) / 4.0 + PI / 4.0
107: 		var b := Basis(Vector3.UP, a)
108: 		st.append_from(rib, 0, Transform3D(b, Vector3(cos(a) * 0.74, 1.42, sin(a) * 0.74)))
109: 	# 塔顶平台 + 雉堞
110: 	_put(st, _cyl(0.82, 0.58, 0.28, 8), Vector3(0.0, 2.74, 0.0))
111: 	var merlon := BoxMesh.new()
112: 	merlon.size = Vector3(0.22, 0.26, 0.16)
113: 	for i: int in range(8):
114: 		var a2: float = TAU * float(i) / 8.0
115: 		var b2 := Basis(Vector3.UP, -a2)
116: 		st.append_from(merlon, 0, Transform3D(b2, Vector3(cos(a2) * 0.66, 3.00, sin(a2) * 0.66)))
117: 	# 塔顶收分 + 基座碎石
118: 	_put(st, _cyl(0.26, 0.46, 0.22, 8), Vector3(0.0, 3.14, 0.0))
119: 	var rock := _rock()
120: 	for i: int in range(5):
121: 		var a3: float = TAU * float(i) / 5.0 + 0.7
122: 		var rr: float = 0.11 + 0.05 * fmod(float(i) * 0.37, 1.0)
123: 		st.append_from(rock, 0, Transform3D(Basis().scaled(Vector3(rr, rr * 0.7, rr)),
124: 			Vector3(cos(a3) * 1.16, rr * 0.5, sin(a3) * 1.16)))
125: 	st.append_from(_disc(1.22, 0.06, 10), 0, Transform3D(Basis(), Vector3(0.0, 0.03, 0.0)))
126: 	return st.commit()
127: 
128: static func _build_tower_accent() -> ArrayMesh:
129: 	var st := SurfaceTool.new()
130: 	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
131: 	# 两道发光石带
132: 	_put(st, _cyl(0.73, 0.73, 0.10, 8), Vector3(0.0, 1.52, 0.0))
133: 	_put(st, _cyl(0.57, 0.57, 0.09, 8), Vector3(0.0, 2.52, 0.0))
134: 	# 塔顶尖晶
135: 	st.append_from(_sphere(0.17), 0, Transform3D(Basis(), Vector3(0.0, 3.40, 0.0)))
136: 	return st.commit()
137: 
138: # ==================== 水晶 ====================
139: 
140: static func _build_crystal_stone() -> ArrayMesh:
141: 	var st := SurfaceTool.new()
142: 	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
143: 	# 十二角基座（三级）
144: 	_put(st, _cyl(1.24, 1.36, 0.40, 12), Vector3(0.0, 0.20, 0.0))
145: 	_put(st, _cyl(1.06, 1.16, 0.26, 12), Vector3(0.0, 0.53, 0.0))
146: 	_put(st, _cyl(1.04, 1.14, 0.55, 12), Vector3(0.0, 0.94, 0.0))
147: 	# 六根立柱
148: 	var pillar := BoxMesh.new()
149: 	pillar.size = Vector3(0.20, 1.15, 0.20)
150: 	for i: int in range(6):
151: 		var a: float = TAU * float(i) / 6.0 + PI / 6.0
152: 		var b := Basis(Vector3.UP, -a)
153: 		st.append_from(pillar, 0, Transform3D(b, Vector3(cos(a) * 0.93, 1.78, sin(a) * 0.93)))
154: 	# 中央石座
155: 	_put(st, _cyl(0.40, 0.64, 0.45, 8), Vector3(0.0, 1.38, 0.0))
156: 	# 基座碎石
157: 	var rock := _rock()
158: 	for i: int in range(6):
159: 		var a2: float = TAU * float(i) / 6.0 + 0.4
160: 		var rr: float = 0.12 + 0.05 * fmod(float(i) * 0.41, 1.0)
161: 		st.append_from(rock, 0, Transform3D(Basis().scaled(Vector3(rr, rr * 0.7, rr)),
162: 			Vector3(cos(a2) * 1.44, rr * 0.5, sin(a2) * 1.44)))
163: 	st.append_from(_disc(1.54, 0.07, 12), 0, Transform3D(Basis(), Vector3(0.0, 0.035, 0.0)))
164: 	return st.commit()
165: 
166: # ==================== 基础网格工具 ====================
167: 
168: static func _put(st: SurfaceTool, mesh: Mesh, pos: Vector3) -> void:
169: 	st.append_from(mesh, 0, Transform3D(Basis(), pos))
170: 
171: static func _cyl(top_r: float, bottom_r: float, height: float, segs: int) -> CylinderMesh:
172: 	var cm := CylinderMesh.new()
173: 	cm.top_radius = top_r
174: 	cm.bottom_radius = bottom_r
175: 	cm.height = height
176: 	cm.radial_segments = segs
177: 	return cm
178: 
179: static func _disc(radius: float, height: float, segs: int) -> CylinderMesh:
180: 	return _cyl(radius, radius * 1.06, height, segs)
181: 
182: static func _torus(inner_r: float, tube: float, rings: int, segs: int) -> TorusMesh:
183: 	var tm := TorusMesh.new()
184: 	tm.inner_radius = inner_r
185: 	tm.outer_radius = inner_r + tube * 2.0
186: 	tm.rings = rings
187: 	tm.ring_segments = segs
188: 	return tm
189: 
190: static func _sphere(radius: float) -> SphereMesh:
191: 	var sm := SphereMesh.new()
192: 	sm.radius = radius
193: 	sm.height = radius * 2.0
194: 	sm.radial_segments = 8
195: 	sm.rings = 4
196: 	return sm
197: 
198: static func _rock() -> SphereMesh:
199: 	var rm := SphereMesh.new()
200: 	rm.radius = 1.0
201: 	rm.height = 2.0
202: 	rm.radial_segments = 5
203: 	rm.rings = 3
204: 	return rm
205: 
206: ## 八面体（晶核）：半径 r、总高 h，平面着色
207: static func _octa(r: float, h: float) -> ArrayMesh:

func _ready() -> void:
	var bm = preload("res://scripts/core/BattleManager.gd").new()

	pick.tower_shield_active = true
	pick.tower_shield = pick.max_health * 0.5
	for i in range(20): await get_tree().process_frame
	if pivot:
		print("PIVOT_ROT=", pivot.rotation.y, " posy=", pivot.position.y)

	print("SHIELD=", shield, " children=", shield.get_child_count() if shield else -1)
	if shield:

		for c in shield.get_children(): print("  SHIELD_CHILD=", c.name, " aabb=", c.get_aabb() if c is MeshInstance3D else "-")
	bm.cam.current = true
	bm.cam.position = pick.global_position + Vector3(6.0, 4.0, 6.0)

	for i in range(6): await get_tree().process_frame
	await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
	get_viewport().get_texture().get_image().save_png("res://artifacts/tower_shield.png")
	get_tree().quit()

extends Node
func _ready() -> void:
	var world := Node3D.new()
	add_child(world)
	# 地面 + 环境光，方便观察实物护盾
	var ground := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var pm := PlaneMesh.new()
	pm.size = Vector2(40, 40)
	ground.mesh = pm
	var gm := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	gm.albedo_color = Color(0.20, 0.28, 0.18)
	gm.roughness = 1.0
	ground.material_override = gm
	world.add_child(ground)
	var sun := DirectionalLight3D.new()
	sun.rotation_degrees = Vector3(-48, -32, 0)
	sun.light_energy = 2.2
	world.add_child(sun)
	var we := WorldEnvironment.new()
	var env := Environment.new()
	env.background_mode = Environment.BG_COLOR
	env.background_color = Color(0.10, 0.14, 0.18)
	env.ambient_light_source = Environment.AMBIENT_SOURCE_COLOR
	env.ambient_light_color = Color(0.45, 0.55, 0.65)
	env.ambient_light_energy = 0.8
	we.environment = env
	world.add_child(we)
	var towers: Array = []
	for spec in [["outer", -3.2, 0], ["crystal", 3.4, 1]]:
		var t = Turret.new()
		t.team = 0
		t.display_name = str(spec[0])
		t.tower_type = str(spec[0])
		t.max_health = 8000.0

func _pack_unit(e: Node, type_code: int, extra = null) -> Array:
# 尾字段：extra(仅防御塔=被攻击标记 idx8) 之后恒接暗印摘要 lyf（idx8 或 idx9）——
# 客户端按 type+长度守卫读取（旧 host 无此字段则默认空）
var row := [_net_id_for(e), type_code, e.team, e.global_position.x, e.global_position.z, e.health, _maxhp_of(e), str(e.display_name)]
if extra != null:
row.append(extra)
row.append(_pack_lyf(e))
return row

# 李元芳暗印摘要：[[源英雄名, 层数, 预测实际伤害], …]（客户端血条黄段/层数文字 1:1 复刻主机）
func _pack_lyf(e: Node) -> Array:
var out: Array = []
if e.has_method("lyf_mark_summary"):
for m in e.lyf_mark_summary():
var src = m["source"]
out.append([str(src.display_name) if (src != null and is_instance_valid(src)) else "",
int(m["stacks"]), float(m["pred"])])
return out


# ---------- M4：静态地图布局（host 打包 / client 收到后供呈现层） ----------

{"command":"@'
extends Node
func _ready() -> void:
	var world := Node3D.new()
	add_child(world)
	var ground := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var pm := PlaneMesh.new()
	pm.size = Vector2(40, 40)
	ground.mesh = pm
	var gm := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	gm.albedo_color = Color(0.20, 0.28, 0.18)
	gm.roughness = 1.0
	ground.material_override = gm
	world.add_child(ground)
	var sun := DirectionalLight3D.new()
	sun.rotation_degrees = Vector3(-48, -32, 0)
	sun.light_energy = 2.2
	world.add_child(sun)
	var we := WorldEnvironment.new()
	var env := Environment.new()
	env.background_mode = Environment.BG_COLOR
	env.background_color = Color(0.10, 0.14, 0.18)
	env.ambient_light_source = Environment.AMBIENT_SOURCE_COLOR
	env.ambient_light_color = Color(0.45, 0.55, 0.65)
	env.ambient_light_energy = 0.8
	we.environment = env
	world.add_child(we)
	var towers: Array = []
	for spec in [["outer", -3.4, 0], ["crystal", 3.6, 1]]:
		var t = Turret.new()
		t.team = 0
		t.display_name = str(spec[0])
		t.tower_type = str(spec[0])
		t.max_health = 8000.0
		t.health = 8000.0
		t.attack_range = 890.0
		t.position = Vector3(float(spec[1]), 0.0, float(spec[2]))
		world.add_child(t)
		towers.append(t)
	for i in range(12): await get_tree().process_frame
	for t in towers:
		t.tower_shield_active = true
		t.tower_shield = 4000.0
	for i in range(25): await get_tree().process_frame
	var cam := Camera3D.new()
	cam.fov = 55.0
	cam.position = Vector3(0.0, 6.2, 12.8)
	cam.look_at(Vector3(0.0, 2.4, 0.5))
	cam.current = true
	world.add_child(cam)
	for i in range(6): await get_tree().process_frame
	await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
	get_viewport().get_texture().get_image().save_png("res://artifacts/tower_shield.png")
	get_tree().quit()

func _refresh_owned_items():
if not shop_owned_container: return
for child in shop_owned_container.get_children(): child.queue_free()
var battle = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("battle_manager") as BattleManager
if not battle or not battle.hero: return
var hero = battle.hero
var rs := ui_scale()
var ids: Array = []
for id in hero.equipment_slots: ids.append(str(id))
for i in range(Hero.MAX_EQUIPMENT_SLOTS):
var has: bool = i < ids.size()
var btn := Button.new()
btn.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(46 * rs, 42 * rs)
btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", StyleBoxEmpty.new())
btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", UiKit.skin_chip(UiKit.C_GOLD, 0.5, 6))
btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", UiKit.skin_chip(UiKit.C_GOLD, 0.7, 6))
btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", StyleBoxEmpty.new())
var box := ItemIconBox.new()
box.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
box.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
if has:
var it = ItemDatabase.get_item(ids[i])
box.item_name = str(it.get("name", ids[i])) if not it.is_empty() else str(ids[i])
box.tier = int(it.get("tier", 1)) if not it.is_empty() else 1
btn.tooltip_text = box.item_name
btn.pressed.connect(_on_shop_item_selected.bind(ids[i]))
btn.add_child(box)
shop_owned_container.add_child(btn)

func _trigger_active_equip(hero: Hero, index: int):
var ae_list = _get_active_equip_list(hero)
if index >= ae_list.size(): return
var ae = ae_list[index]
if ae.cd_remaining > 0: return
var id = ae.id
if id == "golden_body":
if hero.golden_body_cd <= 0 and not hero.golden_body_active:
hero.golden_body_cd = 75.0
hero.golden_body_active = true
hero.golden_body_timer = 1.5
hero.wd_timer = 1.5
hero.stun_timer = 1.5
elif id == "shadow_dart":
hero.shadow_dart_cd = 60.0
hero.shadow_dart_active = true
var dur2 = 1.25 if hero.attack_range <= 400 else 2.5
hero.shadow_dart_timer = dur2
hero.shadow_dart_heal_tick = 0.0
hero.visible = false
hero.collision_layer = 0
hero.apply_move_pct_buff("ms_haste", dur2, 0.3)
elif id == "purify":
hero.purify_cd = 75.0
hero._apply_df_buff(0, 0.3, 3.0, false)
hero._apply_df_buff(0, 0.3, 3.0, true)
elif id == "sunspire_bow":
hero.sunspire_active_cd = 75.0
hero.sunspire_active = true
hero.sunspire_active_timer = 5.0
hero.apply_move_pct_buff("ms_haste", 5.0, 0.2)
if hero.attack_range > 500:
hero.multiply_attack_range_base(1.25)

# ---------- Buff 图标条 ----------
# 增益/减益 各占一个小图标，水平铺在屏幕底部中央：
# 图标 = 色环圆形 + 中央单字字形 + 剩余时间扇形遮罩（正上方顺时针覆盖“已流逝”部分，
#        剩余越少图标越暗）；点击图标弹出名称与效果说明，再次点击或效果结束自动关闭。
func _push_icon(cfgs: Array, key: String, glyph: String, tint: Color, bname: String,
desc: String, rem: float = 0.0, tot: float = 0.0, steady: bool = false, sub: String = ""):
cfgs.append({"key": key, "glyph": glyph, "tint": tint, "name": bname, "desc": desc,
"remaining": rem, "total": tot, "steady": steady, "sub": sub})

# —— Buff 图标池辅助：创建/复用节点，并记录到 cur ——
func _apply_buff_cfg(c: Dictionary, cur: Dictionary) -> void:
var key: String = c.key
var node = buff_icon_nodes.get(key)
if not node:
node = BuffIcon.new()
node.key = key
add_child(node)
buff_icon_nodes[key] = node

class ItemIconBox extends Control:
var item_name := ""
var tier := 1
var dim := false

func _ready() -> void:
mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE

func _draw() -> void:
var r := Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, size)
if item_name == "":
draw_style_box(UiKit.flat(0.5, 6, 1, Color(0.30, 0.36, 0.46, 0.5), Color(0.06, 0.07, 0.10, 0.55), 0.0, 0.0), r)
UiKit.text(self, Vector2(0.0, r.size.y * 0.5 + 6.0), "空", 13, Color(0.42, 0.48, 0.58),
HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, r.size.x)
return
UiKit.item_icon(self, r, tier, item_name)
if dim:
draw_rect(r, Color(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.5))

# ---------- 商店键位与购买反馈（P1） ----------
func _shop_handle_key(ev: InputEventKey) -> bool:
var kc: int = ev.keycode
match kc:
KEY_ESCAPE:
_close_shop()
return true
KEY_UP, KEY_W:
_shop_move_sel(-1)
return true
KEY_DOWN, KEY_S:
_shop_move_sel(1)
return true
KEY_ENTER, KEY_KP_ENTER:
if shop_selected_item != "":
_shop_quick_buy(shop_selected_item)
return true
var cats: Array = ["推荐"]
for k in _shop_categories().keys():
cats.append(str(k))
var idx := -1
match kc:
KEY_1: idx = 0
KEY_2: idx = 1
KEY_3: idx = 2
KEY_4: idx = 3
KEY_5: idx = 4
KEY_6: idx = 5
KEY_7: idx = 6
KEY_8: idx = 7
KEY_9: idx = 8
if idx >= 0 and idx < cats.size():
_on_category_selected(str(cats[idx]))
return true
return false

func _shop_move_sel(d: int) -> void:
if shop_grid_ids.is_empty():
return
var i: int = shop_grid_ids.find(shop_selected_item)
if i < 0:
i = 0
else:
i = clampi(i + d, 0, shop_grid_ids.size() - 1)
_on_shop_item_selected(str(shop_grid_ids[i]))
if shop_grid_scroll != null and shop_item_grid != null and i < shop_item_grid.get_child_count():
shop_grid_scroll.ensure_control_visible(shop_item_grid.get_child(i))

func _shop_missing_cost(missing: Array) -> int:
var s := 0
for rid in missing:
var it: Dictionary = ItemDatabase.get_item(str(rid))
if not it.is_empty():
s += int(it.get("cost", 0))
return s

## 一键买齐目标装备的直接素材（两轮：素材本身也可能由小件合成）
func _shop_buy_missing(target: String) -> void:
var battle = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("battle_manager") as BattleManager
if not battle or not battle.hero:
return
var hero = battle.hero

Need unique patterns per equipment. Could implement a new `ItemGlyph` system in UiKit:
- `item_icon(ci, rect, tier, item_name)` currently only name; add optional `item_id` parameter? Many call sites pass only name. Need unique by item_name; use name hash to select from a palette of procedural motifs, but requirement "每个装备专属设计一个图案" means each item should have a distinct pattern, not just category glyph. Could add optional `id` and use item metadata (category/cost/tier) plus name hash to draw unique static glyph. But all existing call sites pass name only; name is unique per item, so name hash sufficient. However visual designs should be meaningful, not random; we can design motifs based on **item category/name keywords** plus unique variation. There are ~many items (100+). "每个装备专属设计一个图案" impossible to hand-draw 100; procedural per-name unique designs acceptable if each differs. We can create an `ItemGlyph` drawer with:
  - 12-16 archetype motifs: sword, axe, bow, staff, book, robe, armor, shield, boots, ring, gem, orb, dagger, mask, cloak, potion, gauntlet, horn, banner, crystal, hammer, spear, scythe, totem.
  - Map each item name via keywords to archetype; for items with no keyword, hash selects among archetypes; plus **unique seed variations** (orientation, secondary ornaments, colors, motif details) so each item has a distinct pattern.
  - Draw all vector shapes with CanvasItem primitives: lines, polygons, circles, arcs, rects, rotated polygons.
  - Add a small **unique rune signature** derived from hash: 2-4 dots/lines in corners; ensures distinct even same archetype.
  - Maybe draw **item-specific color accent** based on category/tier; quality border.
- But "图案" likely icons; user wants equipment-specific icon instead of first Chinese char. We can deliver distinctive pictograms for each category and unique accents.

## Primary Request and Intent
- Earlier: generate new minion models fitting map; screenshots first, apply after confirmation.
- Then: `"可以，你还有主宰先锋的模型没有生成"` — minion direction approved, dragon vanguard needed.
- Then: `"接入吧，确保这些模型都有移动、攻击和死亡动画"` — integrate seven models with movement/attack/death animations.
- Then: `"请把对局界面UI的布局再调紧凑一点；目前AI的寻路指引感觉看起来和地图质感不是很搭，请你调整"` — compact battle HUD and restyle path guide.
- Then: `"请你优化游戏性能（主要针对新加的特效，让游戏不要太卡顿）"` — optimize VFX; completed.
- Then: `"手机端界面似乎有点问题，有些地方超出屏幕了"` — mobile UI overflow fixed.
- Then: `"手机端英雄选择界面也有越界问题；请把对局中英雄头像、技能图像、召唤师技能图像接入到英雄选择界面中"` — completed.
- Then: `"提高地图外周墙壁的质地，使它们看起来无缝结合"` — completed with continuous outer wall segments.
- Current: `"请实现：防御塔和水晶顶部的晶核需要不停地旋转；防御塔有护盾时，把这个护盾做出实物模型来"` — add continuous rotation for tower/crystal top cores and visible physical shield model for shielded towers.

## Key Technical Concepts
- Godot 4.7.2, GDScript, Forward Mobile renderer; no tests/CI; main scene `scenes/battle.tscn`.
- Engine binary: `D:\Downloads\06_游戏与Flash资源\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe`.
- Headless compile: `--headless --path . scenes/battle.tscn --quit-after 45`; same for `scenes/net_client.tscn`.
- `project.godot`: viewport 2400×1400, `stretch/mode="canvas_items"`, `stretch/aspect="expand"`, landscape mobile; phone 2340×1080 → virtual 3033×1400, `UiKit.scale()≈1.706`.
- `UiKit.scale()` = `maxf(1.0, viewport_width / 2400.0) * 1.35`; `UiKit.safe_top/bottom/left/right()` zero on desktop.
- HUD/hero-select mobile overflow fixes already verified at 2340×1080 and 1920×1080.
- `SelectArt.gd` inner classes `Avatar`, `SkillGlyph`, `SummonerGlyph`; no `class_name`, loaded via `const SelectArt = preload(...)`.
- `HeroArt.draw_portrait`, `SkillArt.draw_bg`, `IconArt.draw_icon`/`kind_for_summoner` reused by hero select.
- Outer perimeter wall: `DecorMesh.outer_wall_visual(length)` builds 2m flush stone segments; `Wall.outer/outer_len`; host and net payload extended with outer flag/length.
- `DecorMesh.rock_material` uses world-space procedural noise, so stone color is continuous across adjacent wall segments.
- `TurretMesh` currently builds normal tower static `Accent` top sphere and only crystal has `CrystalPivot`; `Turret.gd` rotates `_crystal_pivot` and bobs it.
- Tower shield is separate from base `GameEntity.shield_remaining`: fields `tower_shield`, `tower_shield_active`; triggered at HP 75/50/25%, shield = lost health, decays 2% max HP/sec, cleared after 4 min.
- Base `GameEntity._update_shield_visual()` only handles `shield_remaining`, not `tower_shield`; tower physical shield must be implemented in `Turret.gd`/`TurretMesh.gd`.

## Files and Code
- `scripts/entities/TurretMesh.gd`
  - `static func visual(tier, team)`; crystal branch creates `CrystalPivot` with `Crystal` octa, `Core`, `Ring`; normal branch creates static `Accent` via `_build_tower_accent()`.
  - `_octa(r,h)` at bottom; `_torus(...)`, `_cyl(...)`, `_put(...)` helpers.
  - Needed: remove normal tower's static top sphere from `_build_tower_accent`, add `CrystalPivot` + rotating octa core/shards for all non-crystal towers; add public `tower_shield_visual(team, is_crystal)` faceted transparent shield model with struts/rings/edge crystals and shield materials.
- `scripts/entities/Turret.gd`
  - `var _crystal_pivot`, `_crystal_t`; `_crystal_pivot = vis.get_node_or_null("CrystalPivot")` in `_create_visual()`.
  - `_process(delta)` currently rotates/bobs pivot only if non-null; extend to all turret types with differing spin speed.
  - Add `_tower_shield_vis`, `_shield_t`; `_update_tower_shield_visual(delta)` show/hide on `tower_shield_active && tower_shield>0 && health>0`, pulse/rotate, queue_free when off.
  - `_activate_tower_shield(stage)` sets `tower_shield`/`tower_shield_active`; add shield visibility naturally next frame.
  - `take_damage`/`_check_tower_shield_triggers` unchanged.
- `scripts/net/NetModels.gd`
  - `static func wall(hq, outer, outer_len)` updated for outer walls.
  - Add `static func tower_shield(team:int, crystal:bool)` delegating to `TurretMesh.tower_shield_visual`.
- `scripts/net/NetSession.gd`
  - `_collect_map_payload` wall entries now `[x,z,rot,is_hq,is_outer,outer_len]`.
  - Turret snapshot `_trow` currently ends: idx8 under-attack, idx9 lyf, idx10 ring state, idx11 tower_type; append idx12 shield_active (0/1), idx13 tower_shield amount.
- `scripts/net/NetClientBattle.gd`
  - Turret view built at `NET_TURRET` around line 1526; `model_ref = tm`; shield/rotation not handled.
  - Snapshot parse turret branch around line 604; add idx12/idx13 fields.

- `scripts/ui/SelectArt.gd`
  - Reusable hero avatar/skill/summoner icon Controls for hero-select.
- `scripts/core/BattleManager.gd` hero select:
  - New SelectArt integration, compact seat cards, safe-area margins; no overflow at phone resolutions.

## Errors and Fixes
- `SCRIPT ERROR: Parse Error: Identifier "SelectArt" not declared in the current scope.` → removed `class_name SelectArt`; use preload const in `BattleManager.gd` and `NetLobby.gd`.
- Hero-select vertical overflow: seats forced middle column ~1029 high, bottom ended y1445 > 1400; fixed by compact seat cards/inner margins/fonts and safe-area margins; probe now `SelectBottom` ends y1392; root min ~1262 at 3033×1400.
- Net select also fit: blocks top92, middle895, bottom361 ending1392 at 3033×1400; no offscreen.
- `read_image` unavailable (model no image input); use runtime geometry probes/screenshots/PIL analysis.
- Outer wall first design used 2.08m segments at 2.0m spacing → overlapping coplanar caps/top could z-fight; switched straight segments to exact 2.0m, and kept corner arcs/base ring/seam fillers old boulder style to avoid overlap artifacts.
- Deleted stale probe UID files `_dragon_inspect.gd.uid`, `_minion_host_test.gd.uid`.

- Implement normal tower rotating crystal core in `TurretMesh.visual` (all non-crystal tiers).
- Implement physical tower shield model and show/hide/pulse in host `Turret.gd`.
- Sync tower shield state to net clients and animate rotating cores + shield there.
- Verify host and net headless compile; run runtime probe/screenshot of a shielded tower and rotating core.
- Send required Windows notification before final delivery.
- Produce concise Chinese report.

- **省 token 的读法**：先用 grep/glob 定位，再带 offset/limit 定点读；禁止重复整文件读取或整文件回显；改动优先用 edit，不要重写大文件。
- **少开 agent**：默认由 Lead 单独完成。只有当任务可拆成互不依赖的大块、且并行确实更快时才用 teammates；subagent 的上下文同样是成本。
- **验证从简**：本项目无测试套件，只做必要的最小验证（如 GDScript 语法/加载检查），不跑完整试玩流程，除非任务明确要求。
- **输出精简**：结论先行，只列改动点与验证结果，不复述代码。
- **任务完成必须弹 Windows 通知**：每次交付结束前执行
  `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`
  （脚本已就绪，失败会静默降级，不阻断交付）。

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

</system-reminder>

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: schedule_create
tools.description: Create a reminder in the current session that delivers prompt when it becomes due. Supply exactly one timing parameter: after_seconds, at, every_seconds, daily, weekly, or cron. Local times that do not exist in the zone are skipped; repeated local times fire once, at the earlier instant. After downtime, a recurring reminder delivers only its latest missed occurrence. Delivery can repeat after a crash.

prompt.description: Reminder content to present when the target becomes due.

title.description: Concise task name in the user's language, at most 120 characters. Name only the core action and subject; keep essential target identifiers such as PR numbers and branch names. Do not include execution frequency (e.g. daily, hourly), scheduled dates/times, time zones, task status, or configuration and execution details (e.g. read-only mode, profile-tag filters), even when embedded in the requested or existing title. Do not append parenthetical notes. Put scheduling information in the timing parameters and execution instructions in prompt.

every_seconds.description: Fixed-rate interval in whole seconds, at least 60, aligned to the creation time; changing it with schedule_update re-aligns it to the save time.

daily.description: Every day at a local time.

time.description: HH:mm:ss with optional 1-3 fractional digits, for example 23:00:00.

time_zone.description: UTC or IANA Area/Location, for example Asia/Shanghai.

weekly.description: On the given weekdays at a local time.

time.description: HH:mm:ss with optional 1-3 fractional digits, for example 09:00:00.

time_zone.description: UTC or IANA Area/Location, for example Asia/Shanghai.

weekdays.description: ISO weekdays, Monday 1 through Sunday 7, without repetitions.

cron.description: Five-field Vixie cron expression in a time zone.

expression.description: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week, for example "*/15 9-17 * * 1-5". When both day fields are restricted, a date matches if either one matches.

time_zone.description: UTC or IANA Area/Location, for example Asia/Shanghai.

at.description: Absolute target: an RFC 3339 date-time with offset, or a local date, time, and IANA time_zone.

tools.description: Delete a reminder in the current session, active or inactive. Deletion does not retract a reminder message that is already queued.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

tools.description: Read the current working directory, or change it with cd. Relative paths use the current directory. Existing shells and running processes keep their own directories.

cd.description: Existing directory to enter. Omit to read the current directory.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

Design `ItemGlyph.gd` code. Must ensure no parse errors. Use static methods and inner class. In GDScript, `class Painter:` inside a `RefCounted` script; referencing its own type inside static method. Should be fine. Use typed `var p := Painter.new(...)`; inner class init.

Static `draw`:
```
static func draw(ci:CanvasItem, rect:Rect2, tier:int, qc:Color, item_name:String) -> void:
 if rect.size.x < 4 or rect.size.y < 4: return

 p.render()
```
`_bg_cache` in outer; static:
```
static func _bg(tier:int,qc:Color)->StyleBoxFlat:
 if _bg_cache.has(tier): return _bg_cache[tier]
 var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
 sb.bg_color = qc.darkened(0.74) ??? color alpha; stylebox bg color includes alpha; draw_style_box over UI dark.
 sb.border_color = qc.lightened(0.18)

 sb.content_margin? no.
 _bg_cache[tier]=sb
 return sb
```

	func _motif() -> String:
		var n := item_name
		if n.contains("镰"):

	func _has_any(n: String, parts: Array) -> bool:

## 程序化装备图案：每件装备按「名称关键词 → 造型原型」绘制矢量小图，

static var _bg_cache: Dictionary = {}

static func draw(ci: CanvasItem, rect: Rect2, tier: int, qc: Color, item_name: String) -> void:
	if ci == null or rect.size.x < 6.0 or rect.size.y < 6.0:
		return
	var p := Painter.new(ci, rect, tier, qc, item_name)
	p.render(_bg(tier, qc))

static func _bg(tier: int, qc: Color) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	if _bg_cache.has(tier):
		return _bg_cache[tier]
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = qc.darkened(0.76)
	sb.border_color = qc.lightened(0.18)
	sb.border_width_left = 2
	sb.border_width_top = 2
	sb.border_width_right = 2
	sb.border_width_bottom = 2
	sb.corner_radius_top_left = 9
	sb.corner_radius_top_right = 9
	sb.corner_radius_bottom_left = 9
	sb.corner_radius_bottom_right = 9
	sb.shadow_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.28)
	sb.shadow_size = 2
	_bg_cache[tier] = sb
	return sb


class Painter:
	var ci: CanvasItem
	var rect: Rect2
	var tier: int
	var qc: Color
	var item_name: String
	var seed: int
	var c: Vector2
	var u: float
	var metal := Color(0.80, 0.86, 0.93)
	var metal_hi := Color(0.96, 0.98, 1.0)
	var metal_dark := Color(0.38, 0.44, 0.53)
	var gold := Color(1.0, 0.80, 0.30)
	var gold_hi := Color(1.0, 0.94, 0.66)
	var wood := Color(0.52, 0.33, 0.19)
	var leather := Color(0.45, 0.27, 0.17)
	var ink := Color(0.02, 0.03, 0.05, 0.8)

	func _init(p_ci: CanvasItem, p_rect: Rect2, p_tier: int, p_qc: Color, p_name: String) -> void:
		ci = p_ci
		rect = p_rect
		tier = p_tier
		qc = p_qc
		item_name = p_name
		seed = absi(item_name.hash())
		c = rect.get_center()
		u = minf(rect.size.x, rect.size.y) / 64.0

	func render(bg: StyleBoxFlat) -> void:
		ci.draw_style_box(bg, rect)
		# 顶部冷光 + 底部暗角，让平面图标有厚度
		ci.draw_rect(Rect2(rect.position + Vector2(5.0, 2.0), Vector2(rect.size.x - 10.0, rect.size.y * 0.28)),
			Color(1, 1, 1, 0.035))
		ci.draw_circle(c, rect.size.y * 0.44, Color(qc.r, qc.g, qc.b, 0.10))
		# 背景中的专属星图（名称哈希决定位置）
		_stars()
		match _motif():
			"sword": _sword()
			"dagger": _dagger()
			"axe": _axe()
			"hammer": _hammer()
			"bow": _bow()
			"spear": _spear()
			"staff": _staff()
			"book": _book()
			"gem": _gem()
			"orb": _orb()
			"armor": _armor()
			"shield": _shield()
			"cloak": _cloak()
			"boots": _boots()
			"ring": _ring()
			"mask": _mask()
			"fist": _fist()
			"wing": _wing()
			"eye": _eye()
			"claw": _claw()
			"cup": _cup()
			"crown": _crown()
			"hourglass": _hourglass()
			"moon": _moon()
			"banner": _banner()
			_: _gem()
		# 边框刻痕：每件装备的 4 个位置由哈希决定，进一步区分同原型装备
		_marks()

	# ---------- 原型选择 ----------
	func _motif() -> String:
		var n := item_name
		if n.contains("镰"):
			return "scythe" if false else "scythe" if _has_any(n, ["镰"]) else "sword"
		if n.contains("弓") or n.contains("箭"):
			return "bow"
		if n.contains("斧"):
			return "axe"
		if n.contains("锤"):
			return "hammer"
		if n.contains("枪") or n.contains("矛"):
			return "spear"
		if n.contains("匕首"):
			return "dagger"
		if n.contains("拳") or n.contains("握"):
			return "fist"
		if n.contains("刀") or n.contains("剑") or n.contains("刃"):
			return "sword"
		if n.contains("杖") or n.contains("棒"):
			return "staff"
		if n.contains("书") or n.contains("典") or n.contains("页") or n.contains("录") or n.contains("学者"):
			return "book"
		if n.contains("盾") or n.contains("护"):
			return "shield"
		if n.contains("甲") or n.contains("铠") or n.contains("重装"):
			return "armor"
		if n.contains("袍") or n.contains("篷") or n.contains("披风") or n.contains("衣"):
			return "cloak"
		if n.contains("靴") or n.contains("足"):
			return "boots"
		if n.contains("戒") or n.contains("指环"):
			return "ring"
		if n.contains("面具") or n.contains("面罩"):
			return "mask"
		if n.contains("羽") or n.contains("翼"):
			return "wing"
		if n.contains("杯"):
			return "cup"
		if n.contains("眼"):
			return "eye"
		if n.contains("牙") or n.contains("爪"):
			return "claw"
		if n.contains("时"):
			return "hourglass"
		if n.contains("月"):
			return "moon"
		if n.contains("旗"):
			return "banner"
		if n.contains("冠"):
			return "crown"
		if n.contains("水晶") or n.contains("宝石") or n.contains("玛瑙") or n.contains("结晶") \
				or n.contains("珠") or n.contains("石") or n.contains("精") or n.contains("日") or n.contains("星"):
			return "gem"
		if n.contains("圣杯"):
			return "cup"
		var fallback := ["sword", "gem", "staff", "shield", "orb", "armor", "boots", "ring", "book", "hammer", "spear", "bow", "cloak", "mask"]
		return str(fallback[seed % fallback.size()])

	func _has_any(n: String, parts: Array) -> bool:
		for p in parts:
			if n.contains(str(p)):
				return true
		return false

	# ---------- 变体哈希 ----------
	func h(i: int) -> float:
		var x := fposmod(sin(float(seed) * 0.00013 + float(i) * 12.9898) * 43758.5453, 1.0)
		return x

	func tilt() -> float:
		return (h(1) - 0.5) * 0.5

	func _pt(x: float, y: float, ang: float = 0.0) -> Vector2:
		var v := Vector2(x, y)
		if absf(ang) > 0.0001:
			v = v.rotated(ang)
		return c + v * u

	func _poly(pts: Array, col: Color, ang := 0.0, outline := true) -> void:
		var pv := PackedVector2Array()
		for p in pts:
			pv.append(_pt(p.x, p.y, ang))
		ci.draw_colored_polygon(pv, col)
		if outline:
			var closed := PackedVector2Array()
			closed.append_array(pv)
			closed.append(pv[0])
			ci.draw_polyline(closed, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.42), maxf(1.0, u * 0.9), true)

	func _line(x0: float, y0: float, x1: float, y1: float, col: Color, w := 1.4, ang := 0.0) -> void:
		ci.draw_line(_pt(x0, y0, ang), _pt(x1, y1, ang), col, maxf(1.0, u * w), true)

	func _circle_at(x: float, y: float, r: float, col: Color, ang := 0.0) -> void:
		ci.draw_circle(_pt(x, y, ang), u * r, col)

	func _ring_at(x: float, y: float, r: float, col: Color, w := 1.4, ang := 0.0) -> void:
		var p := _pt(x, y, ang)
		ci.draw_arc(p, u * r, 0.0, TAU, 24, col, maxf(1.0, u * w), true)

	func _arc_at(x: float, y: float, r: float, a0: float, a1: float, col: Color, w := 1.4, ang := 0.0) -> void:
		var p := _pt(x, y, ang)
		ci.draw_arc(p, u * r, a0 + ang, a1 + ang, 24, col, maxf(1.0, u * w), true)

	func _rect_at(x: float, y: float, w: float, hgt: float, col: Color, ang := 0.0) -> void:
		_poly([Vector2(x, y), Vector2(x + w, y), Vector2(x + w, y + hgt), Vector2(x, y + hgt)], col, ang)

	func _stars() -> void:
		for i in range(4):
			var x := -27.0 + h(20 + i) * 54.0
			var y := -27.0 + h(30 + i) * 54.0
			ci.draw_circle(_pt(x, y), maxf(0.7, u * 0.75), Color(qc.r, qc.g, qc.b, 0.36))

				3:

{"file_path":"C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king\scripts\ui\ItemGlyph.gd","content":"extends RefCounted
## 程序化装备图案：每件装备按「名称关键词 → 造型原型」绘制矢量小图，
## 再用名称哈希做长度/角度/符文的唯一变体；替代原先的「名称首字」占位。
## 只画几何图形，不依赖任何贴图资源。

static var _bg_cache: Dictionary = {}

static func draw(ci: CanvasItem, rect: Rect2, tier: int, qc: Color, item_name: String) -> void:
	if ci == null or rect.size.x < 6.0 or rect.size.y < 6.0:
		return
	var p := Painter.new(ci, rect, tier, qc, item_name)
	p.render(_bg(tier, qc))

static func _bg(tier: int, qc: Color) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	if _bg_cache.has(tier):
		return _bg_cache[tier]
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = qc.darkened(0.76)
	sb.border_color = qc.lightened(0.18)
	sb.border_width_left = 2
	sb.border_width_top = 2
	sb.border_width_right = 2
	sb.border_width_bottom = 2
	sb.corner_radius_top_left = 9
	sb.corner_radius_top_right = 9
	sb.corner_radius_bottom_left = 9
	sb.corner_radius_bottom_right = 9
	sb.shadow_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.28)
	sb.shadow_size = 2
	_bg_cache[tier] = sb
	return sb


class Painter:
	var ci: CanvasItem
	var rect: Rect2
	var tier: int
	var qc: Color
	var item_name: String
	var seed: int
	var c: Vector2
	var u: float
	var metal := Color(0.80, 0.86, 0.93)
	var metal_hi := Color(0.96, 0.98, 1.0)
	var metal_dark := Color(0.38, 0.44, 0.53)
	var gold := Color(1.0, 0.80, 0.30)
	var gold_hi := Color(1.0, 0.94, 0.66)
	var wood := Color(0.52, 0.33, 0.19)
	var leather := Color(0.45, 0.27, 0.17)
	var ink := Color(0.02, 0.03, 0.05, 0.8)

	func _init(p_ci: CanvasItem, p_rect: Rect2, p_tier: int, p_qc: Color, p_name: String) -> void:
		ci = p_ci
		rect = p_rect
		tier = p_tier
		qc = p_qc
		item_name = p_name
		seed = absi(item_name.hash())
		c = rect.get_center()
		u = minf(rect.size.x, rect.size.y) / 64.0

	func render(bg: StyleBoxFlat) -> void:
		ci.draw_style_box(bg, rect)
		# 顶部冷光 + 底部暗角，让平面图标有厚度
		ci.draw_rect(Rect2(rect.position + Vector2(5.0, 2.0), Vector2(rect.size.x - 10.0, rect.size.y * 0.28)),
			Color(1, 1, 1, 0.035))
		ci.draw_circle(c, rect.size.y * 0.44, Color(qc.r, qc.g, qc.b, 0.10))
		# 背景中的专属星图（名称哈希决定位置）
		_stars()
		match _motif():
			"sword": _sword()
			"dagger": _dagger()
			"axe": _axe()
			"hammer": _hammer()
			"bow": _bow()
			"spear": _spear()
			"staff": _staff()

			_: _gem()
		# 边框刻痕：每件装备的 4 个位置由哈希决定，进一步区分同原型装备
		_marks()

	# ---------- 原型选择 ----------
	func _motif() -> String:
		var n := item_name
		if n.contains("镰"):
			return "scythe" if false else "scythe" if _has_any(n, ["镰"]) else "sword"
		if n.contains("弓") or n.contains("箭"):
			return "bow"
		if n.contains("斧"):
			return "axe"
		if n.contains("锤"):
			return "hammer"
		if n.contains("枪") or n.contains("矛"):
			return "spear"
		if n.contains("匕首"):
			return "dagger"
		if n.contains("拳") or n.contains("握"):
			return "fist"
		if n.contains("刀") or n.contains("剑") or n.contains("刃"):
			return "sword"
		if n.contains("杖") or n.contains("棒"):
			return "staff"
		if n.contains("书") or n.contains("典") or n.contains("页") or n.contains("录") or n.contains("学者"):
			return "book"
		if n.contains("盾") or n.contains("护"):
			return "shield"
		if n.contains("甲") or n.contains("铠") or n.contains("重装"):
			return "armor"
		if n.contains("袍") or n.contains("篷") or n.contains("披风") or n.contains("衣"):
			return "cloak"
		if n.contains("靴") or n.contains("足"):
			return "boots"
		if n.contains("戒") or n.contains("指环"):
			return "ring"
		if n.contains("面具") or n.contains("面罩"):
			return "mask"
		if n.contains("羽") or n.contains("翼"):
			return "wing"
		if n.contains("杯"):
			return "cup"
		if n.contains("眼"):
			return "eye"
		if n.contains("牙") or n.contains("爪"):
			return "claw"
		if n.contains("时"):
			return "hourglass"
		if n.contains("月"):
			return "moon"
		if n.contains("旗"):
			return "banner"
		if n.contains("冠"):
			return "crown"
		if n.contains("水晶") or n.contains("宝石") or n.contains("玛瑙") or n.contains("结晶") \
				or n.contains("珠") or n.contains("石") or n.contains("精") or n.contains("日") or n.contains("星"):
			return "gem"
		if n.contains("圣杯"):
			return "cup"
		var fallback := ["sword", "gem", "staff", "shield", "orb", "armor", "boots", "ring", "book", "hammer", "spear", "bow", "cloak", "mask"]
		return str(fallback[seed % fallback.size()])

	func _has_any(n: String, parts: Array) -> bool:
		for p in parts:
			if n.contains(str(p)):
				return true
		return false

	# ---------- 变体哈希 ----------
	func h(i: int) -> float:
		var x := fposmod(sin(float(seed) * 0.00013 + float(i) * 12.9898) * 43758.5453, 1.0)
		return x

	func tilt() -> float:
		return (h(1) - 0.5) * 0.5

	func _pt(x: float, y: float, ang: float = 0.0) -> Vector2:
		var v := Vector2(x, y)
		if absf(ang) > 0.0001:
			v = v.rotated(ang)
		return c + v * u

	func _poly(pts: Array, col: Color, ang := 0.0, outline := true) -> void:
		var pv := PackedVector2Array()
		for p in pts:
			pv.append(_pt(p.x, p.y, ang))
		ci.draw_colored_polygon(pv, col)
		if outline:
			var closed := PackedVector2Array()
			closed.append_array(pv)
			closed.append(pv[0])
			ci.draw_polyline(closed, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.42), maxf(1.0, u * 0.9), true)

	func _line(x0: float, y0: float, x1: float, y1: float, col: Color, w := 1.4, ang := 0.0) -> void:
		ci.draw_line(_pt(x0, y0, ang), _pt(x1, y1, ang), col, maxf(1.0, u * w), true)

	func _circle_at(x: float, y: float, r: float, col: Color, ang := 0.0) -> void:
		ci.draw_circle(_pt(x, y, ang), u * r, col)

	func _ring_at(x: float, y: float, r: float, col: Color, w := 1.4, ang := 0.0) -> void:
		var p := _pt(x, y, ang)
		ci.draw_arc(p, u * r, 0.0, TAU, 24, col, maxf(1.0, u * w), true)

	func _arc_at(x: float, y: float, r: float, a0: float, a1: float, col: Color, w := 1.4, ang := 0.0) -> void:
		var p := _pt(x, y, ang)
		ci.draw_arc(p, u * r, a0 + ang, a1 + ang, 24, col, maxf(1.0, u * w), true)

	func _rect_at(x: float, y: float, w: float, hgt: float, col: Color, ang := 0.0) -> void:
		_poly([Vector2(x, y), Vector2(x + w, y), Vector2(x + w, y + hgt), Vector2(x, y + hgt)], col, ang)

	func _stars() -> void:
		for i in range(4):
			var x := -27.0 + h(20 + i) * 54.0
			var y := -27.0 + h(30 + i) * 54.0
			ci.draw_circle(_pt(x, y), maxf(0.7, u * 0.75), Color(qc.r, qc.g, qc.b, 0.36))
		if h(40) > 0.45:
			ci.draw_line(_pt(-24.0, -18.0), _pt(-7.0, -24.0), Color(qc.r, qc.g, qc.b, 0.14), maxf(1.0, u * 0.55))

	func _marks() -> void:
		for i in range(4):
			var side := i % 4
			var t := h(50 + i)
			var col := qc.lightened(0.34)
			match side:
				0:
					ci.draw_line(_pt(-27.0 + t * 20.0, -27.0), _pt(-27.0 + t * 20.0 + 3.0, -23.5), col, maxf(1.0, u * 0.7))
				1:
					ci.draw_line(_pt(27.0 - t * 20.0, 27.0), _pt(27.0 - t * 20.0 - 3.0, 23.5), col, maxf(1.0, u * 0.7))
				2:
					ci.draw_circle(_pt(-27.0 + t * 54.0, 27.0), maxf(0.7, u * 0.6), col)
				3:
					ci.draw_circle(_pt(-27.0 + t * 54.0, -27.0), maxf(0.7, u * 0.6), col)

	# ---------- 造型 ----------
	func _sword() -> void:
		var a := tilt()
		var ln := 17.0 + h(2) * 8.0
		var wd := 2.0 + h(3) * 1.2
		_poly([Vector2(0, -ln), Vector2(wd, 7), Vector2(-wd, 7)], metal, a)
		_poly([Vector2(0, -ln), Vector2(-wd * 0.72, -ln * 0.45), Vector2(-wd, 7), Vector2(-wd * 0.2, 7)],
			metal_hi, a, false)
		_line(0, -ln * 0.92, 0, 5.5, metal_dark, 0.75, a)
		var gw := 6.5 + h(4) * 3.0
		_poly([Vector2(-gw, 7.5), Vector2(gw, 7.5), Vector2(gw * 0.8, 10.5), Vector2(-gw * 0.8, 10.5)], gold, a)
		_line(-gw, 9.0, gw, 9.0, gold_hi, 0.8, a)
		_poly([Vector2(-1.7, 10.5), Vector2(1.7, 10.5), Vector2(1.4, 18.0), Vector2(-1.4, 18.0)], leather, a)
		for i in range(3):
			_line(-1.6, 12.0 + i * 1.7, 1.6, 13.0 + i * 1.7, gold.darkened(0.15), 0.65, a)
		_circle_at(0, 19.0, 2.2 + h(5) * 1.0, gold, a)
		# 剑刃侧面的独特缺口/小三角
		if h(6) > 0.4:
			var yy := -ln * 0.30 - h(7) * 4.0
			_poly([Vector2(wd, yy), Vector2(wd + 2.2, yy + 1.8), Vector2(wd, yy + 3.6)], gold_hi, a, false)
		_line(-wd * 0.35, -ln * 0.65, wd * 0.2, -ln * 0.15, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.55), 0.6, a)

	func _dagger() -> void:
		var a := -0.35 + h(2) * 0.4
		for k in range(2):
			var side := 1.0 if k == 0 else -1.0
			var b := a + side * 0.25
			var ox := -4.0 if k == 0 else 4.0
			_poly([Vector2(ox, -15), Vector2(ox + 2.0, -12), Vector2(ox + 2.0, 12), Vector2(ox - 2.0, 12), Vector2(ox - 2.0, -12)], metal, b)
			_line(ox, -12, ox, 10, metal_dark, 0.6, b)
			_poly([Vector2(ox - 4.5, 7), Vector2(ox + 4.5, 7), Vector2(ox + 4.5, 9), Vector2(ox - 4.5, 9)], gold, b)
			_circle_at(ox, 13.0, 1.6, gold, b)

	func _gem() -> void:
		var r := 15.0 + h(2) * 5.0
		var a := h(3) * TAU
		var pts := [Vector2(0, -r), Vector2(r * 0.76, -r * 0.35), Vector2(r * 0.52, r * 0.75),
			Vector2(-r * 0.52, r * 0.75), Vector2(-r * 0.76, -r * 0.35)]
		_poly(pts, qc.lightened(0.08), a)
		for i in range(pts.size()):
			_poly([Vector2(0, 0), pts[i], pts[(i + 1) % pts.size()]],
				qc.lightened(0.30 if i % 2 == 0 else 0.04), a, false)
		_poly([Vector2(0, -r), Vector2(r * 0.40, -r * 0.25), Vector2(0, r * 0.18), Vector2(-r * 0.35, -r * 0.2)],
			Color(1, 1, 1, 0.35), a, false)
		_ring_at(0, 0, r + 4.0, gold, 1.0, a)
		for i in range(2):
			var ang := a + h(12 + i) * TAU
			_circle_at(cos(ang) * (r + 4.0), sin(ang) * (r + 4.0), 1.4, gold_hi)

{"command":"@'
extends Node
var bm: Node
func _ready() -> void:
	add_child(load("res://scenes/battle.tscn").instantiate())
	for i in range(12): await get_tree().process_frame
	bm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("battle_manager")
	bm._start_game_body("鲁班七号")
	for i in range(25): await get_tree().process_frame
	var hero = bm.hero
	hero.equipment_slots = ["iron_sword", "vampire_scythe", "storm_sword", "boots", "infinity_edge", "revive"]
	UiManager._open_shop()
	UiManager._refresh_shop_all()
	for i in range(20): await get_tree().process_frame
	var vp := get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
	print("VP=", vp, " scale=", UiKit.scale())
	print("TABS=", UiManager.shop_category_container.get_global_rect())
	print("GRID=", UiManager.shop_grid_scroll.get_global_rect())
	print("DETAIL=", UiManager.shop_detail_panel.get_global_rect())
	print("OWNED=", UiManager.shop_owned_container.get_global_rect())
	await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
	get_viewport().get_texture().get_image().save_png("res://artifacts/shop_panel_phone.png")
	print("SHOT")

{"command":"@'
extends Control
var shot := false
func _ready() -> void:
	size = Vector2(2400, 1400)
func _draw() -> void:
	var names: Array = []
	var by_name := {}
	for it in ItemDatabase.items.values():
		var nm := str(it.get("name", ""))
		if nm != "" and not by_name.has(nm):
			by_name[nm] = it
			names.append(nm)
	names.sort()
	for i in range(names.size()):
		var col := i % 12
		var row := int(i / 12)
		var x := 24.0 + col * 196.0
		var y := 18.0 + row * 132.0
		var nm2 := str(names[i])
		var it2: Dictionary = by_name[nm2]
		UiKit.item_icon(self, Rect2(x, y, 92.0, 92.0), int(it2.get("tier", 1)), nm2)
		UiKit.text(self, Vector2(x, y + 114.0), nm2, 15, Color(0.85, 0.9, 1.0), HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, 92.0)
	if not shot:
		shot = true
		await get_tree().process_frame
		await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
		get_viewport().get_texture().get_image().save_png("res://artifacts/item_glyph_atlas.png")
		print("ATLAS")
		get_tree().quit()

import re
from collections import defaultdict
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
txt = open('assets/ItemDatabase.gd', encoding='utf-8').read()
names = sorted(set(re.findall(r'"name"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"', txt)))
im = Image.open('artifacts/item_glyph_atlas.png').convert('RGB'); a = np.array(im); sx=im.size[0]/2400.0; sy=im.size[1]/1400.0
d=defaultdict(list)
for i,nm in enumerate(names):
    r,c=divmod(i,12); x0=int((24+c*196)*sx); y0=int((18+r*132)*sy); x1=int((24+c*196+92)*sx); y1=int((18+r*132+92)*sy)
    g=np.array(Image.fromarray(a[y0:y1,x0:x1]).convert('L').resize((9,8),Image.BILINEAR)).astype(int)
    dh=tuple(g[y,x]>g[y,x+1] for y in range(8) for x in range(8))
    d[dh].append(nm)
out=[v for v in d.values() if len(v)>1]
print('items',len(names),'unique',len(d),'dups',len(out))
open('_dup3.json','w',encoding='utf-8').write(__import__('json').dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False,indent=1))

{"command":"@'
extends Control
var shot := false
func _ready() -> void:
	size = Vector2(2400, 1400)
func _draw() -> void:
	var names: Array = []
	var by_name := {}
	for it in ItemDatabase.items.values():
		var nm := str(it.get("name", ""))
		if nm != "" and not by_name.has(nm):
			by_name[nm] = it
			names.append(nm)
	names.sort()
	for i in range(names.size()):
		var col := i % 12
		var row := int(i / 12)
		var x := 24.0 + col * 196.0
		var y := 18.0 + row * 132.0
		var nm2 := str(names[i])
		var it2: Dictionary = by_name[nm2]
		UiKit.item_icon(self, Rect2(x, y, 92.0, 92.0), int(it2.get("tier", 1)), nm2)
		UiKit.text(self, Vector2(x, y + 114.0), nm2, 15, Color(0.85, 0.9, 1.0), HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, 92.0)
	if not shot:
		shot = true
		await get_tree().process_frame
		await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
		get_viewport().get_texture().get_image().save_png("res://artifacts/item_glyph_atlas.png")
		print("ATLAS")
		get_tree().quit()

5: ##   我方英雄杀→我方声包（你击杀了一名敌人[本人]/一名敌人已被击杀[队友]），敌方英雄杀→敌方声包
6: ##   （你被击杀[本人阵亡]/敌方击杀了一名英雄[队友阵亡]）；连杀/累计击杀档按击杀方取 我方/敌方双版本。
7: ## 屏显文案不动（二连击破~五连绝世/大杀特杀~天下无双），音频就近映射到新包文件名。
8: ## 单声道抢占：同一条已在响则不再叠播；更高优先级打断低优先级（第一滴血/五杀/终结 > 连杀 >
9: ## 累计档 > 推塔/被摧毁 > 塔野杀 > 防御警报 > 单杀 > 开局）。
10: ## 延伸触发（六杀~十杀双视角走战报 desc；秀操作/团灭类由 host 模拟直接 play_announce 广播）：
11: ##   十杀>九杀>…>六杀（250~270）> 完美团战(我方团灭敌方)235 > 关键抢夺(抢龙/暴君,含敌方双版本)215
12: ##   > 团灭(我方被团灭)205 > 关键操作(群控≥3)170 > 漂亮的击杀(越塔/反杀/远程)150 > 漂亮辅助(救人)90。

14: ## 互不依赖网络；开局欢迎/准备/全军出击由 host BattleManager 用 announce_chain 触发并经广播

tools.name: ask_user_question
tools.description: Ask the user a concise question when you need confirmation, a choice, or missing information before proceeding.

questions.description: Questions to ask the user before continuing.

id.description: Stable id for this question; echoed in the answer.

question.description: The specific question to ask the user.

header.description: Optional short heading for the question, such as "Confirm" or "Choose Mode".

options.description: Optional choices to show the user. If you recommend one, put it first and append "(Recommended)" to that label.

description.description: One sentence explaining the tradeoff or impact.

multi_select.description: Whether the user may select more than one option. Defaults to false.

tools.name: create_goal
tools.description: Create a persisted goal that keeps this session working across automatic continuation rounds. Use it when the direct human request is a long-running objective, even if the user did not say "goal"; not for single-turn work.

objective.description: The concrete completion objective inferred from the direct human request.

max_goal_rounds.description: Optional positive safe-integer limit on automatic continuation rounds.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Edit an existing UTF-8 text file by replacing literal text.

file_path.description: Path to edit, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `old_string` and `new_string` in the arguments.

new_string.description: Literal replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the match.

replace_all.description: Replace all matches. Defaults to false; when false, old_string must appear exactly once.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: exit_plan_mode

plan.description: The complete plan, as markdown, starting with a # heading that names it.

tools.name: get_goal
tools.description: Read the current session goal, including the id and revision that update_goal requires.

tools.name: glob
tools.description: Find files, not directories, whose paths match a glob pattern, including hidden and ignored files. Returns up to 100 paths in modification-time order; a larger result keeps the first paths and reports where the complete list was saved.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match file paths against (e.g. "**/*.ts", "src/**/*.test.js"). A pattern with no "/" matches the basename at any depth, so "*" and "*.ts" both search the whole tree; include a separator to anchor the depth.

path.description: Directory to search in. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

tools.name: grep

pattern.description: Regular expression to search for (ripgrep syntax).

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

include.description: One glob filter for which files to search (e.g. "*.ts", "*.{js,jsx}"). Not a list; negation is not supported.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.
