## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

21: var _knob_pos := Vector2.ZERO

25: 
26: # 固定底座中心 = 控件中心（控件由 TouchController 锚定成以该中心为圆心的方形，
27: # 方形边长 = 2 * ACTIVATE_RADIUS，因此按下点只要落在激活圆内即可）
28: func get_home() -> Vector2:

37: 			if _active_touch == -1:
38: 				if event.position.distance_to(get_home()) < ACTIVATE_RADIUS:

## 固定式虚拟摇杆（移动端左下角移动区 / 桌面鼠标拖动）
## - 底座中心固定（在控件正中，控件被锚定到屏幕固定位置），不随按下位置跳变

##   （在激活半径之外的触摸不会抢占摇杆，可留给世界点击等）
## - 摇杆头绕固定中心移动、被限制在 MAX_RADIUS 内
## 语义：move_vector.y 正 = 屏幕向上（Godot 屏幕坐标 y 向下为正，这里已翻转）
const ACTIVATE_RADIUS := 300.0    # 摇杆激活半径：按下点须离中心小于此值（扩大为最初版）
const MAX_RADIUS := 120.0         # 摇杆头最大行程半径（虚拟分辨率单位）
var move_vector := Vector2.ZERO   # 归一化（-1..1），y 向上为正
# 固定底座中心 = 控件中心（控件由 TouchController 锚定成以该中心为圆心的方形，
# 方形边长 = 2 * ACTIVATE_RADIUS，因此按下点只要落在激活圆内即可）
elif event is InputEventMouseButton or event is InputEventMouseMotion:
# 移动端 emulate_mouse_from_touch 会产生合成鼠标事件，吞掉防止漏到世界输入
# 以固定中心为基准计算摇杆头位置与移动向量（拖出最大半径外则钳到边缘）
# 固定底座常显（统一玻璃底），提示玩家该位置可拖动

draw_arc(home, ACTIVATE_RADIUS, 0, TAU, 64, Color(UiKit.C_GLASS_HI.r, UiKit.C_GLASS_HI.g, UiKit.C_GLASS_HI.b, 0.16), 2.0, true)

1: class_name TouchActionButton
2: extends Control
3: const IconArt = preload("res://scripts/ui/IconArt.gd")
4: ## 移动端通用动作按钮（普攻 / 召唤师技能 / 回城 / 主动装备）
5: ## - emit_activated_on_press=true 时按下即触发一次（召唤师、回城、主动装）
6: ## - 否则仅维护按住状态（普攻），由外部读取 is_held()
7: 
8: signal activated()
9: signal held_changed(held: bool)
10: 
11: const SIZE_V := 90.0
12: 
13: var label_text := "攻"
14: var icon_kind := ""           # 非空时画程序化功能图标（推塔/小兵/回城…），不再画文字
15: var name_text := ""           # 图标按钮下方的名称条（推塔/小兵/回城）
16: var dimmed := false           # 图标压暗（不可用状态）
17: var label_font_size := 0.0     # 0=自动按半径缩放；>0=固定字号（用于升级“+”等需要更醒目字号的按钮）
18: var color := Color(0.85, 0.6, 0.15, 0.85)
19: var emit_activated_on_press := false
20: var hold_to_act := true        # true=按住持续有效（普攻），false=按下触发一次
21: var toggled := false           # 开关选中态（推塔/小兵等模式键）：外圈金环 + 金字高亮
22: 
23: var _active := false
24: var _active_touch := -1
25: 
26: func _ready():
27: 	mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
28: 	# 尺寸由调用方通过 _anchor_br 指定（普攻 150 / 主动装 100 / 升级 44 等）；
29: 	# 未显式设置时退回默认 90。
30: 	if size.x <= 0.0:
31: 		size = Vector2(SIZE_V, SIZE_V)
32: 		custom_minimum_size = Vector2(SIZE_V, SIZE_V)
33: 
34: func is_held() -> bool:
35: 	return _active
36: 
37: func _gui_input(event):
38: 	if event is InputEventScreenTouch:
39: 		if event.pressed:
40: 			if _active_touch == -1:
41: 				_active_touch = event.index
42: 				_active = true
43: 				if emit_activated_on_press:
44: 					activated.emit()
45: 				held_changed.emit(true)
46: 				queue_redraw()
47: 				accept_event()
48: 		else:
49: 			if event.index == _active_touch:
50: 				_active_touch = -1
51: 				_active = false
52: 				held_changed.emit(false)
53: 				queue_redraw()
54: 				accept_event()
55: 	elif event is InputEventScreenDrag:
56: 		# 拖出按钮一定距离视为取消
57: 		if event.index == _active_touch and not event.position.is_zero_approx():
58: 			var center := size * 0.5
59: 			if event.position.distance_to(center) > size.x * 0.9 and not hold_to_act:
60: 				_active_touch = -1
61: 				_active = false
62: 				held_changed.emit(false)
63: 				queue_redraw()
64: 				accept_event()
65: 	elif event is InputEventMouseButton or event is InputEventMouseMotion:
66: 		# 移动端 emulate_mouse_from_touch 会产生合成鼠标事件，吞掉防止漏到世界输入
67: 		accept_event()
68: 
69: func _draw():
70: 	var center := size * 0.5
71: 	var radius := minf(size.x, size.y) * 0.45
72: 	var base_col := color if _active else color.darkened(0.25)
73: 	draw_circle(center, radius + 5, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.35))
74: 	draw_arc(center, radius, 0, TAU, 32, base_col.lightened(0.3), 3.0, true)
75: 	draw_circle(center, radius, UiKit.C_GLASS)
76: 	# 开关选中态（推塔/小兵等模式键）：外圈金环 + 文字转金色
77: 	if toggled:
78: 		draw_arc(center, radius + 9, 0, TAU, 40, Color(1.0, 0.82, 0.25, 0.95), 4.0, true)
79: 	if icon_kind != "":
80: 		IconArt.draw_icon(self, center, radius * 0.98, icon_kind, dimmed)
81: 		_draw_name(center, radius)
82: 		return
83: 	var fs := int(label_font_size) if label_font_size > 0.0 else int(maxf(22.0, radius * 0.58))
84: 	# draw_string 的 pos.y 是基线；“+”字形重心在基线下方约 0.36em，
85: 	# 若沿用中心上方 0.4em 的基线会让加号偏出圆心上方，故对 “+” 单独下移基线使其落在圆心。
86: 	# （其他如“回城/血/装N”等 CJK 标签保持原位置，避免误动）
87: 	var baseline := center.y - fs * 0.4
88: 	if label_text == "+":
89: 		baseline = center.y + fs * 0.36
90: 	var tc := Color(1.0, 0.92, 0.5, 1.0) if toggled else Color.WHITE
91: 	draw_string(UiKit.font(), Vector2(center.x - radius, baseline), label_text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, radius * 2.0, fs, tc)
92: 
93: ## 图标按钮的名称条：按钮内侧底部圆角小条 + 描边白字
94: ## 几何与 SkillTouchButton 的 name_below 名称条完全一致（同样 220 尺寸的回城/恢复才能对齐）
95: func _draw_name(center: Vector2, radius: float) -> void:
96: 	if name_text == "":
97: 		return
98: 	var k := maxf(1.0, minf(size.x, size.y) / 110.0)
99: 	var band_h := 30.0 * k
100: 	var band := Rect2(center.x - radius * 0.92, center.y + radius - band_h + 2.0 * k,
101: 		radius * 1.84, band_h)
102: 	UiKit.chip(self, band, 0.74, 7.0 * k, color)
103: 	var cfs := int(18.0 * k)
104: 	var inner_w := band.size.x - 14.0 * k
105: 	while cfs > int(12.0 * k) and UiKit.font().get_string_size(
106: 			name_text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, -1, cfs).x > inner_w:
107: 		cfs -= 1
108: 	var tw := UiKit.font().get_string_size(name_text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, -1, cfs).x
109: 	UiKit.text(self, Vector2(band.position.x + 7.0 * k + (inner_w - tw) * 0.5,
110: 		band.position.y + band.size.y * 0.5 + cfs * 0.36), name_text, cfs, Color.WHITE)

(End of file - total 110 lines)
</content>

91: var _ui_theme: Theme

94: func _ready() -> void:
95: 	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
96: 	_ui_theme = load("res://assets/theme/ui_theme.tres")
97: 	# 项目 theme/custom_theme 在运行时不参与 Control 主题查找（实测 ThemeDB.get_project_theme() 为 null），

99: 	var st := get_tree()

104: func _on_node_added(node: Node) -> void:
105: 	if node is Control:
106: 		var c := node as Control
107: 		if c.theme == null:
108: 			c.theme = _ui_theme
109: 		if c is Button and not c.has_meta("_uikit_feel"):
110: 			c.set_meta("_uikit_feel", true)
111: 			c.resized.connect(func(): c.pivot_offset = c.size * 0.5)
112: 			c.button_down.connect(func(): punch(c))
113: 			# 全界面统一点击音（大厅/备战/商店/结算所有按钮，含键盘激活）
114: 			c.pressed.connect(func(): SfxManager.play_ui_sfx("ui_click"))

117: ## 全局字体：项目已通过 [gui] theme/custom_font 设置了默认字体，
118: ## 这里统一取默认主题字体，供 draw_string / draw_multiline_string 等自绘控件使用。
119: func font() -> Font:
120: 	var f := ThemeDB.get_default_theme().default_font
121: 	if f != null:
122: 		return f
123: 	return ThemeDB.fallback_font
124: 
125: ## 自绘文字描边宽度：随字号线性增长（旧实现无论多大都只有 1px，等于没有描边）
126: func outline_size(font_size: float) -> int:
127: 	return clampi(int(round(font_size * 0.14)), 2, 8)
128: 
129: ## 自绘字符串（带描边）：3D 场景上直接画白字会糊，统一走「深色描边 + 主色字」。
130: ## ci 为要绘制的 CanvasItem；其余参数与 draw_string 一致（align/width 可为 -1 左对齐）。
131: func text(ci: CanvasItem, pos: Vector2, txt: String, font_size: int, color: Color,
132: 		align := HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, width := -1.0) -> void:
133: 	if txt == "":
134: 		return
135: 	var f := font()
136: 	var o := float(outline_size(font_size))
137: 	var dark := Color(0, 0, 0, clampf(color.a, 0.55, 0.9))
138: 	ci.draw_string_outline(f, pos, txt, align, width, font_size, int(o), dark)
139: 	ci.draw_string(f, pos, txt, align, width, font_size, color)

142: ## —— 圆角胶囊 / 物品图标 / 推荐装备卡：战况带、技能名条、推荐位共用的绘制原语 ——
143: ## 圆角底 + 1px 冷边；accent 不透明时在左侧画一条竖色条（阵营/元素标识）
144: func chip(ci: CanvasItem, rect: Rect2, alpha := 0.86, radius := 14.0, accent := Color(0, 0, 0, 0)) -> void:
145: 	ci.draw_style_box(flat(alpha, int(radius), 1, C_PANEL_EDGE, Color(0, 0, 0, 0), 0.0, 6.0), rect)
146: 	if accent.a > 0.01:
147: 		ci.draw_rect(Rect2(rect.position + Vector2(5.0, rect.size.y * 0.26),
148: 			Vector2(3.0, rect.size.y * 0.48)), accent)

150: ## 物品图标位：品质色圆角底 + 每件装备专属的程序化几何图案。
151: func item_icon(ci: CanvasItem, rect: Rect2, tier: int, item_name: String) -> void:
152: 	var qc: Color = QUALITY_COLORS[clampi(tier, 1, 5)]
153: 	ItemGlyph.draw(ci, rect, tier, qc, item_name)
154: 
155: ## 推荐装备卡：品质图标 + 名称 + 状态行（可买/还差/槽满/已成型）+ 金币进度条
156: func rec_card(ci: CanvasItem, rect: Rect2, item_name: String, tier: int, cost: int, gold: int,
157: 		maxed: bool, slot_full: bool) -> void:
158: 	var can := cost > 0 and gold >= cost
159: 	var accent := C_GOLD if can else (C_DANGER if slot_full else C_PANEL_EDGE)
160: 	chip(ci, rect, 0.90, 14.0, accent)
161: 	var pad := 6.0
162: 	var ic := Rect2(rect.position + Vector2(pad, pad), Vector2(rect.size.y - pad * 2.0, rect.size.y - pad * 2.0))
163: 	item_icon(ci, ic, tier, item_name)
164: 	var tx := ic.position.x + ic.size.x + 10.0
165: 	var avail := rect.position.x + rect.size.x - tx - 8.0
166: 	var nm := item_name if item_name != "" else ("已成型" if maxed else "无推荐")
167: 	var fs := int(rect.size.y * 0.27)
168: 	ci.draw_string_outline(font(), Vector2(tx, rect.position.y + rect.size.y * 0.40), nm,
169: 		HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, avail, fs, 3, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.8))
170: 	ci.draw_string(font(), Vector2(tx, rect.position.y + rect.size.y * 0.40), nm,
171: 		HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, avail, fs, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.96))
172: 	var sub := "-"
173: 	if maxed: sub = "已成型"
174: 	elif cost > 0: sub = ("%d 金 · 可买" % cost) if can else ("还差 %d 金" % (cost - gold))
175: 	var sfs := int(rect.size.y * 0.20)
176: 	var sc := C_GOLD if can else (Color(1, 0.62, 0.35) if cost > 0 else Color(0.70, 0.72, 0.80))
177: 	ci.draw_string_outline(font(), Vector2(tx, rect.position.y + rect.size.y * 0.68), sub,
178: 		HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, avail, sfs, 2, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.8))
179: 	ci.draw_string(font(), Vector2(tx, rect.position.y + rect.size.y * 0.68), sub,
180: 		HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, avail, sfs, sc)
181: 	if slot_full and not maxed:
182: 		ci.draw_string(font(), Vector2(tx, rect.position.y + rect.size.y * 0.90), "槽满·需合成",
183: 			HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, avail, sfs, Color(1, 0.55, 0.35))
184: 	if cost > 0:
185: 		var pr := clampf(float(gold) / float(cost), 0.0, 1.0)
186: 		var bar := Rect2(rect.position + Vector2(pad, rect.size.y - 5.0),
187: 			Vector2(rect.size.x - pad * 2.0, 3.0))
188: 		ci.draw_rect(bar, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.12))
189: 		ci.draw_rect(Rect2(bar.position, Vector2(bar.size.x * pr, bar.size.y)),
190: 			C_GOLD if can else Color(1, 0.55, 0.25))
191: 
192: ## 统一 9-slice 面板底板（深色渐变 + 描边 + 顶部高光）。
193: ## alpha：整体透明度，替代原先的纯黑 StyleBoxFlat。
194: func panel_style(alpha: float = 0.94, pad: float = 10.0) -> StyleBoxTexture:
195: 	var sb := StyleBoxTexture.new()
196: 	sb.texture = PANEL_TEX
197: 	sb.texture_margin_left = 16.0
198: 	sb.texture_margin_top = 16.0
199: 	sb.texture_margin_right = 16.0
200: 	sb.texture_margin_bottom = 16.0
201: 	sb.modulate_color = Color(1, 1, 1, alpha)
202: 	sb.content_margin_left = pad
203: 	sb.content_margin_top = pad
204: 	sb.content_margin_right = pad
205: 	sb.content_margin_bottom = pad
206: 	return sb

208: 
209: ## 统一按钮底板（normal/hover/pressed/disabled 四态，9-slice）。
210: func button_style(state: String = "normal", alpha: float = 1.0) -> StyleBoxTexture:
211: 	var tex: Texture2D = BTN_TEX_NORMAL
212: 	match state:
213: 		"hover": tex = BTN_TEX_HOVER
214: 		"pressed": tex = BTN_TEX_PRESSED
215: 		"disabled": tex = BTN_TEX_DISABLED
216: 	var sb := StyleBoxTexture.new()
217: 	sb.texture = tex
218: 	sb.texture_margin_left = 16.0
219: 	sb.texture_margin_top = 16.0
220: 	sb.texture_margin_right = 16.0
221: 	sb.texture_margin_bottom = 16.0
222: 	sb.content_margin_left = 12.0
223: 	sb.content_margin_top = 8.0
224: 	sb.content_margin_right = 12.0
225: 	sb.content_margin_bottom = 8.0
226: 	sb.modulate_color = Color(1, 1, 1, alpha)
227: 	return sb
228: 
229: 
230: ## —— 统一扁平皮肤（P0）——
231: ## 卡片 / 芯片 / 标签 / 按钮 / 提示条一律走这里，避免各文件自建 StyleBoxFlat
232: ## 造成圆角、描边、内高光、选中发光不一致。
233: func flat(alpha: float = 0.92, radius: int = 12, border: int = 1,
234: 		edge: Color = C_PANEL_EDGE, bg: Color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0),
235: 		pad: float = 10.0, shadow: float = 0.0) -> StyleBoxFlat:
236: 	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
237: 	var base := C_PANEL_BG
238: 	base.a = alpha
239: 	sb.bg_color = base if bg.a <= 0.0 else bg
240: 	sb.set_corner_radius_all(radius)
241: 	sb.set_corner_detail(8)
242: 	sb.set_border_width_all(border)
243: 	sb.border_color = edge
244: 	sb.border_blend = true
245: 	sb.content_margin_left = pad
246: 	sb.content_margin_right = pad
247: 	sb.content_margin_top = pad * 0.6
248: 	sb.content_margin_bottom = pad * 0.6
249: 	if shadow > 0.0:
250: 		sb.shadow_size = int(shadow)
251: 		sb.shadow_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.45)
252: 	return sb
253: 
254: 
255: ## 卡片：品级/角色色描边；选中态加亮 + 同色外发光。
256: func skin_card(accent: Color, selected: bool = false, alpha: float = 0.92) -> StyleBoxFlat:
257: 	var edge := accent if selected else Color(accent.r, accent.g, accent.b, 0.32)
258: 	var sb := flat(alpha, 10, 2 if selected else 1, edge)
259: 	if selected:
260: 		sb.bg_color = sb.bg_color.lightened(0.06)
261: 		sb.shadow_size = 6
262: 		sb.shadow_color = Color(accent.r, accent.g, accent.b, 0.22)
263: 	return sb
264: 
265: 
266: ## 芯片/小面板：单个控件用的低对比底板。
267: func skin_chip(accent: Color = C_PANEL_EDGE, alpha: float = 0.9, radius: int = 10) -> StyleBoxFlat:
268: 	return flat(alpha, radius, 1, accent)
269: 
270: 
271: ## 标签/徽章：带淡色底的强调标签。
272: func skin_tag(accent: Color) -> StyleBoxFlat:
273: 	var sb := flat(0.95, 8, 1, accent)
274: 	sb.bg_color = Color(accent.r * 0.22, accent.g * 0.22, accent.b * 0.22, 0.95)
275: 	return sb
276: 
277: 
278: ## 按钮四态（filled=true 主行动键用实心强调色）。
279: ## 质感来自三层：底色明暗 + 外投影（hover 时为强调色辉光）+ 顶部 2px 高光位（上方 border 提亮）。
280: func skin_button(state: String = "normal", accent: Color = C_GOLD, filled: bool = false) -> StyleBoxFlat:
281: 	var a := 0.95
282: 	var edge := accent
283: 	var lift := 0.0
284: 	var shadow := 10.0
285: 	match state:
286: 		"hover":
287: 			a = 1.0
288: 			edge = accent.lightened(0.25)
289: 			lift = 0.09
290: 			shadow = 16.0
291: 		"pressed":
292: 			a = 0.9
293: 			lift = -0.06
294: 			shadow = 3.0
295: 		"disabled":
296: 			a = 0.5
297: 			edge = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.16)
298: 			shadow = 4.0
299: 	var sb := flat(a, 10, 1, edge, Color(0, 0, 0, 0), 10.0, shadow)
300: 	sb.shadow_offset = Vector2(0, 3)
301: 	sb.shadow_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.5)
302: 	if state != "disabled":
303: 		if filled:
304: 			var base := Color(accent.r, accent.g, accent.b, a)
305: 			sb.bg_color = base.lightened(lift)
306: 			sb.border_color = accent.lightened(0.35 + lift)
307: 		else:
308: 			var base := C_PANEL_BG
309: 			base.a = a
310: 			sb.bg_color = base.lightened(lift)
311: 			sb.border_color = edge
312: 	if state == "hover":
313: 		sb.shadow_color = Color(accent.r, accent.g, accent.b, 0.30)
314: 		sb.expand_margin_left = 2.0
315: 		sb.expand_margin_right = 2.0
316: 		sb.expand_margin_top = 2.0
317: 		sb.expand_margin_bottom = 2.0
318: 	return sb
319: 
320: 
321: ## 提示条 / 横幅：一侧强调色描边，用于战报、系统提示。
322: func skin_notice(accent: Color = C_GOLD) -> StyleBoxFlat:
323: 	return flat(0.92, 10, 1, Color(accent.r, accent.g, accent.b, 0.55), Color(0, 0, 0, 0), 10.0, 8.0)
324: 
325: 
326: const BACKDROP_SCRIPT := preload("res://scripts/ui/UiBackdrop.gd")
327: 
328: 
329: ## 给全屏 Control 铺一层程序化背景（置于最底层，自动铺满），返回背景节点。
330: func make_backdrop(parent: Control, accent: Color = C_TEAM0, glow: float = 1.0) -> Control:
331: 	if parent == null:
332: 		return null
333: 	var bd: Control = BACKDROP_SCRIPT.new()
334: 	bd.accent = accent
335: 	bd.glow_strength = glow
336: 	parent.add_child(bd)
337: 	bd.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
338: 	parent.move_child(bd, 0)
339: 	return bd
340: 
341: 
342: ## 把统一主题挂到某个 Control 上：definite 面板根节点用，子节点自动继承。
343: func apply_theme(control: Control) -> void:
344: 	if control != null and _ui_theme != null and control.theme == null:
345: 		control.theme = _ui_theme
346: 
347: 
348: ## —— 动效 ——
349: ## 面板打开：透明度 0→1（150ms 缓出），不改变布局与锚点。
350: func show_panel(control: Control, dur: float = 0.15) -> void:
351: 	if control == null or not is_instance_valid(control):
352: 		return
353: 	control.visible = true
354: 	control.modulate.a = 0.0
355: 	var tw := create_tween()
356: 	tw.tween_property(control, "modulate:a", 1.0, dur).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
357: 
358: 
359: ## 面板关闭：透明度 1→0 后隐藏（120ms 缓入）。
360: func hide_panel(control: Control, dur: float = 0.12) -> void:
361: 	if control == null or not is_instance_valid(control):
362: 		return
363: 	if not control.visible:
364: 		return
365: 	var tw := create_tween()
366: 	tw.tween_property(control, "modulate:a", 0.0, dur).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN)
367: 	tw.tween_callback(func(): if is_instance_valid(control): control.visible = false)
368: 
369: 
370: ## 按钮按下反馈：0.96 缩放回弹（pivot 居中），移动端附加轻震动。
371: func punch(control: Control, amount: float = 0.96, dur: float = 0.10) -> void:
372: 	if control == null or not is_instance_valid(control):
373: 		return
374: 	control.pivot_offset = control.size * 0.5
375: 	var tw := create_tween()
376: 	tw.tween_property(control, "scale", Vector2.ONE * amount, dur * 0.4).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
377: 	tw.tween_property(control, "scale", Vector2.ONE, dur * 0.6).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
378: 	haptic(10)
379: 
380: 
381: ## 轻震动（仅移动端，毫秒）。
382: func haptic(ms: int = 12) -> void:
383: 	if OS.has_feature("mobile"):
384: 		Input.vibrate_handheld(ms)
385: 
386: 
387: ## 与既有 UI_Manager.ui_scale() 完全一致的尺度（本批不改视觉，仅统一来源）。
388: func scale() -> float:
389: 	var vp := get_viewport()
390: 	if vp == null:
391: 		return SCALE_EXTRA
392: 	return maxf(1.0, vp.get_visible_rect().size.x / DESIGN_W) * SCALE_EXTRA
393: 
394: 
395: ## 安全区内缩（虚拟像素，Vector4: left/top/right/bottom）。
396: ## 仅在移动端生效；桌面返回全 0，避免 Windows 上 safe_area 是整块屏幕导致误缩。
397: func safe_insets() -> Vector4:
398: 	if not OS.has_feature("mobile"):
399: 		return Vector4.ZERO
400: 	var win := DisplayServer.window_get_size()
401: 	if win.x <= 0 or win.y <= 0:
402: 		return Vector4.ZERO
403: 	var sa := DisplayServer.get_display_safe_area()
404: 	if sa.size.x <= 0 or sa.size.y <= 0:
405: 		return Vector4.ZERO
406: 	var vp := get_viewport()
407: 	if vp == null:
408: 		return Vector4.ZERO
409: 	var vs := vp.get_visible_rect().size
410: 	var sx := vs.x / float(win.x)
411: 	var sy := vs.y / float(win.y)
412: 	return Vector4(
413: 		maxf(0.0, float(sa.position.x)) * sx,
414: 		maxf(0.0, float(sa.position.y)) * sy,
415: 		maxf(0.0, float(win.x - sa.position.x - sa.size.x)) * sx,
416: 		maxf(0.0, float(win.y - sa.position.y - sa.size.y)) * sy
417: 	)
418: 
419: 
420: func safe_top() -> float:
421: 	return safe_insets().y
422: 
423: 
424: func safe_bottom() -> float:
425: 	return safe_insets().w
426: 
427: 
428: func safe_left() -> float:
429: 	return safe_insets().x
430: 
431: 
432: func safe_right() -> float:
433: 	return safe_insets().z
434: 
435: 
436: ## 顶部锚定的控件统一避让刘海/挖孔：整体下移 + 高度不变。
437: func apply_safe_top(control: Control, extra: float = 0.0) -> void:
438: 	if control == null:
439: 		return
440: 	var inset := safe_top() + extra
441: 	if inset <= 0.0:
442: 		return
443: 	control.offset_top += inset
444: 	control.offset_bottom += inset
445: 
446: 
447: ## 底部锚定的控件统一避让手势条。
448: func apply_safe_bottom(control: Control, extra: float = 0.0) -> void:
449: 	if control == null:
450: 		return
451: 	var inset := safe_bottom() + extra
452: 	if inset <= 0.0:
453: 		return
454: 	control.offset_top -= inset
455: 	control.offset_bottom -= inset

lines.text: ## 全局 UI 设计令牌 + 共享工具（字体 / 尺度 / 安全区 / 层级 / 颜色 / 字号）。
## 目的：给 host、联机客户端、移动端自绘 HUD 一个统一来源，后续新 UI 不再各自硬编码。
# —— 设计画布（与 project.godot 的 2400x1400 一致）——

We have limited context? Need inspect skill button and remaining mobile files to understand current visual quality. User asks "按键系统和摇杆" likely expects mobile controls quality. Could focus on:
1. VirtualJoystick: premium multi-layer base/knob, press/return animation, on-release spring, directional glow, tick marks, haptic on activation (UiKit.haptic).
2. TouchActionButton: premium shell shared; pressed scale/depth, gradient rim, inner highlight, active glow; haptic.
3. SkillTouchButton: apply premium shell consistent; pressed feedback; maybe haptic? Skill buttons currently draw many overlays; adding shell helper.
4. AttackWheelButton and CancelCastButton: maybe apply shell too; user says 按键系统 broadly. Add consistent shell helper used across all circular touch controls.
5. MoveModeToggle rectangular button: maybe 9-slice style already; can add pressed feedback/punch.

Could create `UiKit.circle_button_base(ci, center, radius, accent, press, active, dim)` to draw:
- drop shadow (offset y)
- dark outer rim (multiple arcs)
- inner radial bands:
  - draw_circle(center+down, radius+? dark)
  - draw_circle(center, radius, base color)
  - draw_circle(center, radius*0.94, glass)
  - draw_circle(center, radius*0.82, highlight color with low alpha) - fake gradient ring
  - top gloss arc: draw_arc(center - up*radius*0.18, radius*0.78, PI*1.08, PI*1.92, ..., white alpha)
  - bottom rim highlight.
  - accent active ring outside; pulse.
- pressed: radius*0.98, center offset+2, shadow tighter, gloss brighter.
- Use `Color.lerp` for press.

But CanvasItem draw order in each class:
- `TouchActionButton._draw` base then icon/label/name.
- `SkillTouchButton._draw` base then icon etc. We can replace base section (lines154-160) with shared helper.
- `AttackWheelButton._draw` base lines103-110; replace.
- `CancelCastButton` base maybe custom red; could leave or adapt `circle_button_base` accent red; but cancel button highlight state; okay.
- `SkillTouchButton` size 220; helper works with radius and press.
- `TouchActionButton` radius; helper.
- `AttackWheelButton` radius likely 120? inspect.
- Need avoid calling `UiKit` before ready? static-ish autoload; fine.

Need create **press animation**:
- Shared helper accepts `press: float` 0..1. Each control needs `_press` var and `_process`:

This gives smooth press/release. Add haptic on press via `UiKit.haptic(8)` maybe only if mobile; `UiKit` available; could call in `_gui_input`; but haptic on every skill press might be too much; user asks texture; haptic helps. Existing `UiKit.punch` haptics for regular buttons; touch buttons no haptic currently. Add `UiKit.haptic(7)` on press? On mobile each skill use vibrates; acceptable but could be annoying. Maybe only joystick activation and touch action toggles; not skills? "质感" visual focus. Could add subtle 6ms for action buttons; skill buttons maybe; but no requirement. Keep minimal: joystick activation haptic 6; action buttons 6; skill 6? Hmm.
  - `SkillTouchButton`: add `_press`; `is_held()` returns `_active_touch>=0`? inspect; use `_held` state? Need inspect full skill button input/draw sections.

User says "按键系统和摇杆的质感" maybe they refer **desktop keyboard buttons?** "按键系统" likely touch buttons because "摇杆" clearly mobile. Could be "button system and joystick feel" in mobile UI. We'll improve mobile.

Need preserve all callers and APIs. Plan:
- Add `UiKit.glass_button(ci, center, radius, accent, press, dim, ring_w, shadow)` draw premium shell. Must be called before icons. It can return adjusted center? Each button needs draw contents at shifted center when pressed; simplest helper draws at `center + Vector2(0, press*2)` and shrink radius; but subsequent icon/name need same adjusted center/radius. We can calculate in button `_draw`: `center.y += _press*2; radius *= 1-0.02*_press`; then call helper with press. Or helper computes and returns? GDScript can return Vector2/PackedFloat32Array maybe; but more complexity. Do per-class offset.
- Add **texture/pattern**? We can use built-in 9-slice textures; but circular buttons currently procedural. Could create circle via `draw_style_box` with rounded style box; but `StyleBoxFlat` with `corner_radius` half radius produces circle, can have border and shadow and anti-aliased; draw_style_box supports shadows. This could look better and simpler:
  - `UiKit.circle_glass(ci, center, r, accent, press, alpha)`:
    - StyleBoxFlat with bg color, border width, corner radius, shadow; draw_style_box at Rect2(center-r, center-r, 2r,2r).
    - Add top gloss via draw_arc/circle.
  - But dynamic shadows and gradient impossible; draw_style_box shadow takes area beyond rect; fine.
  - Existing flat circles draw anti-aliased? `draw_circle` antialiased default false? In Godot 4 `draw_circle(pos,radius,color,filled=true,width=-1,antialiased=false)`; circles may be jagged; style box corners anti-aliased. Using StyleBoxFlat could improve markedly.
  - Yet draw_style_box with shadow + border + corner might be more expensive but few buttons. Could do layered circles with `draw_arc` antialiased true; existing rings use antialias. Fill jaggedness less noticeable.
  - **Gradients**: `draw_circle` doesn't gradient; use 3-4 concentric fills: outer accent dark, middle glass, inner lighter; plus gloss arc.
  - Add subtle **halo** with `draw_circle` alpha accent; shadows.

Let's implement helper in UiKit:
```
## 圆形触摸键统一玻璃底座：暗色落影 + 外发光 + 金属外圈 + 玻璃主体 + 顶部高光 + 内侧底光。
## press:0..1 按下深度；accent:元素/功能色；dim:不可用压暗；ring:外圈粗细。
func touch_button_base(ci: CanvasItem, center: Vector2, radius: float, accent: Color,
        press: float = 0.0, dim: bool = false, ring_w: float = 3.0) -> void:
    var p := clampf(press,0,1)
    var c := center + Vector2(0, p * 2.0)
    var r := radius * (1.0 - p * 0.018)
    var a := 0.55 if dim else 1.0
    # 外发光
    ci.draw_circle(c + Vector2(0, 5), r + 9 + p*2, Color(0,0,0,0.30))
    if not dim:
        ci.draw_circle(c, r + 6, Color(accent.r, accent.g, accent.b, 0.10 + 0.10*p))
    # 外圈金属框
    ci.draw_circle(c, r + 2.0, Color(0.02,0.03,0.05,0.85))
    ci.draw_arc(c, r + 1.5, 0, TAU, 48, Color(accent.r,...,0.75), ring_w+2.0, true)
    # 主体玻璃
    ci.draw_circle(c, r, Color(UiKit.C_GLASS...alpha))
    # 内层渐变
    ci.draw_circle(c - Vector2(0,r*0.05), r*0.90, Color(1,1,1,0.045))
    ci.draw_circle(c + Vector2(0,r*0.10), r*0.78, Color(0,0,0,0.10))
    # 顶部高光
```

1: extends RefCounted
2: ## 技能按钮图标：纯矢量程序化绘制（项目无美术资源）。
3: ## 用法：const SkillArt = preload("res://scripts/ui/SkillArt.gd")，再调用其 static 方法。
4: ## 每个技能按「技能名关键词 → 纹样」匹配，匹配不到按技能 type 兜底，
5: ## 配色取英雄元素色（Vfx.color_for_hero），因此 51 个英雄技能各有可辨识的图形。
6: 
7: ## 关键词 → 纹样（靠前者优先）
8: const KEYWORDS := [
9: 	[["火", "焰", "炎", "焚", "燃", "爆"], "flame"],
10: 	[["冰", "霜", "寒", "雪", "冻"], "ice"],
11: 	[["雷", "电", "霆", "闪"], "bolt"],
12: 	[["风", "飓", "旋", "卷"], "wind"],
13: 	[["箭", "矢", "矛", "枪", "针"], "arrow"],
14: 	[["剑", "刃", "斩", "刀", "锋", "刺"], "blade"],
15: 	[["盾", "护", "壁", "甲", "披"], "shield"],
16: 	[["星", "辰", "陨"], "star"],
17: 	[["月"], "moon"],
18: 	[["阳", "日", "耀", "光", "辉", "圣"], "sun"],
19: 	[["毒", "腐", "疫", "蚀"], "poison"],
20: 	[["愈", "疗", "回", "奶", "生", "血"], "heal"],
21: 	[["锁", "链", "缚", "禁", "绳"], "chain"],
22: 	[["阵", "域", "圈", "场", "区", "印", "坛"], "trap"],
23: 	[["门", "空间", "瞬", "移", "传送", "跃"], "portal"],
24: 	[["拳", "掌", "踢", "爪", "击"], "punch"],
25: 	[["锤", "棍", "棒", "杖"], "hammer"],
26: 	[["扇"], "fan"],
27: 	[["书", "卷", "符", "典", "牌"], "book"],
28: 	[["音", "歌", "咏", "琴"], "music"],
29: 	[["眼", "瞳", "视", "窥"], "eye"],
30: 	[["魂", "灵", "幽", "鬼", "影", "冥"], "shadow"],
31: 	[["花", "藤", "木", "林", "叶", "种"], "leaf"],
32: 	[["时", "钟", "沙"], "clock"],
33: 	[["球", "弹", "珠"], "orb"],
34: ]
35: 
36: ## 技能纹样名（供外部探测/调试）
37: static func motif_for(skill, slot: int) -> String:
38: 	if skill == null:
39: 		return ["lock", "aoe", "beam", "dash", "shield"][clampi(slot, 0, 4)]
40: 	var n := str(skill.skill_name)
41: 	for entry in KEYWORDS:
42: 		for kw in entry[0]:
43: 			if n.find(str(kw)) >= 0:
44: 				return str(entry[1])
45: 	match int(skill.type):
46: 		0: return "lock"
47: 		1: return "aoe"
48: 		3: return "beam"
49: 		4: return "dash"
50: 		6: return "shield"
51: 	return "orb"
52: 
53: ## 画按钮底盘 + 纹样。learned=false 压暗，ready=false 加冷灰罩
54: static func draw_bg(ci: CanvasItem, c: Vector2, r: float, hero_name: String, skill, slot: int,
55: 		learned: bool, ready: bool) -> void:
56: 	var base: Color = Vfx.color_for_hero(hero_name) if hero_name != "" else Color(0.42, 0.60, 0.88)
57: 	# 同英雄 1/2/3 技能用副元素色偏色，避免三格颜色一模一样
58: 	if hero_name != "" and slot > 0:
59: 		base = base.lerp(Vfx.color2_for_hero(hero_name), 0.16 * clampi(slot, 0, 3))
60: 	var deep := base.darkened(0.80)
61: 	ci.draw_circle(c, r, deep)
62: 	# 径向高光：多层低 alpha 圆叠加，避免硬边色环
63: 	for i in range(12):
64: 		var t := 1.0 - float(i) / 11.0
65: 		ci.draw_circle(c, r * 0.97 * t, Color(base.r, base.g, base.b, 0.055))
66: 	# 环境弧光 + 底部压暗，保证技能名/伤害读数可读
67: 	ci.draw_arc(c, r * 0.88, -PI * 0.95, -PI * 0.15, 22, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.12), maxf(r * 0.09, 1.5), true)
68: 	ci.draw_circle(c + Vector2(0, r * 0.62), r * 0.62, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.16))
69: 	# 纹样（外发光 + 主色 + 高光芯）
70: 	var m := motif_for(skill, slot)
71: 	var k := r * 0.46
72: 	var col := base.lightened(0.42)

lines.text: ## 移动端技能按钮：按下进入瞄准，拖动更新拖拽向量，松开施放
## 拖拽方向（屏幕坐标偏移）由 TouchController 暴露给 Hero 做瞄准
# 王者荣耀式松开施放：final_drag=松开时的拖拽向量；cancelled=「拖出去又拖回按钮」→ 取消施放
# release_global=松开位置（画布全局坐标），用于检测是否落在「取消施法」按钮上
signal released(index: int, final_drag: Vector2, cancelled: bool, release_global: Vector2)
const TAP_THRESHOLD := 30.0      # 超过此拖拽距离才算“拖出去”
const CANCEL_RADIUS := 40.0      # 松手位置距按下起点小于此值且拖出去过 → 视为拖回按钮，取消
# true：技能名画在按钮下方、按钮中央留空（英雄 1/2/3 技能）；false：技能名画在按钮中央（召唤师）
# 技能图标数据（由 TouchController 推送）：英雄名决定元素配色，skill 决定纹样
var icon_kind := ""       # 非空时画功能图标（回城/恢复/召唤师），颜色固定不走英雄色
# 按钮内下方的小字说明（由 TouchController 每帧推送，如惩击的伤害数值）
# 技能图标中央偏上的伤害预览（由 TouchController 每帧推送）：icon_dmg<0 不显示；
# 颜色按伤害类型：icon_dmg_magic=true 法术(紫)，false 物理(橙)；
# icon_count>1 时把伤害与弹数合并显示成“伤害×N”（如“260×6”），表示每段伤害与总弹/段数
# 第二段伤害（与 icon_dmg 并排显示的另一类伤害，如狄仁杰每段同时命中物理+法术）：
# icon_dmg2>0 时按 icon_dmg2_magic 着色并排显示在物理伤害右侧，二者共用弹数“×N”
# 附加效果小字（由 TouchController 每帧推送）：每项 {k:效果类型, col:颜色, txt:数值+时长}，
# 与 icon_dmg 一起画在按钮上（伤害下方逐行，矢量小图标+小字；绿=自身增益/蓝=对敌负面）
# 技能施放后附带“强化普攻”效果（由 TouchController 每帧推送，如亚瑟Q/铠W）：
# 在按钮读数最前/伤害数值前加一枚金色普攻小剑，区别于纯直接伤害技能
var _origin := Vector2.ZERO      # 按下起点（局部坐标）
var _drag := Vector2.ZERO        # 当前拖拽偏移
var _max_drag := 0.0             # 本次手势的最大拖拽距离
# 每帧由 TouchController 更新，用于绘制冷却/蓝量状态
var cd_ratio := 0.0              # 0..1 剩余冷却占比
var cd_total := 30.0             # 技能总冷却（秒），冷却遮罩上显示真实剩余秒数
# 多段/重施窗口状态（每帧由 TouchController 更新）：
var in_window := false          # 当前处于可重施窗口（如李白Q二/三段、夏侯惇Q二段）
var win_left := 0.0             # 窗口剩余时间（秒）
var win_total := 1.0            # 窗口总时长（秒），青色扇形按此比例收拢
var segments_left := 0          # 剩余可施放段数（>0 时在按钮内底部画实心圆点）
# 存储型技能（restore>0，可存多层/多段，如马超大招）：已存层数 / 上限（上限>0 表示这是存储型技能）。
# 每帧由 TouchController 推送；层数>0 时即便在回充下一层的 CD 中也可施放，不画满冷却遮罩。
# 施放前置条件不满足（如马超大招需身边有枪才能召回）→ 按钮置灰并显示 block_cue 提示
# 等级金环：外圈按技能最大等级均分小段，亮段数 = 当前技能等级（max_level=0 不绘制）
# 尺寸由调用方通过 _anchor_br 显式指定（技能 260 / 召唤师·恢复 220）；
# 仅当未显式设置时回退默认 110。
# 当前手指所在位置（画布全局坐标），供取消施法按钮做「拖到其上」高亮检测
# 记录松开时的最终拖拽与「拖回按钮取消」判定
var cancelled: bool = _max_drag > TAP_THRESHOLD and final_drag.length() < CANCEL_RADIUS
elif event is InputEventMouseButton or event is InputEventMouseMotion:
# 移动端 emulate_mouse_from_touch 会产生合成鼠标事件，吞掉防止漏到世界输入
# 字号/描边/金环等内部固定像素随按钮尺寸等比放大（设计基准 SIZE_V=110）
var k := maxf(1.0, minf(size.x, size.y) / SIZE_V)
# ---- 可用性/颜色：亮=可用，青=多段重施窗口，灰=不可用(未学/冷却/蓝不足)，红=前置不满足(无枪等) ----
# 存储型技能：只要还有已存层数就视为可放（此时即便正在回充下一层也不画满冷却遮罩）；
# 层数用尽后的回充则照常按冷却显示
var on_cd := (not in_window) and cd_ratio > 0.001 and not has_charge
var need_mana := (not in_window) and (not on_cd) and max_level > 0 and not mana_ok
var usable := not unlearned and not on_cd and not need_mana and not blocked
# 主体：功能图标（回城/恢复/召唤师 → 固定色，见 IconArt）；英雄技能 → 英雄元素色（SkillArt）
IconArt.draw_icon(self, center, radius, icon_kind, not usable)
SkillArt.draw_bg(self, center, radius, art_hero, art_skill, skill_index, not unlearned, usable)
# 技能名：英雄 1/2/3 技能 name_below=true → 内嵌按钮底部圆角条（元素色色条 + 字数多自动缩字号）；
# 召唤师 / 恢复按钮 name_below=false → 名字居中画在按钮上
var band := Rect2(center.x - radius * 0.92, center.y + radius - band_h + 2.0 * k,
var acc: Color = Vfx.color_for_hero(art_hero) if art_hero != "" else color
while cfs > int(12.0 * k) and UiKit.font().get_string_size(
var label := ("" if icon_kind != "" else str(skill_index + 1)) if display_name == "" else display_name
var label_fs := int((24.0 if label.length() > 2 else 30.0) * k)
_draw_txt(center + Vector2(-radius * 0.75, 6), label, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, radius * 1.5, label_fs, Color.WHITE)
# 拖动瞄准：摇杆头样式小圆（像移动轮盘一样），随拖拽方向移动
draw_arc(knob, kr, 0, TAU, 24, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.75), 3.0 * k, true)
# 等级金环：贴外圈，按最大等级切成小段，已点亮段数 = 当前技能等级
# 冷却/重施窗口叠层：多段重施窗口(青色扇形=窗口剩余比例) 与 完整冷却(暗色扇形) 二选一
# 剩余段数：底部一排实心小圆点（剩余几段=几个点）
var pc := Vector2(x0 + s * gap, py)
_draw_txt(center + Vector2(-radius * 0.5, 6), "%d" % secs, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, radius, int(26.0 * k), Color(1, 0.85, 0.3))
# 存储型技能：已存层数>0 时画一圈细弧表示“下一层回充进度”（不做满遮罩、不盖住技能读数）
# 存储型技能：底部画充能层数点（实心=已有层数，空心=空位；最高层数/已存层数一目了然）
# 前置状态门槛不可用（李白大招侠客 / 沈梦溪1、2炸弹 / 马超R枪 / 东皇2能量 / 兰陵王大招隐身）：
# 非冷却/重施窗口期间在按钮中央斜切一道红色禁用斜杠（下方 block_cue 小字仍叠在斜杠上层）
if blocked and not in_window and not on_cd:
# 前置不满足提示（如马超身边无枪）→ 无冷却遮罩期间显示在按钮中下方
if blocked and not in_window and not on_cd and block_cue != "":
# 下方小字说明（惩击伤害等，不受冷却遮罩影响）
# 技能伤害 + 附加效果读数：英雄技能(名在下方、中央留空)已学且非瞄准/冷却/重施期间时，
# 在中央偏上写“伤害×弹数”（物伤橙/法伤紫），其下逐行画效果小图标+数值/时长（绿=自身增益/蓝=对敌负面）
if name_below and max_level > 0 and skill_level > 0 \
and not _active and not in_window and not on_cd and not blocked:
# 统一带描边文字（draw_string 无描边，3D 场景上纯白字会糊；参数顺序同 draw_string）
func _draw_txt(pos: Vector2, txt: String, align: int, width: float, fs: int, col: Color) -> void:
UiKit.text(self, pos, txt, fs, col, align, width)
# 冷却/窗口扇形：从按钮正上方顺时针铺开的半透明扇形，覆盖面积 = 剩余占比；

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

```
func touch_button_frame(ci: CanvasItem, center: Vector2, radius: float, accent: Color,
        press: float = 0.0, ring_w: float = 3.0, dim: bool = false) -> void:
    if ci == null: return
    var p := clampf(press,0,1)
    var c := center + Vector2(0, p * 1.6)
    var r := radius * (1.0 - p * 0.014)
    var a := 0.55 if dim else 1.0
    # 落影：贴地一点，压按时收紧
    ci.draw_circle(c + Vector2(0, 5.0 - p*2.0), r + 9.0, Color(0,0,0,0.28*a))
    # 外发光
    if not dim:
```

const MAX_RADIUS := 120.0         # 摇杆头最大行程半径（虚拟分辨率单位）

const BASE_RADIUS := 84.0
const ACCENT := Color(0.52, 0.82, 1.0, 0.95)

func _ready():
	mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	_visual_pos = get_home()
	set_process(true)

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if _active:
		_press = 1.0
		return
	var home := get_home()
	var moving := _visual_pos.distance_squared_to(home) > 0.04

	return size * 0.5

		Color(ACCENT.r, ACCENT.g, ACCENT.b, 0.18 + 0.10 * p), 1.5, true)
	draw_circle(home, 9.0, Color(ACCENT.r, ACCENT.g, ACCENT.b, 0.15 + 0.12 * p))
	for i in range(8):

		var d := Vector2(cos(a), sin(a))
		var inner := home + d * BASE_RADIUS * 0.76
		var outer := home + d * BASE_RADIUS * 0.92
		draw_line(inner, outer, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.22 + 0.16 * p), 2.0, true)

	if _active and _visual_pos.distance_to(home) > 4.0:
		var sd := _visual_pos - home
		var sa := atan2(sd.y, sd.x)
		draw_arc(home, BASE_RADIUS + 7.0, sa - 0.34, sa + 0.34, 18,
			Color(ACCENT.r, ACCENT.g, ACCENT.b, 0.34), 5.0, true)
	# 摇杆头：静止时半透明常显，按下后变亮并带高光
	var kp := _visual_pos
	var ka := 0.72 + 0.28 * p
	var kr := KNOB_RADIUS * (1.0 - 0.045 * p)
	draw_circle(kp + Vector2(0, 7), kr * 1.06, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.30 * ka))
	draw_circle(kp, kr + 9.0, Color(ACCENT.r, ACCENT.g, ACCENT.b, 0.05 + 0.09 * p))
	draw_circle(kp, kr + 2.0, Color(0.015, 0.020, 0.032, 0.94))
	draw_circle(kp, kr, Color(0.26, 0.34, 0.46, 0.96 * ka))
	draw_circle(kp - Vector2(0, kr * 0.12), kr * 0.88, Color(0.44, 0.56, 0.70, 0.30 * ka))
	draw_circle(kp + Vector2(0, kr * 0.14), kr * 0.74, Color(0.08, 0.11, 0.17, 0.18 * ka))
	draw_arc(kp, kr, 0, TAU, 48, Color(ACCENT.r, ACCENT.g, ACCENT.b, 0.78 * ka),
		maxf(2.0, kr * 0.06), true)
	draw_arc(kp - Vector2(0, kr * 0.18), kr * 0.76, -PI * 0.92, -PI * 0.08, 24,
		Color(1, 1, 1, 0.34 * ka), maxf(2.0, kr * 0.07), true)
	# 防滑颗粒 + 中心点
	for i in range(4):
		var a := TAU * float(i) / 4.0 + PI * 0.25
		draw_circle(kp + Vector2(cos(a), sin(a)) * kr * 0.48,
			maxf(1.5, kr * 0.045), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.22 * ka))
	draw_circle(kp, maxf(2.0, kr * 0.12), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.26 * ka))

{"file_path":"C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king\scripts\mobile\CancelCastButton.gd","content":"class_name CancelCastButton
extends Control
## 王者荣耀式「取消施法」按钮：拖动技能瞄准时出现在右缘，
## 手指拖到其上（松手落在按钮内）即取消施放。
## 纯显示 + 矩形命中检测（由 TouchController 轮询），不拦截输入（MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE）。

var _highlighted := false
var _hl := 0.0

func _ready():
	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE   # 纯显示，不参与触摸/鼠标命中
	set_process(true)

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	var target := 1.0 if _highlighted else 0.0
	if absf(_hl - target) < 0.003:
		return
	_hl = move_toward(_hl, target, delta * 12.0)
	queue_redraw()

func set_highlighted(v: bool):
	if v != _highlighted:
		_highlighted = v
		queue_redraw()

func _draw():
	var h := clampf(_hl, 0.0, 1.0)
	var center := size * 0.5 + Vector2(0, -2.0 * h)
	var radius := minf(size.x, size.y) * 0.4 * (1.0 + 0.035 * h)
	# 放大后线宽/提示字随按钮尺寸等比缩放（设计基准 150）
	var k := maxf(1.0, size.x / 150.0)
	var accent := Color(1.0, 0.35, 0.30, 0.88).lerp(Color(1.0, 0.58, 0.42, 1.0), h)
	UiKit.touch_button_frame(self, center, radius, accent, h, 4.0, false)
	# 红色玻璃主体：拖到其上时整体提亮
	var body := Color(0.22, 0.06, 0.06, 0.86).lerp(Color(0.42, 0.10, 0.09, 0.92), h)
	draw_circle(center, radius, body)
	draw_circle(center - Vector2(0, radius * 0.12), radius * 0.84, Color(1.0, 0.30, 0.24, 0.055 + 0.04 * h))
	draw_circle(center + Vector2(0, radius * 0.16), radius * 0.76, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.10))
	draw_arc(center, radius - 1.5, 0, TAU, 40, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.10 + 0.10 * h),
		maxf(1.4, radius * 0.02), true)
	draw_arc(center - Vector2(0, radius * 0.18), radius * 0.78, -PI * 0.92, -PI * 0.08,
		24, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.16 + 0.10 * h), maxf(2.0, radius * 0.045), true)
	if h > 0.02:
		draw_arc(center, radius + 9.0 + 2.0 * h, 0, TAU, 40,
			Color(1.0, 0.45, 0.32, 0.18 * h), 2.0, true)
	# ×
	var l := radius * 0.42
	var lw := 8.0 * k
	draw_line(center - Vector2(l, l), center + Vector2(l, l), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.35), lw + 4.0 * k)
	draw_line(center + Vector2(-l, l), center + Vector2(l, -l), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.35), lw + 4.0 * k)
	draw_line(center - Vector2(l, l), center + Vector2(l, l), Color.WHITE, lw)
	draw_line(center + Vector2(-l, l), center + Vector2(l, -l), Color.WHITE, lw)
	# 小字提示
	var fs := int(maxf(20.0, 20.0 * k))
	var tw := 80.0 * k
	draw_string(UiKit.font(), center + Vector2(-tw * 0.5, radius + 26.0 * k), "取消施法",
		HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, tw, fs, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.82 + 0.15 * h))
"}

```
func _draw():
```
	var w := size.x
	var h := size.y
	var p := clampf(_press, 0.0, 1.0)
	var oy := p * 1.5
	# 半透明圆角底框（统一皮肤）：按下时缩短阴影、整体下压
	var style := UiKit.flat(0.56, 9, 2, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.26), Color(0.03, 0.04, 0.06, 0.68), 10.0)
	draw_style_box(style, Rect2(0, oy + 2.0, w, h))
	draw_style_box(style, Rect2(0, oy, w, h))
	# 左侧金色状态条 + 顶部玻璃高光
	draw_rect(Rect2(8.0, oy + 8.0, 3.0, h - 16.0), Color(1.0, 0.82, 0.34, 0.80), true)
	draw_line(Vector2(12.0, oy + 2.0), Vector2(w - 12.0, oy + 2.0),

Potential issue `UiKit.flat` creates new StyleBox every draw; `_draw` only on press changes; okay but could cache; fine.

Need **TouchActionButton** icon issue: helper frame ring might be covered by `IconArt` at radius0.98; IconArt draws dark circle radius0.98 and its own arc at radius-1.0; helper ring at radius+1.5, visible. But helper's top rim highlight at radius+0.5, visible outside 0.98r? Yes, 0.5px inside/outside? radius+0.5 vs IconArt0.98 radius; visible. Good.

Need **SkillTouchButton** helper frame and SkillArt fill: helper accent ring at +1.5, top highlight +0.5; visible. But helper **shadow** at +8.5; good.

Need **AttackWheelButton** helper glass then label; okay.

Need **VirtualJoystick** `UiKit.touch_button_frame` at radius84; activation ring at300; visual. But **joystick base size** 84 may overlap `MoveModeToggle` at x1600 y150? Joystick home x330 y300; base no; fine.
- **Joystick knob at rest** drawn on top of base; good.
- **Joystick active** `_visual_pos` jumps to finger, no smoothing; on release returns; good.
- **`_process` while active sets _press1 but doesn't redraw**; drag redraw from input. fine.
- **On release** `_knob_pos=get_home()`; `_visual_pos` old; `_process` returns home; `_draw` during return uses `_visual_pos`; good. But `_active` false, `_press` decays; base press; knob alpha ka0.72+...; nice.
- **`_process` return after animation**; no queue after; okay.
- **`UiKit.touch_dash_ring`** draws 48 arcs every draw; redraw only on interaction/return; fine.

Need **compile**. Before compile, check any syntax errors (line 153? SkillTouchButton). Run check-only on changed scripts? They reference UiKit autoload; check-only fails identifiers. Run battle scene headless which loads touch controls? `BattleManager` may instantiate TouchController only on mobile feature; headless on Windows maybe TouchController created? Let's inspect BattleManager: touch controls likely if OS.has_feature("mobile") or always? If not, changed scripts may not compile in battle scene. `net_client` NetTouchPad likely only in net client. We need compile all scenes; those scripts may be loaded if nodes instantiate. Headless battle maybe not create TouchController; but earlier net client did. Need run a **custom compile probe** preloading changed scripts with autoloads? In normal `--headless --path . --script` autoloads not available at script compile; but can use a **scene** with attached script? Or use `--headless --path . --editor --quit` not compile. Best run `net_client.tscn` (NetTouchPad always? likely touch UI instantiated) and battle (TouchController probably only if mobile? On Windows headless OS.has_feature("mobile") false; but TouchController maybe added anyway? inspect BattleManager). Search `TouchController.new` / `NetTouchPad.new`.

Need verify visual behavior / potential bugs:
- **TouchActionButton** `_process` no `set_process` issue; okay.
- **MoveModeToggle** `_draw` uses `draw_rect` with rotation? okay.
- **CancelCastButton** `draw_circle` body and frame; okay.

Potential **UiKit.touch_button_frame** shadow with p: `r + 8.5` and center offset; if radius 44, shadow extends; fine.
- **SkillTouchButton** frame is drawn **before** SkillArt; SkillArt draws a full circle at radius, covering helper's top highlight **inside** but helper's top highlight at r+0.5 outside; okay.
- **TouchActionButton** **IconArt** draws at radius*0.98; helper accent ring at r+1.5; visible ~3px. Frame's shadow outside. Good.
- **TouchActionButton** text buttons now use glass; fine.
- **TouchActionButton** label text color etc unaffected.
- **AttackWheelButton** helper glass uses `accent` ring; enhanced gold; good.
- **VirtualJoystick** uses `UiKit.touch_button_frame` with `BASE_RADIUS=84`; base larger than old70; knob radius48; okay. But **joystick hit/activation** unaffected. Visual base may overlap screen bottom? Home y300, radius84 => fits.
- **Joystick `_press`** initial0; idle knob alpha0.72; base.
- **`_process` active returns without queue_redraw**; `_press=1`, but if user presses and no drag, `_update_knob` queue redraw at press. fine.
- **`_process` after release**: `moving` false if `_visual_pos` equals home at center; `pressing` true decays; queue each frame; knob drawn at home; fine.
- **When control first ready** `_visual_pos=get_home()`; size maybe 0? `_ready` after size established? TouchController sets offsets before add; Control size computed after tree entry; `_ready` likely after size; if size 0, home0 then first frame `_process` target actual home; fine.
- **`touch_dash_ring`** uses `draw_arc` with 48* arcs; each draw triggers? fine.
- **Haptic** on desktop no-op; on mobile each skill press 5ms; good.

Need **maybe add button click sound**? Not necessary; UI click sound already for theme buttons, touch skills have skill effects; haptic enough.

Need **MoveModeToggle** `UiKit.flat` called every press frame creating StyleBox, but only while decaying (~0.07s) and initial; acceptable. Could cache, but avoid.

Need **AttackWheelButton** `ring_col` enhanced; helper draw frame at r+1.5 but label etc; okay.
- **AttackWheelButton** `_process` uses `_active`; on release `_press` decays; good.
- **`TouchActionButton`** press for **hold_to_act=false** and drag cancel sets false but no haptic; fine.

Need **button quality for skill icons**: `SkillArt` draws its own flat dark circle; helper adds outer metal frame/shadow but inside is still same. Could improve **SkillArt.draw_bg** with a top gloss? It already has radial highligh; but our outer frame adds. Could add a **glass rim overlay** after drawing SkillArt in `SkillTouchButton`, e.g. `UiKit.touch_button_glass` cannot be used (would cover icon). Add `UiKit.touch_button_gloss` helper that draws only top arc/highlight and maybe inner rim over icon but not central. This would add specular over skill background and icons at edge; could improve quality. Add helper:
```
func touch_button_gloss(ci, center, radius, accent, press=0, dim=false):
  # top rim glossy arc and bottom accent
```
But `_draw` in SkillTouchButton can simply draw:
```
draw_arc(center - Vector2(0, radius*0.18), radius*0.78, -PI*0.92, -PI*0.08, 24, Color(1,1,1,0.10+0.06*p), maxf(2,r*0.035), true)
```
This overlays icon/glyph near top, slight; nice glass. Add after SkillArt/IconArt call and before name maybe; but for icon buttons too. Could use `UiKit.touch_button_gloss` and call after base art, before names; but must not cover too much. Add helper to UiKit:
```
func touch_button_gloss(ci,...):
  top arc at r*0.94 with white alpha0.10, width r*0.03; bottom accent.
```
However `SkillArt` already has top arc at r*0.88; another could be overkill. Skip.

Need **texture of touch buttons** maybe the `UiKit.C_GLASS` used before is now helper with more depth.

block.text:
Transient concurrent? Good. But need check touch scripts actually compile; autoload TouchController loads at startup; yes. Good.

Need **net_client** compile too (NetTouchPad uses same). Later.

Need verify visual behavior / potential bugs:
- **TouchActionButton** `_process` no `set_process` issue; okay.
- **MoveModeToggle** `_draw` uses `draw_rect` with rotation? okay.
- **CancelCastButton** `draw_circle` body and frame; okay.

Potential **UiKit.touch_button_frame** shadow with p: `r + 8.5` and center offset; if radius 44, shadow extends; fine.
- **SkillTouchButton** frame is drawn **before** SkillArt; SkillArt draws a full circle at radius, covering helper's top highlight **inside** but helper's top highlight at r+0.5 outside; okay.
- **TouchActionButton** **IconArt** draws at radius*0.98; helper accent ring at r+1.5; visible ~3px. Frame's shadow outside. Good.
- **TouchActionButton** text buttons now use glass; fine.
- **TouchActionButton** label text color etc unaffected.
- **AttackWheelButton** helper glass uses `accent` ring; enhanced gold; good.
- **VirtualJoystick** uses `UiKit.touch_button_frame` with `BASE_RADIUS=84`; base larger than old70; knob radius48; okay. But **joystick hit/activation** unaffected. Visual base may overlap screen bottom? Home y300, radius84 => fits.
- **Joystick `_press`** initial0; idle knob alpha0.72; base.
- **`_process` active returns without queue_redraw**; `_press=1`, but if user presses and no drag, `_update_knob` queue redraw at press. fine.
- **`_process` after release**: `moving` false if `_visual_pos` equals home at center; `pressing` true decays; queue each frame; knob drawn at home; fine.
- **When control first ready** `_visual_pos=get_home()`; size maybe 0? `_ready` after size established? TouchController sets offsets before add; Control size computed after tree entry; `_ready` likely after size; if size 0, home0 then first frame `_process` target actual home; fine.
- **`touch_dash_ring`** uses `draw_arc` with 48* arcs; each draw triggers? fine.
- **Haptic** on desktop no-op; on mobile each skill press 5ms; good.

Need **maybe add button click sound**? Not necessary; UI click sound already for theme buttons, touch skills have skill effects; haptic enough.

Need **MoveModeToggle** `UiKit.flat` called every press frame creating StyleBox, but only while decaying (~0.07s) and initial; acceptable. Could cache, but avoid.

Need **AttackWheelButton** `ring_col` enhanced; helper draw frame at r+1.5 but label etc; okay.
- **AttackWheelButton** `_process` uses `_active`; on release `_press` decays; good.
- **`TouchActionButton`** press for **hold_to_act=false** and drag cancel sets false but no haptic; fine.

Need **button quality for skill icons**: `SkillArt` draws its own flat dark circle; helper adds outer metal frame/shadow but inside is still same. Could improve **SkillArt.draw_bg** with a top gloss? It already has radial highligh; but our outer frame adds. Could add a **glass rim overlay** after drawing SkillArt in `SkillTouchButton`, e.g. `UiKit.touch_button_glass` cannot be used (would cover icon). Add `UiKit.touch_button_gloss` helper that draws only top arc/highlight and maybe inner rim over icon but not central. This would add specular over skill background and icons at edge; could improve quality. Add helper:
```
func touch_button_gloss(ci, center, radius, accent, press=0, dim=false):
  # top rim glossy arc and bottom accent
```
But `_draw` in SkillTouchButton can simply draw:
```
draw_arc(center - Vector2(0, radius*0.18), radius*0.78, -PI*0.92, -PI*0.08, 24, Color(1,1,1,0.10+0.06*p), maxf(2,r*0.035), true)
```
This overlays icon/glyph near top, slight; nice glass. Add after SkillArt/IconArt call and before name maybe; but for icon buttons too. Could use `UiKit.touch_button_gloss` and call after base art, before names; but must not cover too much. Add helper to UiKit:
```
func touch_button_gloss(ci,...):
  top arc at r*0.94 with white alpha0.10, width r*0.03; bottom accent.
```
However `SkillArt` already has top arc at r*0.88; another could be overkill. Skip.

Need **texture of touch buttons** maybe the `UiKit.C_GLASS` used before is now helper with more depth.

Need **check VisualJoystick class type** comment; fine.

Need **compile all scenes**. First maybe run **custom probe** to instantiate and call `_draw`? Headless draw no; compile.

Run battle again sequential plus net client/lobby/loadout; watch transient.

tools.name: ask_user_question
tools.description: Ask the user a concise question when you need confirmation, a choice, or missing information before proceeding.

questions.description: Questions to ask the user before continuing.

id.description: Stable id for this question; echoed in the answer.

question.description: The specific question to ask the user.

header.description: Optional short heading for the question, such as "Confirm" or "Choose Mode".

options.description: Optional choices to show the user. If you recommend one, put it first and append "(Recommended)" to that label.

description.description: One sentence explaining the tradeoff or impact.

multi_select.description: Whether the user may select more than one option. Defaults to false.

tools.name: create_goal
tools.description: Create a persisted goal that keeps this session working across automatic continuation rounds. Use it when the direct human request is a long-running objective, even if the user did not say "goal"; not for single-turn work.

objective.description: The concrete completion objective inferred from the direct human request.

max_goal_rounds.description: Optional positive safe-integer limit on automatic continuation rounds.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Edit an existing UTF-8 text file by replacing literal text.

file_path.description: Path to edit, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `old_string` and `new_string` in the arguments.

new_string.description: Literal replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the match.

replace_all.description: Replace all matches. Defaults to false; when false, old_string must appear exactly once.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: exit_plan_mode
tools.description: Use only in plan mode. Present your plan for the user's review and, on approval, leave plan mode. The user may approve (carry out the plan from your next step) or keep planning — their feedback comes back in the tool result; revise and present again.

plan.description: The complete plan, as markdown, starting with a # heading that names it.

tools.name: get_goal
tools.description: Read the current session goal, including the id and revision that update_goal requires.

tools.name: glob
tools.description: Find files, not directories, whose paths match a glob pattern, including hidden and ignored files. Returns up to 100 paths in modification-time order; a larger result keeps the first paths and reports where the complete list was saved.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match file paths against (e.g. "**/*.ts", "src/**/*.test.js"). A pattern with no "/" matches the basename at any depth, so "*" and "*.ts" both search the whole tree; include a separator to anchor the depth.

path.description: Directory to search in. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Search file contents with a ripgrep regular expression. Returns matching lines with line numbers, grouped by file. Returns up to 250 matches; a larger result reports where the complete match list was saved.

pattern.description: Regular expression to search for (ripgrep syntax).

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

include.description: One glob filter for which files to search (e.g. "*.ts", "*.{js,jsx}"). Not a list; negation is not supported.

tools.name: interrupt_agent
tools.description: Interrupt one teammate's current turn while preserving its pending inbox. Team Lead only.

target.description: Teammate target returned by spawn_teammate or list_agents.

tools.name: job_kill
tools.description: Request cancellation of a running background job.

job_id.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the background work.

reason.description: Optional short reason, recorded in the log and forwarded to the job.

tools.name: job_list
tools.description: List your background jobs (running and finished) with their ids, kinds, and statuses.

tools.name: job_output
tools.description: Read a background job: output since the previous read for stream jobs, or the result of a finished final-output job.

job_id.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the background work.

wait.description: Block until the job finishes or the timeout expires; a timed-out wait leaves the job running. Defaults to false.

timeout_ms.description: Max wait in milliseconds with wait: true. Defaults to and is capped by configuration.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List the Lead and every durable teammate with an addressable target and current availability. inactive means no turn is executing, not a task result. provisioning and failed describe member creation.

tools.name: load_workspace_dependencies
tools.description: Get absolute paths to bundled Python and library directories, plus bundled Python distribution versions. Node.js and pnpm paths are included when the payload provides them. Python includes numpy, pandas, python-docx, python-pptx, openpyxl, Pillow, lxml, and XlsxWriter. Use these libraries for Office files unless the user or workspace instructions select another environment. When Node.js and pnpm paths are returned, run pnpm with that Node executable and pnpm script path. This does not change PATH or package-manager settings.

tools.name: present
tools.description: Declare existing files as final deliverables for the user. Use it when the user needs a separate file, especially Office documents, spreadsheets, and slide decks; prefer your final response when that suffices. The user opens the current files; their contents are not copied.

files.description: Usually the 1-2 most important deliverables; at most 4 per call.

path.description: Path of an existing regular file. Relative paths use the Session working directory.

description.description: Brief description for the user.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file and return line-numbered content.

file_path.description: Path to read, resolved by the filesystem backend.

offset.description: 1-based first line to return. Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return. Defaults to 2000.

tools.name: read_image
tools.description: Read a PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF file and return the image itself. Large images are downscaled automatically; do not install image libraries or create thumbnails to inspect an image.

file_path.description: Path to the image file, resolved by the filesystem backend.

tools.name: schedule_create
tools.description: Create a reminder in the current session that delivers prompt when it becomes due. Supply exactly one timing parameter: after_seconds, at, every_seconds, daily, weekly, or cron. Local times that do not exist in the zone are skipped; repeated local times fire once, at the earlier instant. After downtime, a recurring reminder delivers only its latest missed occurrence. Delivery can repeat after a crash.

prompt.description: Reminder content to present when the target becomes due.

title.description: Concise task name in the user's language, at most 120 characters. Name only the core action and subject; keep essential target identifiers such as PR numbers and branch names. Do not include execution frequency (e.g. daily, hourly), scheduled dates/times, time zones, task status, or configuration and execution details (e.g. read-only mode, profile-tag filters), even when embedded in the requested or existing title. Do not append parenthetical notes. Put scheduling information in the timing parameters and execution instructions in prompt.

every_seconds.description: Fixed-rate interval in whole seconds, at least 60, aligned to the creation time; changing it with schedule_update re-aligns it to the save time.

daily.description: Every day at a local time.

time.description: HH:mm:ss with optional 1-3 fractional digits, for example 23:00:00.

time_zone.description: UTC or IANA Area/Location, for example Asia/Shanghai.

weekly.description: On the given weekdays at a local time.

time.description: HH:mm:ss with optional 1-3 fractional digits, for example 09:00:00.

time_zone.description: UTC or IANA Area/Location, for example Asia/Shanghai.

weekdays.description: ISO weekdays, Monday 1 through Sunday 7, without repetitions.

cron.description: Five-field Vixie cron expression in a time zone.

expression.description: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week, for example "*/15 9-17 * * 1-5". When both day fields are restricted, a date matches if either one matches.

time_zone.description: UTC or IANA Area/Location, for example Asia/Shanghai.

at.description: Absolute target: an RFC 3339 date-time with offset, or a local date, time, and IANA time_zone.

tools.name: schedule_delete
tools.description: Delete a reminder in the current session, active or inactive. Deletion does not retract a reminder message that is already queued.

tools.name: schedule_list
