# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Working Principles (user-mandated, 最高优先级)

用户时间与预算有限，**每个任务都必须为省时间/省 token 服务**：

- **最短路径**：只为当前任务做最小必要改动；不顺手重构、不新增无关文件、不写长篇注释或文档。
- **省 token 的读法**：先用 grep/glob 定位，再带 offset/limit 定点读；禁止重复整文件读取或整文件回显；改动优先用 edit，不要重写大文件。
- **少开 agent**：默认由 Lead 单独完成。只有当任务可拆成互不依赖的大块、且并行确实更快时才用 teammates；subagent 的上下文同样是成本。
- **验证从简**：本项目无测试套件，只做必要的最小验证（如 GDScript 语法/加载检查），不跑完整试玩流程，除非任务明确要求。
- **输出精简**：结论先行，只列改动点与验证结果，不复述代码。
- **任务完成必须弹 Windows 通知**：每次交付结束前执行
  `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`
  （脚本已就绪，失败会静默降级，不阻断交付）。

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

176: const _BRICK_CODE := """
177: shader_type spatial;
178: render_mode diffuse_burley, specular_schlick_ggx, cull_back;
179: 
180: uniform sampler2D detail_tex : filter_linear, repeat_enable;
181: uniform sampler2D normal_tex : filter_linear, repeat_enable;
182: uniform float map_half = 60.0;
183: uniform vec3 brick_a : source_color = vec3(0.455, 0.415, 0.355);
184: uniform vec3 brick_b : source_color = vec3(0.545, 0.495, 0.425);
185: uniform vec3 brick_c : source_color = vec3(0.360, 0.335, 0.300);
186: uniform vec3 mortar : source_color = vec3(0.180, 0.172, 0.158);
187: uniform vec3 moss : source_color = vec3(0.215, 0.265, 0.170);
188: uniform float brick_len = 0.78;
189: uniform float brick_wid = 0.40;
190: uniform float joint = 0.045;
191: 
192: varying vec3 wp;
193: 
194: float hash21(vec2 p) {
195: 	p = fract(p * vec2(123.34, 456.21));
196: 	p += dot(p, p + 45.32);
197: 	return fract(p.x * p.y);
198: }
199: 
200: void vertex() {
201: 	wp = (MODEL_MATRIX * vec4(VERTEX, 1.0)).xyz;
202: }
203: 
204: void fragment() {
205: 	// 错缝砖：按世界 XZ 坐标铺砖，行间半砖错位
206: 	float row = floor(wp.z / brick_wid);
207: 	float shift = mod(row, 2.0) * 0.5 * brick_len;
208: 	vec2 cell = vec2(floor((wp.x + shift) / brick_len), row);
209: 	vec2 f = vec2(fract((wp.x + shift) / brick_len), fract(wp.z / brick_wid));
210: 	// 到灰缝的距离（米）
211: 	vec2 dst = min(f, vec2(1.0) - f) * vec2(brick_len, brick_wid);
212: 	float edge = min(dst.x, dst.y);
213: 	float face = smoothstep(joint * 0.55, joint * 1.35, edge);
214: 	float h1 = hash21(cell);
215: 	float h2 = hash21(cell + vec2(11.3, 7.7));
216: 	// 砖面色：三种石色随机 + 逐砖明暗抖动
217: 	vec3 bc = mix(brick_a, brick_b, step(0.55, h1));
218: 	bc = mix(bc, brick_c, step(0.86, h1));
219: 	bc *= 0.90 + 0.20 * h2;
220: 	// 砖面细噪 + 磨损（局部变暗）
221: 	vec2 uv = wp.xz * 0.42;
222: 	float n = texture(detail_tex, uv).r;
223: 	float wear = texture(detail_tex, wp.xz * 0.11).r;
224: 	bc *= 0.82 + 0.30 * n;
225: 	// 边缘磨圆：靠近灰缝处压暗，砖有厚度感
226: 	float round_dark = mix(0.72, 1.0, smoothstep(0.0, joint * 2.2, edge));
227: 	bc *= round_dark;
228: 	// 灰缝里长苔：越靠缝越绿，且用低频噪声决定哪里长
229: 	float mossmask = (1.0 - face) * smoothstep(0.35, 0.72, wear);
230: 	vec3 mc = mix(mortar, moss, mossmask * 0.85);
231: 	ALBEDO = mix(mc, bc, face);
232: 	ROUGHNESS = mix(0.96, 0.80, face);
233: 	SPECULAR = 0.18;
234: 	// 砖面凹凸（细节法线）
235: 	vec3 nn2 = texture(normal_tex, wp.xz * 0.55).rgb;
236: 	NORMAL_MAP = mix(vec3(0.5, 0.5, 1.0), nn2, mix(0.25, 0.85, face));
237: 	NORMAL_MAP_DEPTH = 0.85;
238: 	// 让砖缝有一点自阴影
239: 	AO = mix(0.55, 1.0, smoothstep(0.0, joint * 2.6, edge));
240: 	AO_LIGHT_AFFECT = 0.35;
241: }
242: """

258: const _GROUND_CODE := """
259: shader_type spatial;
260: render_mode diffuse_burley, specular_schlick_ggx, cull_back;
261: 
262: uniform sampler2D layout_tex : filter_linear, repeat_disable;
263: uniform sampler2D detail_tex : filter_linear, repeat_enable;
264: uniform sampler2D normal_tex : filter_linear, repeat_enable, hint_normal;
265: uniform vec4 tint : source_color = vec4(1.0);
266: uniform vec4 emission_color : source_color = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
267: uniform float emission_strength = 0.0;
268: uniform float detail_scale = 14.0;
269: uniform float map_half = 60.0;
270: uniform float normal_strength = 0.35;
271: uniform float ground_roughness = 0.95;
272: uniform float bump_amount = 0.0;
273: 
274: varying vec3 wp;
275: 
276: void vertex() {
277: 	wp = (MODEL_MATRIX * vec4(VERTEX, 1.0)).xyz;
278: 	// 野区微地形起伏（只动野区，分路/河道/高地保持平）；纯视觉，实体仍踩 y=0
279: 	if (bump_amount > 0.001) {
280: 		float lane_d = min(min(abs(abs(wp.x) - 55.0), abs(abs(wp.z) - 55.0)), abs(wp.x + wp.z) * 0.7071068);
281: 		float lane_m = 1.0 - smoothstep(7.0, 13.0, lane_d);
282: 		float river_m = 1.0 - smoothstep(10.0, 15.0, abs(wp.x - wp.z) * 0.7071068);
283: 		float hg_m = 1.0 - smoothstep(30.0, 38.0, min(length(wp.xz + vec2(60.0, -60.0)), length(wp.xz - vec2(60.0, -60.0))));
284: 		float edge_m = 1.0 - smoothstep(56.0, 70.0, max(abs(wp.x), abs(wp.z)));
285: 		float jungle_m = clamp(1.0 - lane_m - river_m - hg_m, 0.0, 1.0) * edge_m;
286: 		float n = sin(wp.x * 0.34) * cos(wp.z * 0.29) * 0.65 + sin(wp.x * 0.81 + 1.7) * cos(wp.z * 0.67 - 0.9) * 0.35;
287: 		VERTEX.y += n * bump_amount * jungle_m;
288: 	}
289: }
290: 
291: void fragment() {
292: 	// 世界坐标采样布局图：所有地面平面共用一张图，平面之间天然无缝
293: 	vec2 luv = clamp((wp.xz + vec2(map_half)) / vec2(map_half * 2.0), vec2(0.0), vec2(1.0));
294: 	vec2 duv = wp.xz * (detail_scale / (map_half * 2.0));
295: 	// 运行时生成的贴图没有 sRGB 标记，手动转线性，避免整片发白
296: 	vec3 base = pow(texture(layout_tex, luv).rgb, vec3(2.2));
297: 	vec3 det = texture(detail_tex, duv).rgb;
298: 	base *= mix(vec3(1.0), det, 0.55);
299: 	ALBEDO = base * tint.rgb;
300: 	NORMAL_MAP = texture(normal_tex, duv).rgb;
301: 	NORMAL_MAP_DEPTH = normal_strength;
302: 	ROUGHNESS = ground_roughness;
303: 	SPECULAR = 0.25;
304: 	EMISSION = emission_color.rgb * emission_strength;
305: }
306: """

308: const _WATER_CODE := """
309: shader_type spatial;
310: render_mode diffuse_burley, specular_schlick_ggx, cull_back;
311: 
312: // 不透明水面（见 water_material 注释）：用「波高场 → 有限差分法线 + 菲涅尔天空反射 +
313: // 岸边泡沫 + 顺流闪点」伪造真实水面，比纯色 + 正弦好很多，且不开透明、不破坏贴地特效排序。
314: uniform vec3 shallow_color : source_color = vec3(0.24, 0.56, 0.57);
315: uniform vec3 deep_color : source_color = vec3(0.035, 0.125, 0.185);
316: uniform vec3 foam_color : source_color = vec3(0.88, 0.95, 0.93);
317: uniform vec3 sky_color : source_color = vec3(0.42, 0.60, 0.80);
318: uniform float map_half = 60.0;
319: uniform float wave_strength = 0.040;
320: 
321: varying vec3 wp;
322: 
323: // 四组不同方向/频率的波叠加；沿河方向 (1,1)/√2 有整体推移感
324: float waves(vec2 p, float t) {
325: 	float a = sin(dot(p, vec2(0.80, -0.60)) * 1.35 + t * 0.95);
326: 	a += 0.55 * sin(dot(p, vec2(-0.62, -0.78)) * 2.40 - t * 1.30);
327: 	a += 0.28 * sin(dot(p, vec2(0.97, 0.24)) * 4.60 + t * 2.00);
328: 	a += 0.14 * sin(dot(p, vec2(-0.36, 0.93)) * 8.20 - t * 2.80);
329: 	return a * 0.55;
330: }
331: 
332: // 波高场解析梯度（省两次采样，移动端更省；用于算水面法线）
333: vec2 waves_grad(vec2 p, float t) {
334: 	vec2 d1 = vec2(0.80, -0.60);
335: 	vec2 d2 = vec2(-0.62, -0.78);
336: 	vec2 d3 = vec2(0.97, 0.24);
337: 	vec2 d4 = vec2(-0.36, 0.93);
338: 	vec2 g = cos(dot(p, d1) * 1.35 + t * 0.95) * d1 * 1.35;
339: 	g += 0.55 * cos(dot(p, d2) * 2.40 - t * 1.30) * d2 * 2.40;
340: 	g += 0.28 * cos(dot(p, d3) * 4.60 + t * 2.00) * d3 * 4.60;
341: 	g += 0.14 * cos(dot(p, d4) * 8.20 - t * 2.80) * d4 * 8.20;
342: 	return g * 0.55;
343: }
344: 
345: void vertex() {
346: 	wp = (MODEL_MATRIX * vec4(VERTEX, 1.0)).xyz;
347: 	// 只向上起伏：水面不会被地面吞掉（水面本身只比地面高 0.02）
348: 	VERTEX.y += (waves(wp.xz, TIME) * 0.5 + 0.5) * wave_strength;
349: }
350: 
351: void fragment() {
352: 	vec2 p = wp.xz;
353: 	float t = TIME;
354: 	// 河道沿 (-60,-60)→(60,60) 对角线：d=垂直河心距离(0..10)，along=顺流坐标
355: 	float d = abs(p.x - p.y) * 0.70710678;
356: 	float along = (p.x + p.y) * 0.70710678;
357: 
358: 	// 法线：波高场解析梯度（世界空间 → 视图空间），让高光/天空反射随波起伏
359: 	float h0 = waves(p, t);
360: 	vec2 grad = waves_grad(p, t);
361: 	vec3 n = normalize(vec3(-grad.x * 0.45, 1.0, -grad.y * 0.45));
362: 	vec3 n_view = normalize((VIEW_MATRIX * vec4(n, 0.0)).xyz);
363: 	NORMAL = n_view;
364: 
365: 	// 顺流闪点：高频细纹被慢波调制，形成水光粼粼
366: 	float sparkle = sin(along * 6.0 - t * 2.1 + sin(d * 5.0 + t * 0.8) * 2.0) * 0.5 + 0.5;
367: 	sparkle = smoothstep(0.80, 1.0, sparkle);
368: 
369: 	// 深浅：河心深、近岸浅，叠顺流明暗带
370: 	float center = 1.0 - smoothstep(3.0, 9.2, d);
371: 	float streak = sin(along * 3.4 - t * 1.5 + sin(d * 2.3) * 1.4) * 0.5 + 0.5;
372: 	vec3 col = mix(shallow_color, deep_color, center * 0.95);
373: 	col *= 0.86 + 0.20 * streak;
374: 
375: 	// 岸边泡沫：贴岸窄带上随波推进的泡沫 + 湿沙高光（只占岸边一条，别糊满水面）
376: 	float foam_wave = sin(d * 5.4 - t * 2.4 + sin(along * 1.1 + t * 0.6) * 1.6) * 0.5 + 0.5;
377: 	float shore = smoothstep(7.8, 9.0, d) * (1.0 - smoothstep(9.7, 10.05, d));
378: 	float foam = smoothstep(0.55, 0.95, foam_wave) * shore;
379: 	float wet_line = smoothstep(9.1, 9.55, d) * (1.0 - smoothstep(9.75, 10.1, d));
380: 	col = mix(col, foam_color, clamp(foam * 0.55, 0.0, 1.0));
381: 	col = mix(col, foam_color, wet_line * 0.30);
382: 	col += vec3(0.09, 0.13, 0.14) * sparkle;
383: 
384: 	// 菲涅尔：掠射角染天空色，像真实水面反射天光（强度收敛，别把水面洗成天空色）
385: 	float fres = pow(1.0 - clamp(dot(n_view, VIEW), 0.0, 1.0), 5.0);
386: 	col = mix(col, sky_color, clamp(fres * 0.42, 0.0, 0.42));
387: 
388: 	ALBEDO = col;
389: 	ROUGHNESS = mix(0.035, 0.20, smoothstep(0.15, 1.0, h0 * 0.5 + 0.5));
390: 	SPECULAR = 0.78;
391: 	METALLIC = 0.0;
392: 	EMISSION = vec3(0.02, 0.09, 0.10) * (0.35 + 0.45 * center);
393: }
394: """

508: # ================= 布局贴图绘制 =================
509: 
510: static func _paint_layout() -> Image:
511: 	var size := LAYOUT_SIZE
512: 	var img := Image.create_empty(size, size, false, Image.FORMAT_RGB8)
513: 	var grass := FastNoiseLite.new()
514: 	grass.seed = 7
515: 	grass.noise_type = FastNoiseLite.TYPE_SIMPLEX_SMOOTH
516: 	grass.frequency = 0.045
517: 	var patch := FastNoiseLite.new()
518: 	patch.seed = 31
519: 	patch.noise_type = FastNoiseLite.TYPE_SIMPLEX_SMOOTH
520: 	patch.frequency = 0.016
521: 	for py in size:
522: 		for px in size:
523: 			var x: float = (float(px) + 0.5) / float(size) * MAP_HALF * 2.0 - MAP_HALF
524: 			var z: float = (float(py) + 0.5) / float(size) * MAP_HALF * 2.0 - MAP_HALF
525: 			var n: float = grass.get_noise_2d(x, z) * 0.5 + 0.5          # 0..1 细噪声
526: 			var pt: float = patch.get_noise_2d(x, z) * 0.5 + 0.5         # 0..1 大斑块
527: 
528: 			# 1) 野区草地基底（深浅变化 + 大块阴影）
529: 			var col := Color(0.17, 0.31, 0.14).lerp(Color(0.33, 0.48, 0.21), n)
530: 			col = col.lerp(Color(0.11, 0.20, 0.11), pt * 0.45)
531: 
532: 			# 2) 河道河床（沿 x-z=0 对角线与中路垂直；比草地暗、偏青灰）
533: 			var river_d: float = absf(x - z) * 0.70710678
534: 			col = col.lerp(Color(0.22, 0.28, 0.29).lerp(Color(0.30, 0.36, 0.34), n), _inside(river_d, 13.0, 3.0))
535: 
536: 			# 3) 三路（土黄石路，双色噪声 + 路缘更深）
537: 			var lane: float = _lane_mask(x, z)
538: 			if lane > 0.001:
539: 				var dirt := Color(0.44, 0.40, 0.30).lerp(Color(0.56, 0.51, 0.38), n)
540: 				col = col.lerp(dirt, lane)
541: 				var rim: float = _lane_rim(x, z)
542: 				if rim > 0.001:
543: 					col = col.lerp(Color(0.25, 0.24, 0.19), rim * 0.55)
544: 
545: 			# 4) 高地 / 基地台座（石砖，最后绘制盖住河道与路）
546: 			var hg: float = _high_ground_mask(x, z)
547: 			if hg > 0.001:
548: 				var stone := Color(0.40, 0.42, 0.36).lerp(Color(0.55, 0.56, 0.48), n)
549: 				col = col.lerp(stone, hg * 0.92)
550: 
551: 			# 5) 地图边缘变暗（远景承接雾色，避免看到"断崖"）
552: 			var edge_d: float = maxf(absf(x), absf(z))
553: 			col = col.darkened(clampf((edge_d - 48.0) / 14.0, 0.0, 0.4))
554: 			img.set_pixel(px, py, col)
555: 	return img
556: 
557: # 距离场软边：d 在 half±feather 之间平滑过渡
558: static func _inside(d: float, half: float, feather: float) -> float:
559: 	return 1.0 - smoothstep(half - feather, half + feather, d)
560: 
561: # 三路覆盖度（0..1，软边）：四边路 + 中路对角线（x+z=0 方向，与 _is_on_lane 一致）
562: static func _lane_mask(x: float, z: float) -> float:
563: 	var m := 0.0
564: 	var along_z: float = _inside(absf(z), 44.0, 5.0)   # 竖向路长度（±40 再加软边）
565: 	var along_x: float = _inside(absf(x), 44.0, 5.0)
566: 	m = maxf(m, _inside(absf(absf(x) - 55.0), 8.0, 3.0) * along_z)
567: 	m = maxf(m, _inside(absf(absf(z) - 55.0), 8.0, 3.0) * along_x)
568: 	m = maxf(m, _inside(absf(x + z) * 0.70710678, 7.5, 2.5))
569: 	return m
570: 
571: # 路缘（路两侧 1.5 单位内的暗边）
572: static func _lane_rim(x: float, z: float) -> float:
573: 	var m := 0.0
574: 	var along_z: float = _inside(absf(z), 44.0, 5.0)
575: 	var along_x: float = _inside(absf(x), 44.0, 5.0)
576: 	m = maxf(m, _inside(absf(absf(absf(x) - 55.0) - 9.5), 1.6, 1.2) * along_z)
577: 	m = maxf(m, _inside(absf(absf(absf(z) - 55.0) - 9.5), 1.6, 1.2) * along_x)
578: 	m = maxf(m, _inside(absf(absf(x + z) * 0.70710678 - 9.0), 1.6, 1.2))
579: 	return m
580: 
581: # 高地/基地石材区域：以 (-60,60) 与 (60,-60) 为圆心、半径 35 的扇形范围
582: static func _high_ground_mask(x: float, z: float) -> float:
583: 	var d1: float = Vector2(x + 60.0, z - 60.0).length()
584: 	var d2: float = Vector2(x - 60.0, z + 60.0).length()
585: 	var m: float = maxf(_inside(d1, 34.0, 4.0), _inside(d2, 34.0, 4.0))
586: 	return m
587: 
588: # ================= 装饰物散布（MultiMesh） =================
589: 
590: static func scatter_decorations(parent: Node3D) -> void:
591: 	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
592: 	rng.seed = 20261029
593: 
594: 	# --- 草丛：野区内成片铺，避开路面/河道/高地 ---
595: 	var grass_xf: Array[Transform3D] = []
596: 	var attempts := 0
597: 	while grass_xf.size() < 360 and attempts < 2400:
598: 		attempts += 1
599: 		var gx: float = rng.randf_range(-56.0, 56.0)
600: 		var gz: float = rng.randf_range(-56.0, 56.0)
601: 		if not _open_ground(gx, gz):
602: 			continue
603: 		var rot: float = rng.randf_range(0.0, TAU)
604: 		var basis := Basis(Vector3.UP, rot)
605: 		grass_xf.append(Transform3D(basis, Vector3(gx, 0.0, gz)))
606: 	var grass := _make_cluster("res://model/grass/grass-large.glb", grass_xf, 1.1, false, DecorMesh.grass_mesh(), DecorMesh.leaf_material())
607: 	if grass != null:
608: 		grass.name = "GrassDecor"
609: 		parent.add_child(grass)
610: 
611: 	# --- 河道两岸石墙：河道沿 x-z=0，两岸在 x-z=±15（垂直距约 10.6），朝向与河道一致 ---
612: 	var wall_xf: Array[Transform3D] = []
613: 	for i in range(-40, 41, 7):
614: 		var s: float = float(i)
615: 		for side in [-1.0, 1.0]:
616: 			var wx: float = s + 7.5 * side
617: 			var wz: float = s - 7.5 * side
618: 			if absf(wx) > 55.0 or absf(wz) > 55.0:
619: 				continue
620: 			# 中路桥面两侧不放墙
621: 			if _lane_mask(wx, wz) > 0.05 or _high_ground_mask(wx, wz) > 0.05:
622: 				continue
623: 			wall_xf.append(Transform3D(Basis(Vector3.UP, -PI * 0.25), Vector3(wx, 0.0, wz)))
624: 	var walls := _make_cluster("res://model/wall/wall.glb", wall_xf, 1.5, true, DecorMesh.wall_mesh(), DecorMesh.rock_material())
625: 	if walls != null:
626: 		walls.name = "RiverWallDecor"
627: 		parent.add_child(walls)
628: 
629: 	# --- 陶罐点缀（基地附近） ---
630: 	var pot_xf: Array[Transform3D] = []
631: 	var pot_spots := [
632: 		Vector3(-46, 0, 46), Vector3(-42, 0, 52), Vector3(-52, 0, 40),
633: 		Vector3(46, 0, -46), Vector3(42, 0, -52), Vector3(52, 0, -40),
634: 		Vector3(-50, 0, -30), Vector3(30, 0, 50), Vector3(50, 0, 30), Vector3(-30, 0, -50),
635: 	]
636: 	for p in pot_spots:
637: 		if not _open_ground(p.x, p.z, 3.0):
638: 			continue
639: 		pot_xf.append(Transform3D(Basis(Vector3.UP, rng.randf_range(0.0, TAU)), Vector3(p.x, 0.0, p.z)))
640: 	var pots := _make_cluster("res://model/pot/pot.glb", pot_xf, 0.9, true)
641: 	if pots != null:
642: 		pots.name = "PotDecor"
643: 		parent.add_child(pots)
644: 
645: # 是否是可摆放装饰的开阔地（野区，不在路面/河道/高地/外围）
646: static func _open_ground(x: float, z: float, extra: float = 0.0) -> bool:
647: 	if absf(x) > 57.0 or absf(z) > 57.0:
648: 		return false
649: 	if _lane_mask(x, z) > 0.05:
650: 		return false
651: 	if absf(x - z) * 0.70710678 < 12.5 + extra:   # 河道（x-z=0 对角线两侧）
652: 		return false
653: 	if _high_ground_mask(x, z) > 0.05:
654: 		return false
655: 	return true
656: 
657: static func _make_cluster(path: String, xforms: Array[Transform3D], target_height: float, cast_shadow: bool, mesh_override: Mesh = null, mat: Material = null) -> MultiMeshInstance3D:
658: 	if xforms.is_empty():
659: 		return null
660: 	var mesh: Mesh = mesh_override if mesh_override != null else _load_first_mesh(path)
661: 	if mesh == null:
662: 		return null
663: 	var aabb := mesh.get_aabb()
664: 	var scale_f: float = target_height / maxf(aabb.size.y, 0.001)
665: 	var mm := MultiMesh.new()
666: 	mm.transform_format = MultiMesh.TRANSFORM_3D
667: 	mm.mesh = mesh
668: 	mm.instance_count = xforms.size()
669: 	for i in xforms.size():
670: 		var t: Transform3D = xforms[i]
671: 		mm.set_instance_transform(i, Transform3D(t.basis.scaled(Vector3.ONE * scale_f), t.origin))
672: 	var mmi := MultiMeshInstance3D.new()
673: 	mmi.multimesh = mm
674: 	mmi.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_ON if cast_shadow else GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
675: 	if mat != null:
676: 		mmi.material_override = mat
677: 	return mmi
678: 
679: static func _load_first_mesh(path: String) -> Mesh:
680: 	if not ResourceLoader.exists(path):
681: 		return null
682: 	var res := load(path)
683: 	if res == null or not (res is PackedScene):
684: 		return null
685: 	var inst: Node = (res as PackedScene).instantiate()
686: 	var mesh := _find_mesh(inst)
687: 	inst.free()
688: 	return mesh
689: 
690: static func _find_mesh(node: Node) -> Mesh:
691: 	if node is MeshInstance3D:
692: 		var mi := node as MeshInstance3D
693: 		if mi.mesh != null:
694: 			return mi.mesh
695: 	for c in node.get_children():
696: 		var m := _find_mesh(c)
697: 		if m != null:
698: 			return m
699: 	return null

lines.text: ## 王者峡谷地面视觉层（不改任何 gameplay 逻辑，只换材质/光照/装饰）
## 1. 程序化「布局贴图」：草地/土路/高地砖石/河道一次画好，所有地面平面共用同一张图、
##    按世界坐标采样 → 平面之间没有硬接缝（原先是纯色 PlaneMesh 拼硬边）
## 2. 噪声细节贴图 + 法线贴图：近看有材质层次，不再像塑料板
## 3. 环境：天空盒 + 天空环境光 + ACES 色调映射 + 深度雾 + 暖阳光/冷补光
## 4. 装饰：现成 glb（草/墙/罐）用 MultiMesh 批量铺，移动端友好
## 5. 河道水面 shader：波高场解析法线 + 菲涅尔天空反射 + 顺流闪点 + 贴岸泡沫；
##    两岸另有湿沙滩、半浸礁石、芦苇、睡莲（MultiMesh）
## 注意：project.godot 用 rendering_method="mobile"，SSAO/SSIL/体积雾不可用。
# 只保留中高频光晕，避免整个画面发灰（层级 1..7）
# 2 级级联 + 60m 视距：同性能下阴影更锐利（4 级级联在 90m 上摊薄了纹素）
# 冷色补光（无阴影，提亮背光面）
# 高地/基地台座：石砖铺装（错缝砖块 + 灰缝 + 苔痕），与其他石质建筑同族
// 错缝砖：按世界 XZ 坐标铺砖，行间半砖错位
vec2 cell = vec2(floor((wp.x + shift) / brick_len), row);
vec2 f = vec2(fract((wp.x + shift) / brick_len), fract(wp.z / brick_wid));
vec2 dst = min(f, vec2(1.0) - f) * vec2(brick_len, brick_wid);
// 砖面色：三种石色随机 + 逐砖明暗抖动
vec3 bc = mix(brick_a, brick_b, step(0.55, h1));
// 砖面细噪 + 磨损（局部变暗）
// 边缘磨圆：靠近灰缝处压暗，砖有厚度感
float round_dark = mix(0.72, 1.0, smoothstep(0.0, joint * 2.2, edge));
// 灰缝里长苔：越靠缝越绿，且用低频噪声决定哪里长
uniform sampler2D normal_tex : filter_linear, repeat_enable, hint_normal;
// 野区微地形起伏（只动野区，分路/河道/高地保持平）；纯视觉，实体仍踩 y=0
float lane_d = min(min(abs(abs(wp.x) - 55.0), abs(abs(wp.z) - 55.0)), abs(wp.x + wp.z) * 0.7071068);
float hg_m = 1.0 - smoothstep(30.0, 38.0, min(length(wp.xz + vec2(60.0, -60.0)), length(wp.xz - vec2(60.0, -60.0))));
float jungle_m = clamp(1.0 - lane_m - river_m - hg_m, 0.0, 1.0) * edge_m;
// 世界坐标采样布局图：所有地面平面共用一张图，平面之间天然无缝
vec2 luv = clamp((wp.xz + vec2(map_half)) / vec2(map_half * 2.0), vec2(0.0), vec2(1.0));
// 运行时生成的贴图没有 sRGB 标记，手动转线性，避免整片发白
// 不透明水面（见 water_material 注释）：用「波高场 → 有限差分法线 + 菲涅尔天空反射 +

		return
	var fwd := -cam.global_transform.basis.z
	fwd.y = 0.0
	if fwd.length_squared() < 0.000001:
		return
	fwd = fwd.normalized()
	# 相机水平朝向：Godot 里 yaw 旋转的 forward = (-sin yaw, 0, -cos yaw)
	var yaw := rad_to_deg(atan2(-fwd.x, -fwd.z))
	_sun_light.rotation_degrees = Vector3(-SUN_ELEVATION_DEG, yaw + 180.0, 0.0)
	if _fill_light != null and is_instance_valid(_fill_light):
		_fill_light.rotation_degrees = Vector3(-FILL_ELEVATION_DEG, yaw, 0.0)

Potential **light elevation** actual sun_dir y -0.615 => elevation 38; fill y -0.375 =>22. Good.
- `sun_h_dot` -0.5 because camera pitch; actual horizontal opposite; fine.
- **Backlight exactly horizontal**; good.

Need maybe visual screenshot to ensure not too dark. Could run game windowed and take screenshot with Godot? We can use a script to render viewport to image and save; then inspect image. This would be valuable for "增强立体效果" visual. Need full BattleManager scene screenshot after selecting? Could just capture select screen or gameplay? Battle starts hero select; lighting on map background behind select not visible. Could programmatically start game? `_start_game` requires selections; too much. Could capture **hero preview**? Not.

Alternative create a test scene with BattleManager? Full battle select UI covers; not useful. Could use `battle.tscn` and simulate starting game via methods; possible but time. The lighting change compile and math validated; likely okay.

Need **sun light color** warm orange; backlight rim warm; fine.
- `fog_light_color` cool; sun scatter; atmospheric.

Potential issue **DirectionalLight3D shadow orientation with sun horizontal opposite camera**: shadows cast towards camera, good.
- **Shadow max distance 60** at low sun, long shadows might clip; okay.

Need **select screen camera** `cam` rotation -60,0; sun default yaw180; backlit. Hero preview uses SubViewport camera with own environment? likely separate; not affected. Good.

Need maybe **first-person** backlight: camera pitch0, sun elevation38 in front; the sun disk could be visible in first person and cause bright glow; maybe fine (逆光). If sun behind horizon? no, elevation38 above horizon. In first person horizon visible; sun at 38° above horizon, can be seen; strong backlight. Good.

Need cleanup temp probe files and run final compile.

content.text:
Bug? Close click: RosterView `_gui_input` emits `closed_by_user` (which calls toggle_hero_detail, hiding panel + dim, toggles visible false), then calls `UiKit.hide_panel(self, 0.12)` and sets `visible=false`. The dim is also connected to `toggle_hero_detail`; but `RosterView` covers full rect and STOP, so click outside panel is handled by RosterView and emits close; dim is behind, not receive. Fine.

Why reopen after a while? Could be **UiKit.show_panel/hide_panel tween** race: close emits `toggle_hero_detail` which calls `UiKit.hide_panel(hero_detail_panel,0.12)`, then RosterView's own `UiKit.hide_panel(self,0.12)`; duplicate no reopen.

Maybe **auto-refresh** `_refresh_hero_detail_panel` calls `set_rows`, and `RosterView.set_rows` has:
```
if not visible:
    visible = true
    UiKit.show_panel(self,0.15)
```
If `hero_detail_visible` is true after close? Let's see close flow:
1. Click close → `closed_by_user.emit()` triggers `toggle_hero_detail()` **synchronously**.
2. `hero_detail_visible = !true = false`; hide panel/dim.
3. Return to RosterView, `hide_panel`, `visible=false`.
So state false.
But **dim tap**? no.

"过一会" might be **C key repeat**: User clicks close then maybe later presses C? But says automatically after a while, no key. Could be **UI refresh timer** invoking `_refresh_hero_detail_panel` while `hero_detail_visible` is false should return at 2620. Check.

lines.text: ## 王者峡谷地面视觉层（不改任何 gameplay 逻辑，只换材质/光照/装饰）
## 1. 程序化「布局贴图」：草地/土路/高地砖石/河道一次画好，所有地面平面共用同一张图、
##    按世界坐标采样 → 平面之间没有硬接缝（原先是纯色 PlaneMesh 拼硬边）
## 2. 噪声细节贴图 + 法线贴图：近看有材质层次，不再像塑料板
## 3. 环境：天空盒 + 天空环境光 + ACES 色调映射 + 深度雾 + 暖阳光/冷补光
## 4. 装饰：现成 glb（草/墙/罐）用 MultiMesh 批量铺，移动端友好
## 5. 河道水面 shader：波高场解析法线 + 菲涅尔天空反射 + 顺流闪点 + 贴岸泡沫；
##    两岸另有湿沙滩、半浸礁石、芦苇、睡莲（MultiMesh）
## 注意：project.godot 用 rendering_method="mobile"，SSAO/SSIL/体积雾不可用。
# 只保留中高频光晕，避免整个画面发灰（层级 1..7）
# 2 级级联 + 60m 视距：同性能下阴影更锐利（4 级级联在 90m 上摊薄了纹素）
# 冷色补光（无阴影，提亮背光面）
# 高地/基地台座：石砖铺装（错缝砖块 + 灰缝 + 苔痕），与其他石质建筑同族
// 错缝砖：按世界 XZ 坐标铺砖，行间半砖错位
vec2 cell = vec2(floor((wp.x + shift) / brick_len), row);
vec2 f = vec2(fract((wp.x + shift) / brick_len), fract(wp.z / brick_wid));
vec2 dst = min(f, vec2(1.0) - f) * vec2(brick_len, brick_wid);
// 砖面色：三种石色随机 + 逐砖明暗抖动
vec3 bc = mix(brick_a, brick_b, step(0.55, h1));
// 砖面细噪 + 磨损（局部变暗）
// 边缘磨圆：靠近灰缝处压暗，砖有厚度感
float round_dark = mix(0.72, 1.0, smoothstep(0.0, joint * 2.2, edge));
// 灰缝里长苔：越靠缝越绿，且用低频噪声决定哪里长
uniform sampler2D normal_tex : filter_linear, repeat_enable, hint_normal;
// 野区微地形起伏（只动野区，分路/河道/高地保持平）；纯视觉，实体仍踩 y=0
float lane_d = min(min(abs(abs(wp.x) - 55.0), abs(abs(wp.z) - 55.0)), abs(wp.x + wp.z) * 0.7071068);
float hg_m = 1.0 - smoothstep(30.0, 38.0, min(length(wp.xz + vec2(60.0, -60.0)), length(wp.xz - vec2(60.0, -60.0))));
float jungle_m = clamp(1.0 - lane_m - river_m - hg_m, 0.0, 1.0) * edge_m;
// 世界坐标采样布局图：所有地面平面共用一张图，平面之间天然无缝
vec2 luv = clamp((wp.xz + vec2(map_half)) / vec2(map_half * 2.0), vec2(0.0), vec2(1.0));
// 运行时生成的贴图没有 sRGB 标记，手动转线性，避免整片发白
// 不透明水面（见 water_material 注释）：用「波高场 → 有限差分法线 + 菲涅尔天空反射 +
// 岸边泡沫 + 顺流闪点」伪造真实水面，比纯色 + 正弦好很多，且不开透明、不破坏贴地特效排序。

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

## Primary Request and Intent
- Latest active user request: `"我发现打开全局英雄信息面板后点击关闭，过一会此面板居然又自动弹出了"`
- Intent: diagnose and fix the global hero info panel (RosterView) reopening itself shortly after the user closes it.
- Previous completed requests (do not regress):
  - Hero-select skill hover tooltip must show concrete numeric detail (`"修改选择英雄界面：鼠标悬浮在技能上时需要显示技能的详细信息，具体到数值"`) — completed.
  - Lighting must be exactly backlit relative to camera (`"为了增强立体效果，请把光照改为相机视角下正好逆光"`) — completed.
  - Earlier: teleport portal / exp-orb visuals; fixed `libai_w_ring` and `shen_preview` `MeshInstance3D` → `Node3D`; redesigned 14 hero status bars in `HeroInfoControl.gd`.
- Every delivery must end with:
  `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`

## Key Technical Concepts
- Godot 4.7.2 / GDScript, Forward+/mobile renderer; procedural visuals; no test suite; no git.

  `D:\Downloads\06_游戏与Flash资源\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe`
- CWD: `C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king`.
- Validation command:
  `& $godot --headless --path . --quit-after 30 res://scenes/battle.tscn`
  scan for `SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error|Compile Error|Invalid call|Invalid access|Cannot infer|Identifier not found|Trying to assign|Invalid assignment|Nonexistent function`.
- Godot headless script cache can emit transient false parse errors (e.g. `_update_regen_fx()` / `_melee_weapon_fx()` not found) when scenes run back-to-back; wait 3–7 seconds and rerun resolves it.
- UI Manager is autoload `UiManager`; global hero panel is `RosterView` (`hero_detail_panel`) plus `hero_detail_dim` ColorRect overlay.
- Hero-select skill tooltip uses `SkillDatabase.get_skill_icon_damage(hero, i)` and `SkillDatabase.get_skill_fx(hero, i)` against a naked level-1 `Hero` probe, giving true numeric formulas and per-skill-level values.
- Lighting: `DirectionalLight3D` emits along local `-Z`; to backlight relative to a camera, set sun yaw = camera horizontal yaw + 180° with negative pitch, fill yaw = camera yaw.

  - `_input()` ~2779: `KEY_C: toggle_hero_detail()` without checking `event.echo`.

  - Has a `show()` / open path lines ~52–54 using `UiKit.show_panel`.

  - new static vars:
    ```gdscript
    static var _sun_light: DirectionalLight3D
    static var _fill_light: DirectionalLight3D
    const SUN_ELEVATION_DEG := 38.0
    const FILL_ELEVATION_DEG := 22.0
    ```
  - `setup_environment()` sun now named `SunBacklight`, rotation `Vector3(-38,180,0)`, energy 2.35, warm color `(1.0,0.93,0.80)`; fill named `CameraFill`, rotation `Vector3(-22,0,0)`, energy 0.58, cool color `(0.58,0.68,0.95)`; assigns static refs.
  - new function:
    ```gdscript
    static func update_backlight_for_camera(cam: Camera3D) -> void:
        if cam == null or _sun_light == null or not is_instance_valid(_sun_light):
            return
        var fwd := -cam.global_transform.basis.z
        fwd.y = 0.0
        if fwd.length_squared() < 0.000001:
            return
        fwd = fwd.normalized()
        var yaw := rad_to_deg(atan2(-fwd.x, -fwd.z))
        _sun_light.rotation_degrees = Vector3(-SUN_ELEVATION_DEG, yaw + 180.0, 0.0)
        if _fill_light != null and is_instance_valid(_fill_light):
            _fill_light.rotation_degrees = Vector3(-FILL_ELEVATION_DEG, yaw, 0.0)
    ```

  ```gdscript

  MapVisuals.update_backlight_for_camera(cam)

      return
  ```

    - `_skill_tip_max_level(idx)`: returns 1 for idx>=3; else `Hero.SKILL_MAX_LEVEL` (idx<2) / `Hero.ULTIMATE_MAX_LEVEL`.
    - `_skill_tip_damage_at`, `_skill_tip_fmt_damage`, `_skill_tip_raw_damage`, `_skill_tip_damage_text`.
    - `_skill_tip_fx`, `_skill_tip_effect_text`, `_skill_tip_raw_effects`.
    - `_build_skill_tip_lines(sk, idx) -> Array` builds type/CD/mana, damage 1→max, count, 1/max effects, texts, shield, restore, ranges, duration.
    - `_show_skill_tip(sk, idx)` UI wrapper; tooltip size `(430,0)`, body `(390,0)`.
    - skill chips: child `row`/glyph/info/labels set `MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE`; chip stays `STOP`; `mouse_entered`/`mouse_exited` bound.
- `scripts/net/NetClientBattle.gd` — backlight call after `_update_camera()`:
  ```gdscript
  _update_camera()
  # 逆光：主光始终在相机水平正前方，补光在相机后方（与 host BattleManager 同源）
  MapVisuals.update_backlight_for_camera(_cam)
  ```
- `scripts/ui/HeroInfoControl.gd` — prior status-bar redesign; do not regress.
- `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` — `get_skill_icon_damage(hero, i)` at line 1858; `get_skill_fx(hero, i)` at 2052; per-hero hardcoded formulas.
- `assets/Skill.gd` — fields; `is_channeling` is set true by `get_skill()` for types 1/3/4, so tooltip no longer displays it.
- `scripts/core/BattleManager.gd` hero configs around 2355+; `兰陵王` has 4 skills (`lanling_stealth` as idx 3).

## Errors and Fixes
- `Function "_update_regen_fx()" not found in base self` and `_melee_weapon_fx()` false parse errors in headless runs: transient Godot script cache issue; rerun after 4–7 seconds gives 0 errors. Functions actually exist (`_update_regen_fx` at Hero.gd 3984).
- Tooltip initially showed false `引导施法` for all type 1/3/4 skills because `get_skill()` sets `is_channeling`; removed line from tooltip.
- Tooltip showed wrong `回复 1` for 马超 R (`restore=1` = stored charges); changed to `可存储 %d 层（满级 %d 层）`.
- Tooltip showed misleading `护盾 1000` for 太乙 R; raw shield suppressed for skill name `"大变活人"` (actual revive handled via fx/text).
- `_skill_tip_fx` probe `Hero.new()` works outside tree; UI probe confirmed `VISIBLE=true`, body and tooltip size correct.
- Probe scripts initially had parse errors (`max_lv` type inference; Node vs Node3D); fixed, then temp files deleted.
- `restore` and `shield_amount` fields may be inaccurate; fx/text take precedence.

## Pending Jobs
- Fix global hero info panel auto-reopening after close.
- Likely causes to check: `RosterView.closed_by_user` connected directly to `toggle_hero_detail` (toggle state can desync with actual `visible`); close tap may also propagate to underlying `team_stats_bg`/`time_chip` handlers; `_input` does not ignore key auto-repeat (`event.echo`); delayed `UiKit.hide_panel` tween vs `closed_by_user` duplicate emissions; touch/mouse tap helper may defer events.
- After fix validate `battle.tscn` and `net_client.tscn`, then send notification.

## Current Work
- Just inspected:
  - `UI_Manager.toggle_hero_detail()` and `_create_hero_detail_panel()`.
  - `RosterView` close logic lines 312–343 and `closed_by_user` emissions.
- No edit made yet for the auto-reappear bug.
- Lighting + tooltip work is complete and compiled cleanly:
  `battle.tscn EXIT=0 ERRS=0`, `net_client.tscn EXIT=0 ERRS=0`.

## Next Step
- Read the full `RosterView` close/tap implementation (`scripts/ui/RosterView.gd` around 300–350) and `_connect_tap_to_action` in `UI_Manager.gd`, then make closing idempotent: use explicit `open_hero_detail()` / `close_hero_detail()` or change signal handling to set `hero_detail_visible=false` directly, prevent duplicate toggle from background propagation, and ignore `event.echo` for `KEY_C`.

## Critical Context
- User explicitly reports reopening after a delay, not immediately; likely a duplicated toggle/close signal or delayed input event, not a refresh timer (refresh only runs when visible).
- `toggle_hero_detail()` currently flips state blindly, so any second `closed_by_user`/tap event reopens the panel.
- `RosterView._gui_input` emits `closed_by_user` when clicking outside or close rect, then hides; `UiKit.hide_panel` tween plus direct `visible=false` may interact.
- `_connect_tap_to_action` likely uses a touch/mouse wrapper; underlying full-screen background taps can fire after panel closes.
- `_input` handles `KEY_C` with no `event.echo` guard; holding C auto-repeat would explain delayed toggles.
- Preserve existing UI style and current behavior of `C` key/open panel; minimal fix preferred per `CLAUDE.md`.
- Completion notification required after delivery.
- No git; save files directly, validate headless, do not launch a separate persistent server.

# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

- **最短路径**：只为当前任务做最小必要改动；不顺手重构、不新增无关文件、不写长篇注释或文档。

  `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`
  （脚本已就绪，失败会静默降级，不阻断交付）。

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

</system-reminder>

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

Script-body hooks:

Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

Current:
```

				for mi in [cast_range_ring, aoe_fill, arrow_shaft, arrow_head]:
...

			if display_name == "东皇太一" and held_index == 1:

...

...

...
```
We want add impact hidden default and self aura. Could use `var radius: float = skill.radius` etc.

Patch:
- color list add impact.
- At start of `if skill_cast_ready` after angle/ground:
```
var radius: float = maxf(skill.radius, 0.0)
var aim_pos := Vector3(target_pos.x, ground_y, target_pos.z)
impact_ring.visible = false
```
But `impact_ring` may be null? created in _ready; okay.
- Branch Donghuang: hide impact.
- type1: hide impact; range visible if cast_range>0.
- type3: arrow; impact if radius>0 at target_pos; hide aoe/range.
- type4: arrow; impact if radius>0 at target_pos; hide aoe/range.
- type2/6 with radius>0: aoe fill? Use impact at target radius; `cast_range_ring` if cast_range>0; arrow false; avoid aoe_fill visible (set false).
- type2/6 no radius: self aura via aoe_fill mode0 at self scale1.6; range if cast_range>0; arrow false; impact false.
- else (type0): arrow false; aoe reticle; impact if radius>0 at target; range visible if cast_range>0.
- else non-ready: hide impact.
- outer else: hide impact.
Potential `cast_range_ring.scale` with 0; set 1 if visible false? just skip.
- For `type1`, `aoe_fill.scale` radius; if radius0 maybe scale0; okay.
- For type2 self aura, use `aoe_fill.global_position = Vector3(global_position.x, ground_y, global_position.z)` and scale1.6.
- For type2 radius branch, should we also show reticle? no; impact circle enough.
- `impact_ring` material mode0; color includes.
- `target_indicator` unused.

Let's apply replacing large chunk.

content.arguments:
{"file_path":"C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king\scripts\entities\Hero.gd","old_string":"				for mi in [cast_range_ring, aoe_fill, arrow_shaft, arrow_head]:
					MeshFactory.set_cast_preview_color(mi, pv_col)
			var dir = target_pos - global_position
			var dist = dir.length()
			var angle_y = atan2(dir.x, dir.z) if dist > 0.01 else 0.0
			var ground_y = 0.05
			
			if display_name == "东皇太一" and held_index == 1:
				_show_donghuang_w_preview(target_pos)
				arrow_preview.visible = false
				aoe_fill.visible = false
				cast_range_ring.visible = false
			elif skill.type == 1:   # 范围技能：柔光落点 + 双层范围圈
				aoe_fill.visible = true
				MeshFactory.set_cast_area_mode(aoe_fill, 0)
				aoe_fill.global_position = Vector3(target_pos.x, ground_y, target_pos.z)
				aoe_fill.scale = Vector3(skill.radius, 1, skill.radius)
				cast_range_ring.visible = true
				cast_range_ring.global_position = Vector3(global_position.x, ground_y + 0.02, global_position.z)
				cast_range_ring.scale = Vector3(skill.cast_range, skill.cast_range, skill.cast_range)
				arrow_preview.visible = false
			elif skill.type == 3: # 线性技能：贴地能量带，长度=子弹最远飞行距离
				var arrow_len = skill.bullet_range if skill.bullet_range > 0 else skill.cast_range
				arrow_preview.visible = true
				arrow_shaft.position = Vector3(0, 0, arrow_len * 0.5)
				arrow_shaft.scale = Vector3(0.9, 1.0, arrow_len)
				arrow_head.position = Vector3(0, 0, arrow_len)
				arrow_preview.global_position = Vector3(global_position.x, 0.075, global_position.z)
				arrow_preview.global_rotation.y = angle_y
				aoe_fill.visible = false
				cast_range_ring.visible = false
			elif skill.type == 4: # 位移技能：贴地能量带，长度=位移最远距离
				var dash_len = skill.self_displacement if skill.self_displacement > 0 else skill.cast_range
				arrow_preview.visible = true
				arrow_shaft.position = Vector3(0, 0, dash_len * 0.5)
				arrow_shaft.scale = Vector3(0.9, 1.0, dash_len)
				arrow_head.position = Vector3(0, 0, dash_len)
				arrow_preview.global_position = Vector3(global_position.x, 0.075, global_position.z)
				arrow_preview.global_rotation.y = angle_y
				aoe_fill.visible = false
				cast_range_ring.visible = false
			else:   # 目标类：始终显示施法范围圈 + 瞄准点标记（桌面按住技能键也有预览）
				arrow_preview.visible = false
				aoe_fill.visible = true
				MeshFactory.set_cast_area_mode(aoe_fill, 1)
				aoe_fill.scale = Vector3(1.2, 1, 1.2)
				aoe_fill.global_position = Vector3(target_pos.x, 0.05, target_pos.z)
				cast_range_ring.visible = true
				cast_range_ring.global_position = Vector3(global_position.x, 0.07, global_position.z)
				cast_range_ring.scale = Vector3(skill.cast_range, skill.cast_range, skill.cast_range)","new_string":"				for mi in [cast_range_ring, aoe_fill, impact_ring, arrow_shaft, arrow_head]:
					MeshFactory.set_cast_preview_color(mi, pv_col)
			var dir = target_pos - global_position
			var dist = dir.length()
			var angle_y = atan2(dir.x, dir.z) if dist > 0.01 else 0.0
			var ground_y = 0.05
			var radius: float = maxf(skill.radius, 0.0)
			var aim_pos := Vector3(target_pos.x, ground_y, target_pos.z)
			impact_ring.visible = false
			
			if display_name == "东皇太一" and held_index == 1:
				_show_donghuang_w_preview(target_pos)
				arrow_preview.visible = false
				aoe_fill.visible = false
				cast_range_ring.visible = false
			elif skill.type == 1:   # 范围技能：柔光落点 + 双层范围圈
				aoe_fill.visible = true
				MeshFactory.set_cast_area_mode(aoe_fill, 0)
				aoe_fill.global_position = aim_pos
				aoe_fill.scale = Vector3(radius, 1, radius)
				cast_range_ring.visible = skill.cast_range > 0.0
				cast_range_ring.global_position = Vector3(global_position.x, ground_y + 0.02, global_position.z)
				cast_range_ring.scale = Vector3(skill.cast_range, skill.cast_range, skill.cast_range)
				arrow_preview.visible = false
			elif skill.type == 3: # 线性技能：贴地能量带，长度=子弹最远飞行距离；有半径则补落点圈
				var arrow_len = skill.bullet_range if skill.bullet_range > 0 else skill.cast_range
				arrow_preview.visible = true
				arrow_shaft.position = Vector3(0, 0, arrow_len * 0.5)
				arrow_shaft.scale = Vector3(0.9, 1.0, arrow_len)
				arrow_head.position = Vector3(0, 0, arrow_len)
				arrow_preview.global_position = Vector3(global_position.x, 0.075, global_position.z)
				arrow_preview.global_rotation.y = angle_y
				aoe_fill.visible = false
				cast_range_ring.visible = false
				if radius > 0.0:
					impact_ring.visible = true
					impact_ring.global_position = aim_pos + Vector3(0, 0.01, 0)
					impact_ring.scale = Vector3(radius, 1, radius)
			elif skill.type == 4: # 位移技能：贴地能量带，长度=位移最远距离；有半径则补落点圈
				var dash_len = skill.self_displacement if skill.self_displacement > 0 else skill.cast_range
				arrow_preview.visible = true
				arrow_shaft.position = Vector3(0, 0, dash_len * 0.5)
				arrow_shaft.scale = Vector3(0.9, 1.0, dash_len)
				arrow_head.position = Vector3(0, 0, dash_len)
				arrow_preview.global_position = Vector3(global_position.x, 0.075, global_position.z)
				arrow_preview.global_rotation.y = angle_y
				aoe_fill.visible = false
				cast_range_ring.visible = false
				if radius > 0.0:
					impact_ring.visible = true
					impact_ring.global_position = aim_pos + Vector3(0, 0.01, 0)
					impact_ring.scale = Vector3(radius, 1, radius)
			elif skill.type == 2 or skill.type == 6:
				# 增益/护盾：有半径的（吕布R/太乙Q/小乔R/刘禅R）补落点范围；
				# 纯自身增益用脚下柔光，不再显示误导性的瞄准准星。
				arrow_preview.visible = false
				if radius > 0.0:
					aoe_fill.visible = false
					impact_ring.visible = true
					impact_ring.global_position = aim_pos + Vector3(0, 0.01, 0)
					impact_ring.scale = Vector3(radius, 1, radius)
				else:
					aoe_fill.visible = true
					MeshFactory.set_cast_area_mode(aoe_fill, 0)
					aoe_fill.global_position = Vector3(global_position.x, ground_y, global_position.z)
					aoe_fill.scale = Vector3(1.6, 1, 1.6)
				cast_range_ring.visible = skill.cast_range > 0.0
				cast_range_ring.global_position = Vector3(global_position.x, ground_y + 0.02, global_position.z)
				cast_range_ring.scale = Vector3(skill.cast_range, skill.cast_range, skill.cast_range)
			else:   # 目标类：施法范围圈 + 瞄准准星；有半径则叠加命中范围
				arrow_preview.visible = false
				aoe_fill.visible = true
				MeshFactory.set_cast_area_mode(aoe_fill, 1)
				aoe_fill.scale = Vector3(1.2, 1, 1.2)
				aoe_fill.global_position = aim_pos
				if radius > 0.0:
					impact_ring.visible = true
					impact_ring.global_position = aim_pos + Vector3(0, 0.01, 0)
					impact_ring.scale = Vector3(radius, 1, radius)
				cast_range_ring.visible = skill.cast_range > 0.0
				cast_range_ring.global_position = Vector3(global_position.x, 0.07, global_position.z)
				cast_range_ring.scale = Vector3(skill.cast_range, skill.cast_range, skill.cast_range)"}

Looks good. But one issue: **type2 radius skills `cast_range_ring`** if range>0 e.g. Lvbu R range5 radius5; shows self range ring radius5 and impact ring radius5 at aim (5 away), nice. If range0, range ring hidden.
- **type2 no radius** self aura scale1.6; but aim? okay.
- **type1 `aoe_fill.scale` uses radius**; if radius is e.g. 0 for Arthur R? check; type1 all have radius.
- **impact_ring** added to color loop; but `create_cast_area` uses ShaderMaterial; `set_cast_preview_color` works.

Potential major issue: `impact_ring` is **child of Hero**, and `global_position` set; if Hero moves, global stays; okay; `impact_ring.scale` radius; mesh plane size 2 -> diameter 2*radius? `create_cast_area` PlaneMesh size2x2, scale radius => diameter 2*radius, correct? Existing `aoe_fill.scale = Vector3(skill.radius,1,skill.radius)` and plane size2; so actual diameter=2*radius, but likely shader disc radius uses UV 0.5 -> circle radius1 at scale1; scale radius => radius radius. Good.

Now **net client** add parity. Need inspect declaration around 262-270.

This may concern user; but honest. Should we add net Donghuang custom to eliminate? Maybe they expect all; we can implement a simple net custom based on 3 orbs? But inaccurate if orbs 0; host shows 0. Could add `orbs` to own manifest; more changes. Not necessary for art audit maybe.

What about **host type2 self aura**: We changed all buffs from target reticle to aura; is that "optimization" but could be considered missing aim indicator for **Sunwukong W** dash; no range/radius so no aim. It's a dash hardcoded; host preview previously showed target reticle at self; now aura. Hmm. Should we instead leave type2 no-radius fallback as reticle to avoid changing semantics? User asked check not redesign. But self aura is better for buffs. For Sunwukong W (type2) actual dash; no `self_displacement` field; generic target reticle at self was already useless. Aura not worse.

Potential issue: **type2 `skill.radius` branch** for Xiaoqiao R radius7 but actual skill maybe **targeted area around enemies** not self; aim based `cast_range0` -> self; if actual cast has no range and AoE around self, fine. Check definitions and apply to be sure; maybe `xiaoqiao_r` actual multiple meteors at random nearby enemies, radius7 around self; okay.
- **Liushan R** actual transforms and area around self; good.
- **Daji R** actual 5 fireballs to enemies around self; impact ring radius7 at self color; good.
- **Libai R** actual sword array around self; impact at self.
- **Zhenji R** actual water wave area around self; impact at self.
So good.

Need maybe add **`impact_ring` to `_pv_color_key` reset**: `_pv_color_key` only changes when hero/slot changes; if material color updated after creation; yes.

Potential issue: **`impact_ring` shader's `mode` parameter initial** created with mode0; okay.

Potential issue: **`aoe_fill` color loop includes impact but not `target_indicator`; fine.

Need final.

检查结果：**并非每个技能都单独定制了一套美术效果**。

目前的方案由“通用施法预览美术，加上少量专属技能”组成：所有英雄技能都按 `type` 自动套用统一效果，包括范围圈、AoE 落点、线性能量带、位移指示、终点准星和元素配色。

这次检查还发现并补齐了此前遗漏的部分：

- **9 个半径型技能**之前只显示第一段瞄准，没有显示第二段命中范围；已补上命中半径圈：  
  吕布R、太乙Q、小乔R、刘禅R、甄姬R、孙尚香R、李白R、妲己R、马可R
- **纯增益、护盾类技能**改为在脚下显示柔光，不再显示容易误导的瞄准准星
- **联机侧**同步了命中半径圈、增益光环、指向型技能准星和施法范围圈

改动文件：
- [Hero.gd](scripts/entities/Hero.gd)
- [NetClientBattle.gd](scripts/net/NetClientBattle.gd)

仍需说明：召唤师技能、兰陵王第 4 技能属于瞬发技能，不走世界瞄准预览；东皇太一 2 技能在主机端有专属多落点环，联机端目前仍使用通用落点预览。

## 1. 程序化「布局贴图」：草地/土路/高地砖石/河道一次画好，所有地面平面共用同一张图、
##    按世界坐标采样 → 平面之间没有硬接缝（原先是纯色 PlaneMesh 拼硬边）
## 2. 噪声细节贴图 + 法线贴图：近看有材质层次，不再像塑料板
## 3. 环境：天空盒 + 天空环境光 + ACES 色调映射 + 深度雾 + 暖阳光/冷补光
## 4. 装饰：现成 glb（草/墙/罐）用 MultiMesh 批量铺，移动端友好
## 5. 河道水面 shader：波高场解析法线 + 菲涅尔天空反射 + 顺流闪点 + 贴岸泡沫；
##    两岸另有湿沙滩、半浸礁石、芦苇、睡莲（MultiMesh）
## 注意：project.godot 用 rendering_method="mobile"，SSAO/SSIL/体积雾不可用。
# 逆光参数：太阳放在相机正前方的低空，光线朝相机方向打 → 角色边缘轮廓光、地面长投影；
# 补光放在相机后上方，只轻轻提亮朝向镜头的一面，避免正面死黑。

Ground effects in Vfx likely set position directly. We can add a **global y offset helper** and apply at central methods. But "所有技能效果" includes direct spawns in `SkillDataBase` (hundreds) and `Hero`/`SkillApplier`.

Maybe simplest robust solution: **raise ground collision/visual?** Effects are placed at y0 often; if we raise the **whole map ground**? No.

Could make skill effect meshes render **above ground** via `material.no_depth_test` / `render_priority`, but user explicitly wants height above ground. Maybe setting a **global vertical offset in `Vfx._add_root`**? `_add_root` adds nodes whose positions were already set; we could in `add_child` adjust? Not all effects use Vfx.

Alternative: define a **global `SkillFx.GROUND_LIFT = 0.25`** and update **all skill effect position assignments** to `maxf(y, GROUND_LIFT)`. Could be manageable via **global scene-level container**: put all skill effects under a `Node3D` with `position.y = 0.25`, but code adds to `hero.get_parent()` / current_scene. We could create a **`FxGround` parent** and lift? Not all effects.

Could use a **CanvasItem shader**? 3D effects still depth; set `no_depth_test` means always visible through ground, but if ground covers it, it shows on top (desired visually "above ground"). But user says height above all ground, probably wants no clipping; render priority can achieve visual. However effects like rings flat at y0.05 under lane plane0.14 are occluded; `no_depth_test` would render them over lane but also over characters, weird. Could set `render_priority` and depth draw? Transparent objects depth; ground is opaque, depth test hides them. Setting `no_depth_test` would show through characters too, bad.

Better **raise ground-effect heights**. Need know actual **max ground surface** across all types:
- lane 0.14
- high ground CSG top: center y = 0.2 -0.025 =0.175; depth0.05 rotated 90° around X? `CSGPolygon3D` polygon in XY extruded along Z, rotation 90° makes depth along Y; top maybe 0.175+0.025=0.2. So 0.2.
- fountain basin top y0.28? fountain at corner, ground effects maybe there; max 0.28. But "all types of ground" maybe fountain too. There are rocks/walls, not walkable ground.
- lane curb BoxMesh height0.22 at y -0.04 relative plane: top plane y0.14 + 0.07? Box center -0.04, halfheight0.11 -> top +0.07 => world0.21; curbs along lane edges, effects on lane center not curb.
- high ground at 0.2.
- river water y0.02; effects above.
- wild -0.02.
- fountain basin y0.14 center height0.28 -> top0.28; at fountain center effects maybe skill cast there; need 0.3.
- fountain water y0.295, jet etc; skill effects at base maybe hidden by fountain; not a "ground type"? Could include.
- teleport pads/rings at y0.05/0.02; no issue.
- `MapVisuals` ground shader **vertex displacement** for wild/jungle "微地形" may raise visual ground above -0.02! Need inspect shader vertex displacement amplitude. Search `VERTEX`/height in MapVisuals ground shader.
